spyod pa'i glu'i 'grel pa jo bo rjes mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ma hā paṇḍi ta a bha yā ka ra gupta pā das mdzad pa/ ma hā paṇḍi ta ratna rakṣi ta pā da dang*/ lo tsā ba rdo rje 'dzin pa zhang grub pa dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/ dbang gi rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po a bha yā ka ra guptas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ mkhas pa shes rab dpal gyi 'gyur/ rang byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa'i man ngag ces bya ba dngos grub brnyes pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po a bha yā ka ra guptas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal bde mchog nyid dang dbyer med pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po dpal rje btsun ratna rakṣi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje bde mchog gi sgrub thabs rdo rje slob dpon chen po dpal nyin mor mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī su bhū ti shānti dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ bde mchog gi sbyin sreg gi cho ga bram ze chen po nyin mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las btus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs byang chub kyi sems kun du gzigs pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po ka la ka pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta chen po krī ka ra dang*/ lo tsā ba chen po 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i de kho na nyid snang ba slob dpon chen po dpag med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra rakṣi ta dang*/ ā tsārya mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i snying po de kho na nyid bsdus pa slob dpon ku sa li pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug dang*/

ā tsārya mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ lhan cig skyes pa'i de kho na nyid snang ba dang*/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag slob dpon ku sa li pas mdzad pa/ kha che'i mkhas pa bha dra bo dhi dang*/ lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa gnyis su med pa'i bsam gtan gyi man ngag rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gtum mo slob dpon chen po dge ba'i mgon pos mdzad pa/ bal po'i paṇḍi ta wā gī shwa ra dang*/ lo tsā ba ā tsārya mar pa chos dbang gi 'gyur/ lū hi pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i 'grel pa sdom pa 'byung ba zhes bya ba/ lū hi pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i 'grel pa'i ṭī ka khyad par gsal byed ces bya ba/ dpal bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rnams paṇḍi ta chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs dza ga ta la'i paṇḍi ta chen po bi bhū ti tsand+ra'i rang 'gyur/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i mngon par rtogs pa'i dka' 'grel slob dpon bī ra badzras mdzad pa/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i cho ga yid 'ong phreng ba zhes bya ba dang*/ mnyes pa'i snying po zhes bya ba slob dpon kṣānti dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa/ ye shes 'byung ba man ngag ces bya ba kā yastha pa ga ya dha ras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ sdom pa 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bal po'i paṇḍi ta chen po kṣanti shrī'i zhal snga nas dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shong blo brtan gyis legs par bsgyur te gtan la phab pa rnams bzhugs so// //za pa la/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs padma rā ga'i gter zhes bya ba dang*/ rkang pa bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa bsgyur ba'i bstod pa/ shrī dza ya se nā dang*/ dpal dharma yon tan gyi 'gyur/ 'di la tshigs su bcad par bsgyur ba'ang snang ngo*// gtor ma'i cho ga rin po che asma garbha dang*/

bla ma'i maṇḍal gyi cho ga rin po che marka ta mkhas pa dza ya se na'i gsung*/ dpal ye shes rdo rje'i 'gyur/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa slob dpon mai tri pas mdzad pa/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i mngon par dbang bskur ba'i cho ga dang*/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rin po che me shel mkhas pa chen po dza ya se nā'i gsung*/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ dpal ye shes rdo rje'i 'gyur/ rang byin gyis brlab pa'i man ngag gi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po gzhon nu dpal gyi zhal snga nas gyis mdzad pa/ gsang ba rin po che yid bzhin gyi nor bu snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa zhes bya ba dpal ldan nā ro pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po shrī na ro pa dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyi 'gyur/ gsang ba rin po che zhes bya ba mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa'i snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis phulla ha ri'i dgon par bsgyur ba/ bdud rtsi 'od zer can zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po ratna shrī dzñā na dang*/ mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro lus med pa'i chos zhes bya ba rje te lo pas nā ro pa la gsungs pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma lta bsgom spyod gsum gyi brda bstan pa/ dpal sdom pa'i man ngag zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis phu la ha rir bsgyur ba/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta shū ra ka la shas mdzad pa/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bsod nams bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa zhes bya ba dang*/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la bstod pa kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po bram ze rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta ma hā dzñā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyun bshags rgyas pa slob dpon bhu ri pas mdzad pa/ jo bo rje dang*/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ lam gyi rab tu bya ba grong khyer sumbha ri'i rgyal po'i sras dpal 'jigs byed lha'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid kyi spyan sngar/ bod kyi lo tsā ba grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dbang gi rim pa zhes bya ba kha che'i paṇḍi ta bde ba'i rgyal pos mdzad pa/ ratna shrī'i zhabs kyi padmo la gtugs pa paṇḍi ta shrī pa ra hi ta dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta dpal ma ṇi ka shrīs mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta su ma ti kīrti'i spyan sngar dge slong pradzñā kīrti'i 'gyur/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga grub pa'i slob dpon chen po nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rig pa gzhon nu'i 'gyur/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon dbus pa blo ldan gyis mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba mkhas pa chen po dzñā na shrīs mdzad pa/ bod kyi rgyal po pho brang zhi ba 'od kyis bsgyur ba/ slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa sbron ma bzhi'i ṭī ka zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po shrī dha ra'i zhal snga nas gyis mdzad cing bsgyur ba'o// de ltar bde mchog yab bka'i skor rnams bkod nas/ yum gtso bor gyur pa'i skor la/ dpal rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs ā tsārya bha dras mdzad pa/ bal po'i paṇḍi ta su ma ti kīrti dang*/

bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs mkhas pa chen po a ba dhū tī pa gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la mchod pa mdor bsdus pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po badzra pā ṇi'i zhal snga nas dang*/ lo tsā ba mtshur gyi 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs byang chub sems dpa' rgyal po seng ge'i gdan can khyab 'jug sbas pas mdzad pa/ 'jigs med lha'i zhabs dang*/ lo tsā ba rje btsun pradzñā kīrti'i 'gyur/ grub pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po dpal o ḍyān gyi mi dbang ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal nā lend+ra pa dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong pradzñā kīrti'i 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyis byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti chen pos mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba ye shes rdo rje'i 'gyur/ rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs dpal lha lcam lakṣ+mī ka ras mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs dpal ri khrod dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rgyal po ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa/ bla ma bai ro tsa na'i 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs zhal gnyis ma chung ba ri khrod dbang phyug gis mdzad par grags pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bsod nams 'byung gnas bzang po dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ dpal de kho na nyid ye shes grub pa zhes bya ba zhal gnyis ma che bar grags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa mkhas pa chen po ting nge 'dzin rdo rje'i zhabs rdul la reg pa paṇḍi ta stong nyid ting nge 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ don thams cad grub pa

don grub ma chung ba'ang zer/ zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs slob dpon grub pa brnyes pa a ba dhū tī pas mdzad pa/ ye shes 'pho don grub ma che ba zer/ ba zhes bya ba dpal stong nyid ting nge 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje phag mo dbu bcad ma'i sgrub thabs chung ba lha mo dpal gyi blo gros mas mdzad pa rnams bal po'i paṇḍi ta bha rend+ra ru tsi dang*/ lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dbu bcad ma'i sgrub thabs che ba zhes bya ba dpal birwa pas mdzad pa/ bal po'i paṇḍi ta bha rend+ra ru tsi dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga slob dpon chen po bsod snyoms pa'i slob ma rgyal bas byin gyi tsha bo sangs rgyas byin gyis mdzad pa/ bal po'i paṇḍi ta bha rend+ra ru tsi dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ gzhung drug gi sbyin sreg dang bcas pa 'di dag bod na grags pa'i rim pa ltar bkod pa'o// rigs ldan ma'i de kho na nyid nges pa zhes bya ba o ḍyān du grub pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na'i 'gyur/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mchod pa'i cho ga rgya gar gyi mkhan po badzra pā ṇi'i zhal snga nas dang*/ lo tsā ba mtshur gyi 'gyur/ rus sbal zhabs kyi sgrub pa'i thabs grub thob rngon pa bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta ā nanda ka ra'i zhal snga nas dang*/ dpyal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ phag mo thugs kyi sgrub thabs kurma pā da'i gdams pa/ paṇḍi ta ā nanda ka ra dang*/ dpyal lo tsā ba dpal chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs grub thob rngon pa bas mdzad pa/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa ni ska laṅga dang*/ dpyal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ slob ma rjes su gzung ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba/

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ rdo rje phag mo'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga rnams grub thob sha ba ri dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ yul ma ga dhā'i paṇḍi ta gau tam bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis legs par bsgyur ba/ rnal 'byor gyi rjes su 'brang zhal gnyis ma chung ba'i 'grel pa zer/ ba zhes bya ba grub thob chen po dā ri ka pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta klu'i sbyin pa'i rnal 'byor gyi snying po'i don bsdus bstan pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mchod pa'i cho ga slob dpon dā ri ka pas mdzad pa rnams rgya gar shar phyogs dza ga ta la'i paṇḍi ta dā na shī las bod yul dbus kyi drang srong srin po rir rang 'gyur/ keng rus tā ra na pa'i sgrub thabs lha 'dre bran du 'khol ba'i slob dpon dā ri ka pas mdzad pa/ keng rus tā ra na'i sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa gzhan la phan pa zhes bya ba mang du thos pa'i slob dpon ku mā ra bo dhis mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po dzā landha ra pas mdzad pa/ phag mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon mkhas pa chen po rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs o rgyan nas byung ba rnams paṇḍi ta su ma ti kīrti dang*/ lo tsā ba mar pa chos dbang gi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// //'a pa la/ rdo rje phag mo dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon koṅka byin gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta rakṣi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba khams pa ba ri dharma kīrti'i 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje phag mo shes rab gsal byed ma'i bstod pa zhes bya ba slob dpon koṅka byin gyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta ratna rakṣi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong grub pa dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bzhed pa'i sbas pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon koṅka byin gyis mdzad pa/

paṇḍi ta dha pa la ha 'u dang*/ lo tsā ba ba ri rin chen grags kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dgongs pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga slob dpon koṅka byin gyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta badzra pā ṇi dang*/ lo tsā ba mtshur dzñā na ā ka ra'i 'gyur/ dpal rnal 'byor ma'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdzad 'gyur mi gsal ba 'di bod ma 'dra/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis gtsang nyang ro cung pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs dpal nā ro pa'i zhal gyi brgyud pa rjes su gnang ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ma ti kīrti dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong pradzñā kīrti'i 'gyur/ 'di nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gzhung yin/ gzhan don slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga bla ma bha rend+ra ru tsis mdzad pa/ bla ma bal po lo tsā ba dang*/ ye shes rdo rjes thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bsgyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba bi rū pa'i gdams ngag gi brgyud pa shrī u ma pa ti dattas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta mkhas pa chen po wā gī shwa ra gupta pā da dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos rab kyi 'gyur/ mngon par rtogs pa'i snye ma zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po dge ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta mkhas pa chen po dā na shī la'i rang 'gyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bde ba mchog gi sdom pa la 'jug pa nges pa don gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po a wa dhū tī pa dpal gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na kīrti'i rang 'gyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba dpal u ma pa ti dattas mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta chen po wā gī shwa ra gupta dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos rab kyi 'gyur/ de kho na nyid ye shes yang dag par grub pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa de kho na nyid bshad pa zhes bya ba/ bi kra ma shī la'i gtsug lag khang du dge slong paṇḍi ta brtson 'grus dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ bal po'i paṇḍi ta mañdzu shrī dang dze tā karṇa'i zhal snga nas mnyan te/ lo tsā ba dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal thar pa gling du legs par bsgyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phag mo khros pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po buddha shrī bha dra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod dkar mo'i bstod pa paṇḍi ta dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rig pa 'dzin pa rtsen ma'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga mkhas pa chen po rgyal ba'i sde'am mtshan gzhan khang pa gsar pa zhes bya bar brjod pas gris pa/ gzhan don slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga dza ya se nās mdzad pa/ dpal phag mo dmar chung ma zhes kyang bya/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba tri sa ra ha pas mdzad pa/ rin po che rgyan gyi sgrub pa/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba rnams rje dī paṃ kā ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ rgya brtson 'grus seng ge'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod pa paṇḍi ta chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba khu ne tso'i 'gyur/ rdo rje phag mo mdor bsdus pa'i bstod pa a bhi sang ka tās mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta ngag gi dbang phyug dang*/ klog skya lo tsā'i 'gyur/ ye shes dbab pa'i cho ga rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dgongs pa'i gsang ba sbyin sreg gi cho ga slob dpon a bhi yuktas mdzad pa/

gzhan yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsad pa las kyi man ngag phyir bzlog 'khor lo/ phag mo'i srung ba'i 'khor lo/ gtor ma'i cho ga lag pa'i mchod pa rnams slob dpon a bhi yuktas mdzad zer ba 'di ni the tshom gyi gzhir snang ngo*// rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs rnam par sgeg pa zhes bya ba dang*/ rdo rje phag mo'i bstod pa rim pa gnyis pa rdo rje btsun mos byin gyis brlabs pa grub dbang rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po shrī ba na ratnas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po de nyid dang*/ chos 'khor lo tsā ba 'jam dpal ye shes kyis 'bras yul nor bu'i gling du bsgyur ba la/ phyis chos smra ba rgya mtsho'i sdes mi bcos su mi rung ba rnams bcos nas don la rton par bsgyur ba zhes bya ba'i mtha' can/ rdo rje phag mo don thams cad grub ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba dang*/ yang rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba zhal gnyis ma ste/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po nags kyi rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba 'jam dpal ye shes kyi 'gyur/ gnas la sogs pa gtan la dbab pa rnam par grags pa'i paṇḍi ta gnas brtan shākya rakṣi ta'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ zhwa lu lo tsā ba dge slong dharmā pā la bha dras legs par bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// bde mchog 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel nyi shu bzhi// yab skor gtso bo brgya dang bco brgyad la// yum gyi skor la drug cu rtsa bdun te// dril bas brgya phrag gnyis dang dgu bzhugs so// de dag gis ni bde mchog 'khor lo'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar bde mchog 'khor lo'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ dpal gdan bzhi'i skor la/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gdan bzhi'i 'grel pa dran pa'i rgyu mtshan zhes bya ba slob dpon bha ba bha dras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang*/

bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// //ya pa la/ 'phags pa gdan bzhi'i rnam par bshad pa slob dpon dge ba'i go chas gzigs nas sbyor ba'i gdan gyi rnam par bshad pa yan chad mdzad cing*/ de dman chad rgya gar gyi mkhan po dran pa'i ye shes grags pas mdzad pa/ smṛ ti'i rang 'gyur/ mchan khung gi sbyor ba slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dpal gdan bzhi'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon ārya de bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gupta dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba bal po'i paṇḍi ta chen po dza ga ta ā nanda dzī wa bha dras mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs 'di dang mthun pa'i bka' lung sngon chad bod du dar ba ma byung ba la/ de nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo paṇḍi ta ma hā bo dhi las nos shing lung mi chad pa'i don du paṇḍi ta'i phyag nas rgya dpe gdan drangs shing*/ bod kyi paṇḍi ta ma ti dhwa dza shrī bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba dpal ldan smra ba'i seng ges dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen por bsgyur ba/ gdan bzhi'i yum skor la/ ye shes dbang phyug ma'i sgrub thabs 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta smṛ ti dzñā na kīrti'i rang 'gyur/ phyis paṇḍi ta sa ma ya shrī dzñā nas rgya dpe la zhus tig byas pa/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gdan bzhi pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga snying po mdor bsags pa slob dpon chen po ārya de bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos khugs pa lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ dpal gdan bzhi'i zab don ston pa shing gcig gi dka' 'grel dang*/ rdo rje dril thabs kyi mchod pa'i thabs kyi rim pa slob dpon 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ dpal gdan bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po bha ba bha tras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang*/

bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ dpal gdan bzhi pa'i chu'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga slob dpon bha ba'i man ngag lo tsā ba tshul khrims gzhon nu'i 'gyur/ gdan bzhi'i yum skor la/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por dge slong rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis rgya dpe las bsgyur te zhus pa/ rnal 'byor nam mkha'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sdes mdzad pa/ gdan bzhi'i de kho na nyid bzhi pa slob dpon dze tā ri pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ de kho na nyid drug rnam par gzhag pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po smṛ te dzñā na kīrtis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid kyi 'gyur rnams so// dpal ldan rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud 'grel gsum// yab yum sgrub thabs dkyil 'khor cho ga dang*// rdzogs rim la sogs chos skor bcu gnyis te// dril bas bcu phrag gcig dang lnga bzhugs so// de dag gis ni dpal gdan bzhi'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar gdan bzhi'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi skor la/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel sgyu ma can zhes bya ba rdo rje slob dpon mkhas pa dpal du dza ya tsand+ras mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta bde gshegs grags pa dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes sems dpa'i 'gyur/ dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa yon tan ldan pa zhes bya ba slob dpon paṇḍi ta chen po dpal rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po zhi ba bzang po dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa dran pa zhes bya ba nag po dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na wa ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ sgyu ma chen mo zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel dpal slob dpon mkhas pa chen po rgyan pas mdzad pa/ sgyu ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs bcom ldan 'das yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nyid o ḍyān gyi yul du byon nas gsungs pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a wa dhū tī pa dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba shākya brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i he ru ka'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba spros pa med pa'i man ngag ma hā mā yā'i sgrub thabs rmongs pa sgrol ba'i brtag pa zhes bya ba rnams slob dpon ku ku ri pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a nī la badzra dang bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur ba/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dngos grub brnyes pa ku ku ri pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po na bi ko ṭa dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ ma hā mā yā'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha la bstod pa slob dpon chen po ku ku ri pas zhal gzigs pa'i tshe bstod pa/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag gi 'grel pa slob dpon blo bzang snying pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gupta dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po dpal rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas pa chen po dzñā na shrī bha dra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dpal sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs dang*/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i rim pa gsal ba zhes bya ba nag po spyod pa bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po karm+ma badzra dang*/

lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ 'di la dpe la lar ku ku ri pas mdzad zer ba'ang 'dug spyi'i chos spyod/ rigs lnga mkha' 'gro'i bstod pa/ dpal he ru ka 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod pa/ bdun tshigs kyi cho ga rnams slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa/ sātstsha gdab pa'i man ngag sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa slob dpon chen po chos kyi zhabs kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa dang*/ sgyu ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po zhi ba bzang po dang*/ lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sgrub thabs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sbyin sreg dang bcas pa slob dpon grub thob rnal 'byor pa chen po dpal rgyan pas mdzad pa/ sgyu 'phrul chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bla ma'i zhal snga'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon mkhas pa 'dul bas byin gyis mdzad pa/ he ru ka phyag rgya gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ ro sreg pa'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sgrub thabs rgya gar gyi mkhan po sku med rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa bzhi// sgrub thabs la sogs chos skor nyer gsum ste// gsang ba yid bde'i chos skor dri ma med// bcu phrag gnyis dang bcas pa'i bdun bzhugs so// de dag gis ni sgyu ma chen mo'i skor gyi chos tshan gyi rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar sgyu ma chen mo'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i skor la/ ra pa la/ dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi'i dka' 'grel slob dpon dri med bzang po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'di sngar gyi 'gyur rnying pa'i le'u gnyis pa man chad ma tshang zhing*/ de yan chad kyang shin tu 'khrugs te 'grel pa gzhan dang 'dres pa las/ lo tsā ba chen po dge slong rin chen grub kyis rgya dpe las bsgyur zhing smṛ ti'i spel mar bshad pa dang yang bstun nas gtan la phab pa/

rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud kyi bshad pa slob dpon yon tan bzang pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po smṛ ti'i rang 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i rgya cher 'grel pa bdud rtsi 'dzag pa zhes bya ba dngos grub thob pa'i slob dpon chen po bha gos mdzad pa/ gzhung tshad tshigs bcad stong sum brgya yod pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta tā ra pā la dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba la chings yon tan 'bar gyi 'gyur la/ phyis paṇḍi ta shrī la kudzha badzra dang*/ lo tsā ba glog skya shes rab brtsegs kyis legs par bcos pa rnams bzhugs so// he ru ka dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi yi// rgyud kyi rgyal po'i rnam bshad dri ma med// mkhas grub rnams kyis mdzad pa rnam pa gsum// shin tu khyad par 'phags pa legs par bzhugs// de dag gis ni rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i skor la/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel ye shes ldan pa zhes bya ba dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po sa ra ha'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel de kho na nyid kyi zla ba zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas pa chen po padma rdo rjes mdzad pa las/ le'u gnyis pa yan chad ji tsam rnyed pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i rgya cher 'grel pa 'jigs pa med pa'i gzhung zhes bya ba/ gnas brtan mkhas pa a bhya yā ka ra guptas mdzad pa/ ding ri chos grags kyi 'gyur yin nam zer ba'i 'gyur rnying la bar skabs su dpe stor bas ma tshang ba la dpang lo tsā ba dge slong blo gros brtan pas le'u dang por bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag rgya chen po zhes pa nas/

'og gi lam nas byung zhes pa'i bar dang*/ lha'i sku bsgoms te zhes pa nas sa gzhi la sogs pa rnams dang g.yo ba zhes pa'i bar dang*/ le'u gsum pa'i mjug bsgom pa rdzogs pas zhes pa nas/ le'u bzhi pa'i tha ma la ni 'dir ma rig pa ste des zhes pa'i bar dang*/ le'u bcu pa'i dbu'i de kho na nyid ni thams cad la zhes pa nas/ le'u bcu bzhi pa'i mjug na gang zhig shar bas ni zhes pa'i bar dang*/ srid gsum rnam rgyal zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad gnyis rnams hor kong bsabs shing lhag ma rnams la zhu chen bgyis te gtan la phab pa/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma'i cho ga dpal sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i rim pa gsal ba zhes bya ba rnams dngos grub kyi mchog brnyes pa'i slob dpon sa ra ha'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ ga ya dha ra dang*/ gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ ri gi a ra la'i sgrub thabs lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen grub kyis rgya dpe ji lta ba bzhin 'gyur ba rnams so// dpal ldan sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba'i// rgyud kyi rgyal po'i rnam bshad rnam pa gsum// sgrub dkyil gtor chog ri gi'i sgrub thabs te// chos skor dri ma med pa bdun bzhugs so// de dag gis ni sangs rgyas thod pa'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar sangs rgyas thod pa'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi skor la/ dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog gi rgyud kyi don rnam par bshad pa zhes bya ba dpal o ḍyān gyi mkhas pa chen po 'dzam gling gi nyi ma dang 'dra ba dngos grub thob pa'i slob dpon rgyal po brgya byin sdang pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bidyā ka ra singha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba lha rin po che'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog gi 'grel pa mnyam sbyor gyi rgyan zhes bya ba slob dpon rab tu dga' ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so//

//la pa la/ dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel slob dpon ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rtog pa thams cad 'dus pa zhes bya ba sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog gi rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma rnam par bshad pa shlau ka drug stong lnga brgya bdun cu pa shrī nā lend+ra na bzhugs pa rdo rje slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ smṛ ti dzñā na kīrti'i rang 'gyur/ 'di mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud phyi ma phyi ma'i 'grel par snang gi rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa min par snang ngo*// sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dka' 'grel slob dpon rab tu zhi ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsarya shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ dharma shrī bha dra dang zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka'i gsang don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal padma gar gyi dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje rin chen nyi ma'i gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba/ rta mchog rol pa'i gsang ba'i don rnam par dgod pa zhes bya ba rnams slob dpon ku ku rā dzas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bidyā ka ra singha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba lha rin po che'i 'gyur/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i cho ga lnga pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po ku ku rā dzas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī badzra ha sa dang*/ sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba rma rin chen mchog gi 'gyur/

dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po ku ku rā dzas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po gu lend+ra gupta dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dran pa nam mkha'i 'gyur la/ phyis lo tsā ba lha rin po ches bcos la/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i tshogs kyi cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon rgyal po ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā nanda garbha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dran pa nam mkha'i 'gyur/ phyis lo tsā ba lha rin po ches bcos pa/ dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po thu bo rā dza hastis mdzad pa/ dpal he ru ka'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po hūm̐ mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bidyā ka ra singha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba lha rin po che'i 'gyur/ dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon chen po hūm̐ gi zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po badzra ha sa dang*/ sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba rma rin chen mchog gis bsgyur ba las/ slad kyis lo tsā ba phyi ma dag gis sum thug tu zhu chen bcos pa/ yan lag bzhi'i don snang bar byed pa zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa hūm̐ mdzad grags pas mdzad pa/ dpal bsam yas kyi mchims phur dkyil 'khor chen po'i slob dpon paṇḍi ta dpal rdo rje bzhad pa dang*/ sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po rma rin chen mchog gis dbang sgrub dang bcas pa legs par bsgyur ba/ dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po hūm̐ mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bidyā ka ra singha dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba lha rin po che'i 'gyur/ dpal khrag 'thung chen po'i sgrub thabs yang dag par grub pa zhes bya ba grub pa'i slob dpon chen po badzra hūm̐ ka ra'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/

dpal nā lend+ra'i gtsug lag khang du rgya gar gyi mkhan po hūm̐ ka ra de nyid dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba gnubs nam mkha'i snying po'i 'gyur/ rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog ces bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sems can thams cad kyi bde ba skyed ma zhes bya ba kha che'i mkhas pa shes bya mtha' dag la mkhas pa dpal rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dpal o ḍyān du sbyangs pa mkhas pa ye shes rdo rje dang*/ lo tsā ba gnyan bsod nams kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po rgyal po ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' rjes su dran pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po thu bo rā dza hastis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par sbyor ba yi// mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog rgyud 'grel lnga// sgrub thabs la sogs chos skor bcu dgu ste// mnyam sbyor chos skor nyi shu rtsa bzhi bzhugs// de dag gis ni sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi chos skor rnams bkod nas/ sgrol ma'i skor la/ sha pa la/ sgrol ma rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud ltar du bshad pa la/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba sgrol ma rgya mtsho'i rgyud nas phyung ba 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta chen po dharma badzra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong dar ma rin chen gyis/ chos 'khor 'jo 'jo'i gtsug lag khang du legs par bsgyur cing zhus chen mdzad pa/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma spyi'i mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ lha mo sgrol ma'i bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba dang*/

de'i so so'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa kha che'i slob dpon nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa rnams mkhas pa chen po mañdzu shrī dang*/ lo tsā ba chen po mal gyo blo gros grags pas bi kra ma shī la'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs man ngag gi rim pa slob dpon chen po nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa/ 'di dang po ma 'gyur ba la/ phyis kha che'i paṇḍi tas kha ba can gyi ljongs su spyan drangs pa'i dpe las bod skad du dpal sa skya'i dben gnas dam par bsgyur ba/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma la bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig ma'i sgrub thabs rje btsun lha mo mchog gis rjes su bzung ba'i slob dpon chen po nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa/ chos rje ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas gsum par grags pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po bsod snyoms pa kha che shākya shrī bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bod yul dbus kyi gtsug lag khang chen po sol nag thang po che dang*/ pho brang khra 'brug gi gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba/ lha mo sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig la bstod pa rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po sūrya guptas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ges tho lding gser gyi lha khang du bsgyur ba/ lha mo dam

ma byung*/ tshig sgrol ma'i bstod pa/ sgrol ma phreng ba 'dzin pa'i bstod pa paṇḍi ta chen po thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa snga 'gyur/ me tog phreng 'dzin gyi bstod pa slob dpon chen po thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka na ka warma dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur la/ slad kyis paṇḍi ta ma ni ka shrī dzñā na dang*/ chag lo tsā ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyis cung zad bcos pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i me tog phreng ba 'dzin pa'i bstod pa tsheg bar bdun mar bcad pa slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta zla ba gzhon nu'i rang 'gyur/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa kha che'i slob dpon nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta sā dhu kīrti dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba ldan ma tshul khrims seng ges bsgyur ba la/ phyis dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du dag par byas pa/ lha mo sgrol ma la sme sngags kyi gsol ba 'debs pa zhes bya ba'i bstod pa slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta shākya shrī dang*/ lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ sgrol ma dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bi kra ma shī la'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba/ byang chub kyi sems bde ba'i man ngag rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na nyid dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur cing*/ pho brang byang chub 'od kyis zhus pa/ me tog phreng 'dzin gyi sgrub pa'i thabs 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po ta thā ga ta rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ cog gru lo tsā ba mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba/

so so'i sgrub thabs la/ sgrol ma dkar mo la brten nas stong pa nyid bsgom pa/ sngon mo la brten nas log par lta ba sun dbyung ba/ ser mo la brten nas chom rkun bcing ba/ dmar mo la brten nas rig pa bskyed pa/ ljang ser la brten nas 'chi ba bslu ba rnams 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po ta thā ga ta rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ cog gru lo tsā ba mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ 'phags ma lha mo sgrol ma'i bstod pa don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba bstod pa'i rgyal po slob dpon ma ti tsi ṭas mdzad pa/ 'phags pa sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rim pas rje btsun sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ma hā dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba gzhon nu 'od kyi 'gyur/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ 'brog mi lo tsā'i 'gyur/ u rgyan sgrol ma'i skor la/ 'phags ma gnas kyi dbang phyug ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal u rgyan gyi sgrol ma'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ u rgyan gyi sgrol ma'i rim pa/ dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa paṇḍi ta pa ra hi tas mdzad pa rnams kha che'i paṇḍi ta saṅgha shrī bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba 'jam dpal sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i 'gyur/ dpa' bo gcig ma'i rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ u rgyan gyi rim pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gdan mas gsungs pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga nyung ngu dang*/ zhing gi dbang phyug ma'i mchod pa'i rim pa rnams paṇḍi ta pa ra hi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba nag tsho shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ de kho na nyid kyi tshig le'ur byas pa'i man ngag paṇḍi ta pa ra hi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/

de kho na nyid kyi tshig le'ur byas pa'i man ngag gi 'grel pa mkhas pa chen po slob dpon su dza ya shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa/ mkhas pa rin chen dpal gyi slob ma paṇḍi ta pa ra hi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba nag tsho dge slong shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ ma hā mā yā'i rdzogs rim de dang cha 'dra bar 'dug na'ang*/ nag tsho'i lugs la u rgyan sgrol ma'i rdzogs rim du bzhed do// gnas chen gyi rim pa'i lha mo sgrol ma la bstod pa slob dpon mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta pā ra hi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ zhing gi dbang phyug ma'i bstod pa blon po'i rigs shin tu dga' ba'i paṇḍi tas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta ye shes rdo rje dang*/ lo tsā ba nag tsho chen po'i 'gyur/ rdo rje dril bu'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba dang*/ thod pa mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta pa ra hi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba nag tsho shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'di u rgyan sgrol ma'i chos skor du mdzad do// rmi lam sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon zla ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta su ga ta shrī dang*/ lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ sgrol ma'i 'chi kha ma'i nyams len dpal chos kyi rje sa steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i kha che shākya shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa dang*/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs ma byung*/ bsdus pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po shākya shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas byung ba/ dpyal padmo can gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje phag mo sgrol ma la bstod pa paṇḍi ta zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ sgrol ma khro mo la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bstod pa tshig rkang bcu gnyis pa/

sgrol ma u gra tā ra'i sgrub thabs rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po shrī ba na ratna'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa dang*/ 'phags ma sgrol ma drag mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po shrī ba na ratna dang*/ lo tsā ba mañdzu shrīs bsgyur ba/ 'phags ma sgrol ma drag mo'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po nags kyi rin chen gyi zhal snga nas dang*/ dge slong chos smra ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde'i 'gyur/ ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po dā na shī las 'o na 'di'i sku grong du legs par bsgyur cing zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma khros pa'i ba liṃ gi gtor ma'i cho ga bsdus pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta dā na shī las 'gran gyi 'phyang sar du rang 'gyur mdzad pa/ sgrol ma ral gcig ma'i blo 'phel snyan ngag mkhan rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po dā na shī las yang dag par bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa ral pa gcig ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rol pa'i sbas pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs ba rend+ra dza ga ta la'i paṇḍi ta dā na shī las yul dbus kyi grub pa thob pa'i gnas drang srong srin po rir bsgyur ba/ ral pa gcig ma dmar mo'i sgrub pa'i thabs kun spangs rdo rje zhes pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta mi dbang bzang po dang*/ chos smra ba'i btsun pa legs pa'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ ral pa gcig ma dmar mo'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga nag po spyod pa bas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta mi dbang bzang po dang*/ lo tsā ba gzhon nu shes rab kyi 'gyur/ mchog gi sgrol ma ral gcig ma'i man ngag gi sgrub thabs snyan ngag mkhan rtag pa'i rdo rje'i man ngag bha gu paṇḍi ta'i khyad chos/

rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇa chen dā na shī la las mnyan te/ rig pa 'dzin pa khu rnal 'byor pas 'on dmar du legs par bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ sgrol ma lha lnga'i sgrub thabs rin po che gsal ba zhes bya ba slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta ratna da ti dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ thugs rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba dngos grub phreng ba slob dpon rtag pa'i badzras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ lo tsā ba mkhas pa ba ris rgya dpe bod du spyan drangs nas ba sbugs rong gi gser khang du bsgyur ba/ sgrol ma'i nang gi gtor chog slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ yul bal po rdzong du bsgyur ba/ phyir bzlog gi 'khor lo rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ mkhas pa chen po rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ sgrol ma gsang ba'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ratna da ti dang lo tsā ba rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ thugs rje sgrol ma las sna tshogs pa'i sgrub thabs rgya gar bsil ba'i seng ldeng phug tu slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ mkhas pa chen po ba ri lo tsā'i 'gyur/ khwa gdong ma srang mda' nag po zhes bya ba slob dpon rtag pa'i badzras mdzad pa/ sgrol ma'i man ngag me long dwangs pa zhes bya ba rma dang ba ri lo tsā ba dharma kīrti zhes bya bas dpyal dang*/ bla ma gus ston la zhus nas bsgyur ba/ de rnams sgrol ma rnal 'byor bla med du bkral ba'i skor rnams so// ma rgyud spyi dang 'brel pa la/ dpal u rgyan gyi rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma'i rang byung gi longs spyod dur khrod kyi rtog pa zhes bya ba slob dpon birwa pas mdzad pa las btus pa/ rnal 'byor pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na kīrti'i rang 'gyur/ rjes chags kyi sbyor bas de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i man ngag ces bya ba paṇḍi ta chen po don yod rdo rje'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa dang*/

las kyi phyag rgya brtag pa'i man ngag ces bya ba paṇḍi ta a mo gha badzra las byung ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ dbang chos rten 'brel 'gro ldog dpal nā ro pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi bla ma te phu ba dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa/ shlau ka sum brgya drug cu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'di phyi nang gi rgyud du ma dang 'brel yang*/ khyad par ma rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ gdan bzhi dang 'brel par snang bas 'dir bkod do// rmi lam brtag pa rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta bi bhu ti tsand+ra'i rang 'gyur/ padma drwa ba 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs rgyal ba dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa dang*/ padma spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi padma drwa ba'i rim pas bcom ldan 'das kyi dkyil 'khor du mchod pa'i cho ga rgyal ba dpal ye shes ming gzhan padma rdo rje zhes bya bas mdzad pa/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po su ma na shrī bha dra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen grub kyi 'gyur/ ma rgyud dang phyogs mthun pa mgon po nag po'i skor la/ dpal mgon po nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi rim pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ dpal nag po chen po'i rgyud drag po'i brtag pa dur khrod chen po zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa dpal rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ dpal nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dngos grub rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba dang*/ ye shes kyi me sbar ba zhes bya ba sbyin sreg gi cho ga paṇḍi ta chen po sa manta shrīs mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos rab kyi 'gyur/

nag po chen po'i mngon par rtogs pa phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i dpal lhan cig skyes pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa dang*/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa lhan cig skyes pa'i zhabs kyi slob ma slob dpon li ka ri'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī na rend+ra bha dra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba u rgyan pa rin chen dpal gyis ri bo chen po spu tra'i mgul bde chen gling gi pho brang chen por bsgyur ba/ dpal nag po chen po yum can gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta shrī ba na ratna'i zhal snga nas dang chos 'khor lo tsā ba 'jam dpal ye shes kyi 'gyur/ dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta a bha yā ka ra dang*/ lo tsā ba rtsa mi chen po'i 'gyur/ dpal mgon po'i nang bya rog gdong can zer/ sgrub paṇḍi ta a bha yā ka ra dang*/ lo tsā ba rtsa mi chen po'i 'gyur/ dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po sha ba ri pas mdzad pa/ dpal nag po chen po'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bram ze mchog sred zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta nag po ro 'dzin dang*/ lo tsā ba gyi ljang dbu dkar ba'i 'gyur/ dpal mgon po nag po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ma ti kīrti dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong pradzñā kīrti'i 'gyur/ dpal mgon po'i gtor chog dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba 'brom ston gyi 'gyur/ dpal lha mo nag mo'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga slob dpon lo ka shrī'i 'gyur/ lha mo re ma ti dmag zor gyi man ngag ā tsārya dmar po zhabs kyis mdzad pa/

dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma'i rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga dud sol ma'i sgrub thabs/ gtor ma'i cho ga rnams paṇḍi ta nags kyi rin chen gyi zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid kyi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i btsun pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde'i 'gyur/ dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ yang nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ dpal nag po chen po'i bstod pa rkang pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba rnams slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ dpal nag po chen po la bstod pa slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ dpal nag po chen po'i bstod pa slob dpon chen po a wa dhū tī pas mdzad pa/ rje btsun dpal nag po chen po la bstod pa dang*/ bya rog ming can dang bya rog gdong can la bstod pa rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags pas mdzad pa/ se lo tsā bas bod skad du bsgyur ba 'di la thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston gyis/ 'di gnyis rtsom mkhan bod kyis brtsams pa yin kyang saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du brtsams shing*/ bod skad du bsgyur ba yin pas sngar gyi rnams kyis bris 'dug pas bris zhes gsung ngo*// lha mo nag mo la bstod pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ dpal nag po chen po'i bstod pa rkang pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba dang*/ yang dpal nag po chen po la bstod pa rkang pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī bai ro tsa na badzra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba ding ri chos grags kyi 'gyur/ dpal lha mo nag mo'i sgrub thabs mkhas pa chen po nā ro pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ skad gnyis smra ba'i slob dpon lo ka shrī'i 'gyur/ gtum chen drag po'i mngon par rtogs pa paṇḍi ta bde ba chen po'i rdo rjes bsgrigs pa/ lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu dpal gyi 'gyur/ mi g.yo ba'i mngon par rtogs pa rab tu dga' bar mngon par brjod pa slob dpon dpal nags kyi rin chen gyis mdzad pa/

lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// sgrol ma bla med skor la drug cu gsum// ma rgyud spyi 'brel drug dang pad dra'i gnyis// mgon po'i chos skor sum cu mi g.yo'i gnyis// dril bas chos skor brgya dang rtsa gsum bzhugs// de dag gis ni sgrol ma la sogs pa'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar sgrol ma la sogs pa'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ rnal 'byor chen po thabs kyi rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor la/ dang por mgon po klu sgrub kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i 'phags skor la/ sa pa la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa zhes bya ba rdo rje theg pa chen po pa slob dpon chen po dpal klu sgrub kyis mdzad zer ba'i le'u bcu bdun pa yan chad rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī tā ra ka la sha'i sras paṇḍi ta ku mā ra ka la sha'i dbon po mant+ra ka la sha zhes bya ba nyid kyi rang 'gyur/ le'u bco brgyad pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa rdo rje theg pa chen po pa dpal klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po dpal gzhon nu bum pa'i rang 'gyur bzhugs so// 'grel pa 'di slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad ma mdzad rtsod pa can du 'dug na'ang*/ bod ma ma yin par 'dug cing mtshan bzang por g.yar 'dug pa'i don la dbu ru bzhugs su bcug pa yin zhes gsungs so// //ha pa la/ sgron ma gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i rgya cher bshad pa slob dpon chen po nā gārdzu na'i man ngag la brten te slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur la/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī dzñā nā ka ra bas bshad nas/ bod kyi zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur ba la/ yang slad kyis rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta nag po'i zhal snga nas bshad cing*/

bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis yul dbus kyi dpe dang gtugs te bcos pa/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ gsang ba thams cad kyi sgron ma'i rgya cher 'grel pa gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma paṇḍi ta snyan grags bzang pos mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta smṛ te dzñā na kīrti'i rang 'gyur/ 'di la the tshom gyi gzhi cig snang ngo*// //a pa la/ rdo rje bzlas pa'i rgya cher bshad pa zhes bya ba dang*/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las 'byung ba'i rgyan bdun rnam par dgrol ba dang gnyis ka slob dpon chen po shraddhā ka ra warma'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ sgron ma gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel slob dpon thugs rje dpal gyi zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ gzhung gi tshad ni tshigs su bcad pa'i rnam grangs stong phrag gsum la brgya phrag lngas lhag ma yod pa/ skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang phyug dge slong rin chen grub kyis zhwa lu ri phug dga' ldan gyi dben gnas su bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ sgron ma gsal ba mdor bshad pa'i sa bcad snying gi me long zhes bya ba dpal lakṣ+mī ka ra'i zhal snga nas kyi slob ma paṇḍi ta mkhas pa ku mā ras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta gzhon nu bum pa dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/ sgron ma gsal bar byed pa'i dka' ba btus pa'i 'grel pa zhes bya ba slob dpon legs ldan byed kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po rgyal ba mchog dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya brtson 'grus kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //ki khi gnyis la/ sgron ma gsal bar byed pa'i dgongs pa rab gsal zhes bya ba bshad pa'i ṭī ka slob dpon chen po bha dra kīrtis zhal snga nas mdzad pa/

gzhung gi tshad shlau ka stong phrag bcu drug pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po paṇḍi ta ku mā ra'i rang 'gyur/ sgron ma gsal ba zhes bya ba'i le'u dang po'i 'grel bshad slob dpon ārya de was mdzad zer ba 'di bod ma 'dra bar 'dug na'ang sngar gyi rnams kyis bris 'dug pas bris so// //gi pa la/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal rdo rje phreng ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa zab mo'i don gyi 'grel pa zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta a laṃ ka ka la shas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ steng pa lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'i le'u bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa'i phyed par du 'grel pa ji tsam rnyed pa bzhugs so// 'di'i 'phro da rung yang btsal bar bya'o// de ltar rgyud 'grel gyi skor rnams bkod nas/ da ni sgrub thabs dkyil chog man ngag la sogs pa'i skor la/ ngi pa la/ sgrub pa'i thabs mdor byas pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa'i thabs mdo dang bsre ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad zer ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su bhā ṣi ta dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dbang bzhi pa'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon nā gārdzu nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shānti garbha dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ byang chub sems kyi 'grel pa tshigs bcad ma zhes bya ba slob dpon bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po gu ṇa ā ka ra dang*/

lo tsā ba rab zhi bshes gnyen gyi 'gyur la/ slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka na ka warma dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis bcos pa/ byang chub sems kyi 'grel pa lhug pa ma slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta dza ya ā nanda dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba khu mdo sde 'bar gyi 'gyur/ rim pa lnga pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur la/ slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gupta dang*/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos yul dbus kyi dpe dang yang gtugs te bcos pa/ spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma slob dpon chen po ārya de was mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ shlau ka stong sum brgya pa'o// sems la dmigs pa'i rim pa'i don 'grel sems kyi sgrib pa rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon chen po ārya de bas mdzad pa/ ā tsārya dzñā nā ka ra dang*/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ sgyu lus kyi don 'grel bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba rnam par dbye ba/ 'od gsal gyi don 'grel mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ ro bsreg pa'i cho ga rnams slob dpon 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim mthar phyin pa slob dpon ārya de was mdzad zer ba/ 'dus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs rnam par gzhag pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba grub pa'i slob dpon klu'i blos zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nyi shu pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po paṇḍi ta ti la ka ka la sha dang*/

bod kyi sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po bande pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis bsgyur ba/ las kyi mtha' rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba rje btsun 'phags pa klu'i blo'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bla ma rje btsun ma ṇi ka shrī dzñā na dang*/ rje btsun chen po re wend+ra'i zhal snga nas gus par mnyan te chag lo tsā ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ rim pa lnga'i khongs su bsdu ba'i man ngag ces bya ba'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon chen po klu'i blo rig pa 'dzin pa'i dngos grub brnyes nas da dung dpal gyi ri la bzhugs pa'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten dpal tshangs pa 'byung ba'i gtsug lag khang du rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā laṅka ka la sha dang*/ bod kyi sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ rim pa lnga'i don mdor bshad pa rnal 'byor pa'i yid 'phrog ces bya ba ma ga dhā'i paṇḍi ta thub pa dpal bzang pos mdzad pa/ dpyal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang pos bsnams pa'i rgya dpe las lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen grub kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ gzhung tshad ni rkang pa dang bcas pa'i brgya phrag gnyis pa dpal bi kra ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang chen por paṇḍi ta mkhas pa chen po ta thā ga ta rakṣi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba klog skya gzhon nu dpal gyi 'gyur la/ slad kyis dpal tho ling dpe med lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas pa chen po dī paṃ kā ra rakṣi ta dang*/ khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bcos pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa li lā badzra'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ bi bhū ti tsand+ra'i rgya dpe la bltas nas lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen grub kyis legs par bsgyur cing dag par byas pa/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dpal ldan zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/

slob dpon shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa zhes bya ba slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad zer ba 'di ni the tshom gyi gzhi cig snang ngo*// zung du 'jug pa gsal ba zhes bya ba dbang gi bya ba shlau ka phyed dang brgyad brgya pa dkyil 'khor chen po'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i mkhas pa chen po sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ mkhas pa chen po bsod snyoms pa shākya shrī bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'di la shlau ka phyed dang brgyad brgya'o// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon nag po pa'i zhal snga nas bla ma'i man ngag la brten te mdzad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod pa'i cho ga gtor ma'i cho ga rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'i rim pa rnams slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa/ de nyid dang*/ 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i lam gyi rim pa man ngag bdud rtsi gsang ba slob dpon chen po sgra dbyangs bcu gcig pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga zhes pa za hor gyi mkhan po shānta de wa/ zhes bya ba mngon shes lnga dang ldan pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba 'gos kyi 'gyur/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga dpal ldan rab 'jigs rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur ba rnams bzhugs so// 'di la shlau ka brgya brgyad cu rtsa gsum mo// //ci pa la/ da ni sgrub skor de dag gi 'grel pa'i skor ni/ mdor bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa rin chen phreng ba zhes bya slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po karma badzra'i rang 'gyur/ sgrub pa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po dpal dzñā na badzra zhes bya ba gsang 'dus rim pa gsum gyi man ngag dang ldan pa bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa'i zhabs kyi ze'u 'bru spyi bos len pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dge bsnyen btsun pa ku mā ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba lha btsun pa'i 'gyur/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i sku la bstod pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi gnas rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ byang chub sems kyi 'grel pa'i rnam par bshad pa smṛ ti dzñā na kīrtis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po smṛ ti dzñā na kīrti de nyid kyi 'gyur/ rim pa lnga'i dka' 'grel don gsal ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po brtson 'grus bzang po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta bīrya bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'bro dge bsnyen chen po shes rab brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur/ rim pa lnga pa'i dgongs 'grel zla ba'i 'od zer zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ shar phyogs dza ga ta la'i paṇḍi ta bi bhū ti tsand+ra'i 'gyur/ sgrub thabs mdor byas kyi dka' 'grel paṇḍi ta bi bhū ti tsand+ras mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen grub kyis dbo'i lo mgo'i zla ba'i tshes bcu dgu la rgya dpe la gzigs nas dpal ri phug gi dben gnas su bsgyur ba/ rim pa lnga'i don gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa zhes zer ba 'di rdzun ma yin par 'dug na'ang sngar gyi rnams kyis bris 'dug pa ltar bris so// spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i rgya cher bshad pa shes rab mchog dang ldan pa'i slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/

rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi bshad pa slob dpon ta thā ga ta rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ tho lding dpe med lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas pa chen po dī paṃ ka ra rakṣi ta dang*/ khams pa ba ri lo tsā ba'i 'gyur/ bsdus pa'i rim pa'i dka' 'grel slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bal po'i dge bsnyen su'o dī ta dang*/ lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dad pa smra ba zhes bya ba'i bstod pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā shrī gupta dang*/ sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba bande rin chen bzang po'i bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //chi pa la/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rim pa lnga'i dka' 'grel zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po bha bya kīrtis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po rgyal ba mchog dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur/ rim pa lnga'i bshad pa li la badzra zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong dar ma blo gros kyi 'gyur/ rim lnga'i bshad pa nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad zer ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po rdo rje slob dpon chen po karma badzra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ 'di slob dpon klu byang gis mdzad ma mdzad the tshom za bar 'dug kyang rgya gar gyi paṇḍi tas mdzad par 'dug pas bris so// rim lnga'i dka' 'grel slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛṣṇa paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ rim pa lnga'i 'grel ba'i don gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba kha che'i mkhas pa chen po lakṣ+mīs zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa tā ra ka la sha'i sras mant+ra ka la sha nyid kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// de ltar 'phags skor la 'grel pa bcu gnyis dang*/

sgrub thabs la sogs kyi skor la bzhi bcu rtsa bdun te chos skor lnga bcu nga dgu'o// //ji pa la/ slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi skor gyi 'grel pa la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'grel pa man ngag gtan la dbab pa zhes bya ba le'u bco brgyad pa'i phyed kyi rtsa ba'i rgyud rdzogs pa'i 'grel pa slob ma la phan pa zhes kyang bya ba slob dpon rab tu zhi ba'i ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ 'di slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyi dngos slob tshe 'di nyid la mya ngan las 'da' ba'i gang zag bzhi'i ya gyal rab tu zhi ba'i bshes gnyen dang gcig mi gcig dpyad byar lus so// gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi man ngag gi rgya mtsho thigs pa zhes pa le'u bco brgyad pa'i phyed kyi rtsa ba'i rgyud rdzogs pa man chad kyi 'grel pa slob dpon bi shwa na mi tras mdzad pa/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon tha ga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// //nyi pa la/ rin po che'i ljon shing zhes bya ba gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon chen po tsi lu pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gupta dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba chen po mnga' bdag lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel zhes bya ba rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa slob dpon rgyal bas byin gyis mdzad pa dang*/ rgyud phyi ma le'u bco brgyad pa dang bcas pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon sman pa'i bu rgyal bas byin gyis mdzad pa gnyis/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po zhi ba bzang po dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab ye shes kyi 'gyur la/ slad kyis lha sa 'phrul snang du paṇḍi ta ting 'dzin rdo rjes yang zhu chen bgyis/ yang slad kyis paṇḍi ta shrī su n+yā ya mi tra dang*/

lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyis bcos pa rnams bzhugs so// //ti pa la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba le'u bco brgyad pa'i rnam par bshad pa dkyil 'khor chen po'i slob dpon byang phyogs kyi lam la mkhas pa chen po slob dpon zla ba'i 'od dang*/ ming gzhan rin chen rdo rje myu gus mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po su n+yā shrī mi tra dang*/ bod kyi sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dar ma grags kyis mang yul grong gi lha khang ka ru dang ag tsar sgang du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ yang dag rig byed ces bya ba rgyud phyi ma'i rnam par bshad pa slob dpon birya pā das mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la guhya dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mnga' bdag lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad sbyar snyim pa'i me tog ces bya ba le'u bcu gsum pa yan slob dpon chen po ratna a kar shāntis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// //thi pa la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad sbyar snyim pa'i me tog gi le'u bcu bzhi pa man chad slob dpon chen po ratna ā kar shāntis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po shānta bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ 'di ye shes zhabs kyi rjes 'brang bya ba'i dmigs bsal mi 'dug na'ang*/ lha'i bskyed chog la sogs ye shes zhabs lugs dang mthun par byung zhing*/ sngar gyi mkhas pa dag gis kyang ye shes zhabs lugs kyi phyogs su bris 'dug pas 'dir yang de ltar bris so// gsang ba 'dus pa rgyud kyi rgyal po'i bshad pa zla ba'i 'od zer ces bya ba le'u bcu bdun pa'i rnam par bshad pa slob dpon rab tu dga' ba'i 'byung gnas go chas mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// //de ltar rgyud so so'i 'grel pa rnams bkod nas/ spyi'i man ngag la sogs pa'i sgrub skor la/ di pa la/ rim pa gnyis pa'i de kho na nyid bsgom pa zhes bya ba'i zhal gyi lung 'jam dpal zhal lung chen mor grags pa dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon chen po lha sangs rgyas dpal ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la guhya dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po mnga' bdag lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ zhal gyi lung chung ba dpal ldan o rgyan yul nas byung ba'i sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi sgrub thabs kyi man ngag lo tsā ba dge slong khyung wer rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs byang chub sems dpa' 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs kyi ze'u 'bru'i rdul la reg pa slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta shraddhā ka ra warma dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ yan lag bzhi'i sgrub thabs kun tu bzang mo zhes bya ba dkyil 'khor chen po'i slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po smṛ ti dzñā na kīrti'i rang 'gyur/ dpal he ru ka'i sgrub thabs slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dpal he ru ka sgrub pa'i thabs kyi 'grel pa/ 'di gsum la sgrub pa'i thabs kun tu bzang mo gsum zhes zer ro// grol ba'i thig le dkyil 'khor chen po'i rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la guhya dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po mnga' bdag lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ bdag sgrub pa la 'jug pa slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta shānti bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ rje btsun 'phags pa gnod 'dzin chu dbang gi sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon mi bskyod rdo rje sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shraddhā ka ra bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ gsang ba'i dzambha la'i sgrub thabs dang*/ rgya che ba'i dzambha la'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dza ya se na dang*/

btsun pa dar ma yon tan gyi 'gyur/ sbyin sreg gnyis kyi cho ga dang*/ gtor chog mi nub pa'i sgron ma dang*/ tshogs 'khor gyi 'khor lo sna tshogs 'khor lo dang*/ rin chen 'bar ba dang*/ rtsa ba'i ye shes chen po dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa'i mdzod dang*/ byang chub sems kyi thig le dang*/ bkra shis kyi rnam bshad chen po dang*/ rgyud kyi rnam bshad dang*/ dkyil 'khor cho ga nyis brgya lnga bcu pa rnams la lung dang mthun pa'i chos bcu bzhi zhes bshad pa la/ rgyud kyi rnam bshad ni ma mdzad/ dkyil chog ni kha cher khyer nas rgya gar na med par bshad/ gzhan rnams la gong du smos pa rnams ma gtogs pa bod du 'gyur ba mi snang ngo*// stang stabs kyi bkod pa slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa sangs rgyas ye shes kyi dngos slob tshe 'di nyid la mya ngan las 'da' ba bzhi'i ya gyal slob dpon mar me mdzad bzang po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po padmā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur rnams so// da ni de dag gi rjes su 'brang ba'i 'grel pa'i skor la/ mdzes pa'i me tog ces bya ba rim pa gnyis pa'i de kho na nyid bsgom pa zhal gyi lung gi 'grel pa/ slob dpon chen po bi ta pā das mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la guhya dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po mnga' bdag lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ kun tu bzang po'i sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa byang phyogs kyi dge slong yon tan 'byung gnas bzang po'i slob ma shrī pha la badzras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bīrya bha dra dang*/ bi bhā ka ra dang*/ sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi 'grel pa slob dpon mkhas pa chen po tha ga nas mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //ni pa la/ yan lag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rgya cher bshad pa snying po'i snye ma zhes bya ba slob dpon dpal kun tu bzang pos mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po n+ya yan shrī dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis bal yul mthil du 'gyur/ grol ba'i thig le zhes bya ba'i rnam par bshad pa slob dpon chen po bi ta pā das mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la guhya dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba chen po mnga' bdag lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dpal gsang ba 'dus

bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa yang zer/ pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i 'grel pa slob dpon chen po rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bīrya bha dra dang*/ sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba rnams so// da ni de dag gi rjes su 'brang ba'i sgrub thabs dkyil chog la sogs pa'i skor la/ yan lag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kun tu bzang mo zhes bya ba'i rnam par bshad pa dang*/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs rnam par bshad pa slob dpon chen po bi ta pā das mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la guhya dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba mnga' bdag ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //pi pa la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i gter zhes bya ba/ sbyor ba bdun pa zhes bya ba dbang bzhi'i rab tu byed pa/ gtor ma chen po'i cho ga mi shigs pa'i rin po che zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ bdag gi don grub par byed pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi bya ba'i rim pa rnams slob dpon chen po bi ta pā das mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la guhya dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po mnga' bdag lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi snang ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba dpal rnam par snang mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bla ma chen po paṇḍi ta puṇya shrī dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong g.yung drung 'od kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal kun tu bzang pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ga ta kīrtis bsgyur nas gtan la phab pa/ kun tu ma byung bzang po'i bsdus don slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/

dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dga' ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po rgyal bas byin gyis mdzad pa dang*/ ye shes zhabs kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dpal mi bskyod rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon dpal rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po padmā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'di la smṛ ti'i rang 'gyur cig kyang yod mod kyi/ don gcig cing 'gyur 'di bzang bas bris so// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtogs sla zhing mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs dpal mkhas pa chen po puṇyā shrī mi tras mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba klog skya gzhon nu 'bar gyi 'gyur/ dbang gi rab tu byed pa slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal dga' ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ gzhung tshad ni tshigs bcad sum brgya/ bam po gcig pa/ tho ling gi gtsug lag khang du rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong ba ri'i 'gyur/ 'dus pa'i dbang bskur ba mdor bsdus pa paṇḍi ta ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa/ bal po'i paṇḍi ta su ma ti kīrti dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba klog skya gzhon nu 'bar dang*/ mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ yan lag bdun pa shlau ka bzhi brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ de kho na nyid rin po che snang ba/ de kho na nyid rin po che snang ba'i rnam par bshad pa rnams slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis rgya gar shar phyogs kyi dpe las zhu gtugs byas pa/ 'di gsum gsang 'dus kyi chos skor yin yang ye shes zhabs lugs kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i gsal kha mi snang ste/

sngar gyi rnams kyis ye shes zhabs lugs kyi skor du bris 'dug pas bris so// rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon dpe med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bīrya bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ gsang 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor la spyan ras gzigs gtso bor ston pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bstod pa rnams slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ de kho na nyid bcu pa slob dpon rgyan pas mdzad pa/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga slob dpon zla ba'i 'od kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po puṇya kīrti dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ brtan pa'i nor thams cad pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs paṇḍi ta chen po ratna kīrtis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba la chings yon tan 'bar gyi 'gyur/ khro bo bcu'i gtor ma'i cho ga dbang gtan la dbab pa slob dpon mkhas pa chen po bsod snyoms pa dge slong 'od srung gzhon nus mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ta thā ga ta rakṣi ta dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi lugs/ paṇḍi ta smṛ tis mdzad cing*/ de nyid kyi rang 'gyur/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba ye shes zhabs kyi lugs 'di gnyis 'grel pa chen po nas sbyor drug la mos pa zhig gis logs su phyung ba yin par 'dug pas logs su ma bris kyang btub mod kyi/ sngar gyi rnams kyis kyang bris 'dug cing don bzang bas bris so// 'jam pa'i rdo rje mchod pa'i cho ga slob dpon dpal sbyin gyis mdzad pa/

lo tsā ba dge slong blo gros seng ges zhus chen byas nas paṇḍi ta chen po bi bhū ti tsand+ras rang 'gyur du mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// //phi pa la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud la brten pa'i arga'i cho ga snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba dang*/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ye shes snang ba zhes bya ba slob dpon snang byed zla bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal paṇḍi ta wa rend+ra pa dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong pradzñā kīrti'i 'gyur/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba'i paṇḍi ta mi 'jigs pa'i phyag gis mdzad pa/ rgya che ba'i tshig bsdus pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga slob dpon dpal kā tsa zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ zha lu lo tsā ba dharmā pā la bha dras dben gnas dpal e waṃ chos 'khor du bsgyur ba/ dpal ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud las phyung ba spyan ma'i ngan song sbyong ba'i cho ga dpal stong nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a wa dhū tī bai ro tsa na badzra'i zhal snga nas dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba khams pa ldi ri chos kyi grags pas bsgyur ba/ dus tha ma'i mchod pa'i cho ga ming gzhan gshin po bde bar gshegs pa'i gnas la 'god pa zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta dpal ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal phyogs dbang dga' byed dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong pradzñā kīrti'i 'gyur ba rnams so// de ltar ye shes zhabs lugs kyi 'grel pa'i skor bcu/ sgrub thabs rab gnas la sogs kyi chos skor lnga bcu rtsa bdun te/ chos skor drug cu rtsa bdun no// //de ltar ye shes zhabs lugs kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams bkod nas/ da ni slob dpon rdo rje bzhad pa la sogs pa'i bzhed pa'i lugs kyi gsang 'dus kyi skor ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rnam par bshad pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po rdo rje bzhad pas mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na garbha dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba bai ro tsā na'i 'gyur/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi gleng gzhi bla ma'i man ngag gi bshad pa dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dpal bde ba chen po'i sgrub thabs rdo rje bzhad pas mdzad pa/ dpal bde ba chen po sgrub pa'i thabs rnam par bshad pa slob dpon chen po bi ma la garbhas mdzad pa rnams te/ 'di dag sngar gyi rnams kyis ye shes zhabs lugs kyi gseb tu bris mod kyi/ 'di dag ye shes zhabs lugs kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i gsal kha med cing*/ lha bskyed chog la sogs kyang 'phags skor dang cha mthun par 'dug cing*/ ye shes zhabs lugs dang mi mthun pas lugs gud du byas so// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rdo rje sgeg pas mdzad pa/ kha che'i rigs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po buddha shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ de ltar rdo rje bzhad pa lugs kyi chos skor lnga'o// rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'grel pa rtsa ba'i rgyud dang rgyud phyi ma gnyis bla ma'i man ngag las bris pa zhes bya ba dang*/ lha mo bzhis yongs su zhus pa'i rnam par bshad pa man ngag rgyas pa zhes bya ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po rdo rje slob dpon smṛ ti dzñā na kīrtis mdzad cing*/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po smṛ ti dzñā na kīrti nyid kyi rang 'gyur/ lha mo bzhis yongs su zhus pa'i rnam par bshad pa slob dpon ye shes snying pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dran pa ye shes grags pas bsgyur ba rnams te 'di dag kyang sngar gyi rnams kyi ye shes zhabs lugs kyi skabs su gtogs par bshad mod kyi/ ye shes zhabs kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i gsal kha med cing*/ bzang po zhabs kyi rjes su 'brang bar smṛ tis gsal bar gsungs pas 'di dag kyang lugs tha dad yin no// de ltar bzang po zhabs dang smṛ ti'i chos skor gsum mo//

//bi pa la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dka' 'grel slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi dza ya shrī dha ra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur la/ slad nas ā tsārya shraddhā ka ra warmas zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'di 'grel pa mkhan pos rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du bkral nas snang na yang rgyud kyi ngo bo rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud yin pas skabs 'dir bris so zhes pa rnams kun mkhyen pas gsungs so// de ltar slob dpon kun dga' snying po'i lugs kyi chos skor gcig go /gsang 'dus 'phags skor ye shes zhabs lugs dang*// rdo rje bzhad pa bzang po'i zhabs dang ni// smṛ ti kun dga' snying po la sogs pa'i// chos skor brgya dang sum cu rtsa lnga bzhugs// de dag gis ni gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud dang 'brel pa'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ da ni de'i cha dang mthun pa'i rgyud gshin rje gshed kyi skor la/ gshin rje gshed dgra nag gi rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa'i 'grel pa dpal gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud kyi dka' 'grel lhan cig skyes pa'i snang ba zhes bya ba slob dpon shrī dha ras mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po shānti bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ dpal gshin rje dgra nag po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i dka' 'grel rin po che'i sgron ma zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas pa chen po ratna ka ra shānti pas mdzad pa/ ā tsārya bi na ya tsand+ra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis dad pas bsgyur/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po mngon par mthong ba'i lam gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i rgya cher bshad pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po kṛṣṇa pa chen pos mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor pa bsod snyoms pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na kīrti'i rang 'gyur/
