gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba shar phyogs bhaṃ ga la ra bi kra ma pu ri'i gtsug lag khang du sku 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa chen po a wa dhū tī pa gzhon nu zla bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po lī la badzra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dpyal se rtsa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ gshin rje dgra nag po'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel ye shes sgron ma zhes bya ba slob dpon padma pā ṇis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon ba ra me shwa ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rong zom chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //mi pa la/ gshin rje nag po'i sgrub thabs tshig gi snang ba grub pa zhes bya ba dang*/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon mkhas pa dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na kīrti dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta su ma ti kīrti dang*/ lo tsā ba mar do chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed dgra nag gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gshin rje gshed 'byung ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po la li ta badzras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a mo gha badzra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba cog gru shes rab bla ma'i 'gyur/ mchod rten sgrub pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po la li ta badzras mdzad pa dang*/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i sgrub pa'i thabs dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa dang*/ gshin rje gshed nag po zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon nyin mor byed pa'i grags pas mdzad pa/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis rgya gar gyi phyi mo dang gtugs te gtan la phab pa/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon gho ṣa badzras mdzad pa/ bal po'i mkhan po su ma ti tsand+ra dang*/

bod kyi lo tsā ba bande tshogs chag chung ba'i 'gyur dpal gshin rje gshed dgra nag po'i sgrub thabs 'khor lo'i don rgyas par bshad pa dang bcas pa slob dpon mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya bi nā ya tsand+ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i sgrub pa'i thabs bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa las btus pa dge slong bsod snyoms pa ka ma la rakṣi ta zhes bya bas bsdus pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga slob dpon chen po dpal rnyog med rdo rje'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a du la da sa dang*/ lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga zhes bya ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la rakṣi tas gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa la brten nas mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba shrī pradzñā dzñā na kīrti'i rang 'gyur/ gshin rje'i dgra nag po'i sgrub thabs ku mu ta kha bye ba zhes bya ba slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ ā tsārya bi nā ya tsand+ra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dpal gshin rje gshed nag po sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed nag po dus mthar phyin pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī paṇḍi tas mdzad pa/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ gshin rje gshed rnam par snang mdzad kyi mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba/ gshin rje gshed rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'od dpag tu med pa'i snying po 'dod chags gshin rje gshed sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ gshin rje gshed rdo rje rnon po zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/

rdo rje sems ma bde ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ rdo rje bde rgyas dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ las kyi rdo rje gau rī ma'i sgrub thabs rnams slob dpon mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa dang*/ rje btsun 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po kṛṣṇa paṇḍi tas mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba nā da ku be ra las byung ba'i don kun da na kṣe ri na bzhugs pa'i mkhas pa chen po rnal 'byor pa nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po ka ma la rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ khro bo tho ba gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dbyug pa gshin rje gshed rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ ral gri gshin rje gshed gtum po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ padma gshin rje gshed kyi shes rab bde ba can gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba rnams rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra zhes bya bas mdzad pa/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi maṇḍal gyi cho ga zhes bya ba zangs gling nā ga pū ri'i rnal 'byor pa ka ma la rakṣi tas ta ru ba ri'i dur khrod kyi tshal du mdzad pa/ chos kyi sku'i snang ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba mchod rten gyi cho ga rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka lā pa ma hā zhes bya bas mdzad pa/ gshin rje gshed kyi ro sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba bla ma nag po zhabs kyis dpal rdo rje gdan du mdzad pa/ de rnams rnal 'byor pa bsod snyoms pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na kīrtis rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/ yi dwags thams cad rdo rjes bcings pa slob dpon chen po dpal nag po pas mdzad pa/

gshin rje gshed nag po'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas pa chen po rdo rje'i blos mdzad pa/ dpal gshin rje gshed nag po'i 'khor lo bri ba'i cho ga gshin rje dgra nag po zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon kun tu bzang pos mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje'i 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon la li ta badzras mdzad pa/ 'o ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon ā tsārya dzi mu dra pā das mdzad pa/ ā tsārya badzra pā ṇi dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i 'khor lo'i man ngag slob dpon nā ga bo dhis mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos rab kyi 'gyur/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga slob dpon chen po la lī ta badzras mdzad pa/ 'chi bdag yi dwags rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje gshed kyi lag mchod dā na shī las mdzad cing*/ de nyid kyis bsgyur ba 'di gshed dmar gyi skor yin te 'brel 'dug pas der bzhag go /gshin rje gshed nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa zhes bya ba ā tsārya kīrtis mdzad pa dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pas gshin rje gshed po la bstod pa gcig go /de ltar gshin rje gshed nag po'i 'grel skor lnga dang*/ sgrub skor la sogs bzhi bcu rtsa dgu ste/ chos skor lnga bcu nga bzhi'o// //rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi skor la/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi dka' 'grel rdo rje slob dpon mi bskyod pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi nā ya tsand+ra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi mdor bshad pa zhes bya ba slob dpon so na shrīs mdzad pa/

mkhas pa chen po ta thā ga ta'i zhal nas brgyud pa zhes yod pa/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi mdo mdor bshad pa zhes bya ba slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i slob dpon dpal chen po rdo rje grub pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi dka' 'grel slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal gzhon nu zla bas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta mkhas pa chen po ta thā ga ta rakṣi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong ba ri rin chen grags kyis 'gyur/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud kyi 'grel pa rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po nag po pas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nyid las blangs nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po paṇḍi ta dpal bai ro tsa na rakṣi ta dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba glan dar ma blo gros kyi 'gyur/ ma he'i zhal gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba'i 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po rnam par snang mdzad srung ba dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong ba ri dharma kīrti'i 'gyur/ rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya ā nanda dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong rdo rje grags kyi 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs mdor bsdus pa slob dpon chen po shrī bha dras mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang*/ sgrub pa'i cho ga dang*/ las sbyor/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa las 'khor lo bskor ba'i las drag po phyogs gcig pa slob dpon zhi ba'i ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje'i rang 'gyur/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs slob dpon mañdzu shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ zhang 'or ston pa shes rab bsod nams kyi 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/

las bya ba'i cho ga sems dpa' bsdus pa ā tsārya don yod rdo rjes mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje nyid kyi rang 'gyur la/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po mañdzu shrī dzñā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rong zom chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur cing*/ slar yang phyug mtshams dbang phyug rgyal pos bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon chen po dpal don yod pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba rwa rdo rje grags kyi 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bsad pa'i 'khor lo la li tas mdzad pa/ dpal de kho na nyid grub pa slob dpon chen po ke ra lis mdzad pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dam tshig la 'jug pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po dpal la li ta badzras mdzad pa/ grub pa brnyes pa'i paṇḍi ta a mo gha badzra dang*/ lo tsā ba mar pa dge bsnyen chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje'i tshig rnal 'byor dbye ba zhes bya ba rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta a mo gha badzras mdzad pa/ rdo rje tsartsi ka'i las sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon chen po bram ze dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta rgyas sras bi bhū ti tsand+ra'i zhal snga nas glo bo lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab rin chen gyis chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang sku mkhar nyi gzungs su bsgyur ba/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon a shwa ka shrīs mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta dharma shrī mi tra dang*/ lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ rdo rje dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rnams grub thob 'khor los sgyur ba'i slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta rgyal sras dpal bi bhū ti tsand+ra dang*/ glo bo lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab rin chen gyis chos kyi rgyal po'i khab sku mkhar nyi gzungs su bsgyur ba/

las kyi gshin rje'i mchod pa'i cho ga rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta dārpan ā tsāryas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba zhe sdang rdo rjes dag par bsgyur ba/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon mañdzu badzras mdzad pa/ bal po'i paṇḍi ta bha ro phyag rdum dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba slob dpon ratna ā ka ra shāntis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra rakṣi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rdo rje grags kyi 'gyur/ tsutstshundha ra'i rtog pa bha ro phyag rdum gyi phyag dpe las rwa rdo rje grags kyis phyis bsgyur ba/ rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba a mo gha badzras mdzad pa/ rwa rdo rje grags kyi 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs slob dpon la li ta badzras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā shrī de ba dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba cog gru bande shes rab bla ma'i 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs dang*/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gtor ma'i cho ga slob dpon chen po la li ta badzras mdzad pa/ 'jigs byed kyi zhi ba'i bya ba bdun pa paṇḍi ta a mo gha chung bas mdzad pa/ drag po'i bya ba bdun pa de nyid kyis mdzad pa/ 'khor lo bri ba'i cho ga las kyi grogs kyi bya ba/ dam rdzas rmad du bsgyur te brten pa'i cho ga dang gsum po 'di kha cig rtog pa gsum pa'i rgyud du 'dod de/ kha cig man ngag tu 'dod de zhang lo tsā ba shes rab bla ma'i 'gyur/ gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi phyag mtshan gyi rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba mkhas pa chen po ta thā ga ta rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ u to bo pa ti dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mal gyo blo gros grags kyi 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dzñā na ka ras mdzad pa/

zla ba'i 'od zer gyi 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa/ de nyid lnga pa'i bstod pa/ yang 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa gcig dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rjes mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ zhang lo tsā ba shes rab bla ma'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal 'jigs byed mtshan gyi bstod pa/ slob dpon las kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs rdo rje'i 'od ces bya ba dang*/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gsal ba zhes bya ba rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta bai ro tsa na rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta bai ro tsa na de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// de ltar 'jigs byed kyi skor la 'grel skor lnga sgrub thabs la sogs bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis te/ chos skor bzhi bcu rtsa bdun no// //tsi pa la/ gdong drug gi skor la/ dpal gshin rje gshed po'i rtsa ba'i sngags rdo rje rab tu 'byed pa zhes bya ba slob dpon dpal sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ de la phan pa'i le'u gcig slob dpon rig pa bzang pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal u pā ya shrī mi tra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rong zom chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba/ gshin rje gshed nag po gdong drug pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon de wa ā ka ra tsand+ras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de wa ā ka ra tsand+ra de nyid dang*/ cog ro bande shes rab bla ma'i 'gyur/ u rgyan nas byung ba'i gshin rje'i dgra brub pa'i 'khor lo ji ltar rnyed pa slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa ste de ltar gdong drug gi chos skor la bzhi'o// //gshed dmar skor la/ gshin rje mthar byed dmar po'i sgrub thabs rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bi rū pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bla ma rje btsun chen po nyi ma'i dbang po'i 'od zer dang*/
chag lo tsā ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon shrī bi rū pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta dā na shī la'i rang 'gyur/ gtor ma'i

ma byung*/ cho ga gnyis dang*/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i byin rlabs kyi man ngag 'od gsal 'char ba'i rim pa slob dpon mthu stobs kyi mgon po dpal bi rū pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta re wend+ra dang*/ chag lo tsā ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ gshed dmar gyi rdzogs rim shin tu spros pa med pa de kho na nyid kyi man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon dpal mthu stobs kyi mgon po bcom ldan 'das kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bi rū pas mdzad pa/ chos kyi rgyal po'i sku mkhar nyi gzungs su rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta dngos grub brnyes pa dpal dārpan ā tsārya dang*/ glo bo lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab rin chen gyi 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga slob dpon birwa pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs dpal dpa' bo rgyal pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bla ma rje btsun nyi ma'i dbang po'i 'od zer dang*/ chag lo tsā ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi phreng ba slob dpon bi rū pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta dpal mkhas pa chen po dā na shī las yul dbus kyi grub pa thob pa'i gnas drang srong srin po rir rang 'gyur/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs dang*/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga paṇḍi ta rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta rje btsun chen po dpal gshin rje gshed kyis rjes su bzung ba nyi ma'i dbang po'i 'od zer dang*/ chag lo tsā ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i de kho na nyid ces bya ba rang byin gyis brlab pa'i man ngag grub thob kyi 'khor los sgyur ba mthu stobs la mnga' brnyes pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bram ze dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/

dārpan ā tsārya dang*/ glo bo lo tsā'i 'gyur/ gshed dmar ma byung*/ gyi yum bzhi so so'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ gshin rje gshed dmar po maṇḍal du mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba rnams grub thob dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ lha'i skad la legs par zhugs pa'i lo tsā ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos skad gnyis smra ba'i gdan sa dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur ba/ dpal gshin rje gshed nag po dang dmar po mchod pa'i cho ga slob dpon chen po paṇḍi ta dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta nyi ma'i dbang po'i 'od zer dang*/ chag chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi cho ga slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po dā na shī la'i rang 'gyur/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i gtor ma'i cho ga slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs dpal rnam par snang mdzad srung bas mdzad pa/ rang byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa'i man ngag dang bcas pa gshin rje mthar byed dmar po'i mngon par rtogs pa slob dpon chen po mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa blo gros bzang pos mdzad pa rnams paṇḍi ta chen po bla ma rje btsun nyi ma'i dbang po'i 'od zer dang*/ chag lo tsā ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur ba/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i 'khor lo'i gsal byed bsdus pa dang*/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i 'khor lo'i de kho na nyid kyi gsal byed slob dpon gnas brtan byang chub snying pos mdzad pa/ rdo rje gdan pa niṣka laṅka dang*/ dpyal lo tsā ba dpal chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ gshin rje'i dgra dmar po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po blo bzang snying po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ lha'i skad la legs par zhugs pa'i lo tsā ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos skad gnyis smra ba'i gdan sa dpal thar pa gling du legs par bsgyur ba/

gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba mkhas pa chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i 'tsho ba'i de kho na nyid ces bya ba'i man ngag rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta dārpan ā tsāryas mdzad pa dang*/ gshin rje gshed mthar byed dmar po'i byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa grub thob kyi 'khor los sgyur ba bram ze dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dārpan ā tsārya dang*/ glo bo lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab rin chen gyi 'gyur/ lha mo 'od 'dzin ma'i byin gyis brlab pa grub thob mkhas pa chen po dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de wa ā ka ra dang*/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos 'gyur la/ dus phyis rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta dārpan ā tsārya dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa zhe sdang rdo rje'i 'gyur/ snga 'gyur la 'di las tshan che tsam gda'o zhes bu ston gyis gsungs so// 'od 'dzin ma'i sgrub thabs ting nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes pa dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ sgyur byed kyi lo paṇa snga ma dang 'dra'o// rang gi sems gong du 'pho ba'i man ngag byin rlabs dang bcas pa slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta rgya gar mngon shes can dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos khugs pas bsgyur ba las/ dus phyis sa'i steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba dārpan ā tsārya dang*/ lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi 'gyur/ byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa dang*/ me'i lha mchod pa zhes bya ba dngos grub brnyes pa dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dārpan ā tsārya dang*/ dge slong shes rab rin chen gyis legs par bsgyur ba/ bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal bi rū pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dārpan ā tsārya dang*/ lo tsā ba zhe sdang rdo rjes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/

srung 'khor gyi byin rlabs dang phyir bzlog pa'i man ngag ces bya ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po'i zhal gdams rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dngos grub mchog brnyes pa slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a nu pa ma rakṣi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba dar ma yon tan gyi 'gyur la/ phyis chos kyi rgyal po'i sku mkhar gnyis su rgya gar shar phyogs kyi mkhan po chen po dārpan ā tsārya dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab rin chen gyi 'gyur/ 'di'i dpe bar skabs su rgya gar bal po thams cad du rgyun chad pa la/ phyis o rgyan du mkha' 'gro ma rgya mtsho'i gos can las rnal 'byor pa santa wa lantas zhus te byung ngo*// gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sngags btu ba zhes bya ba slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta dā na shī la dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba bsod nams seng ge'i 'gyur/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i las kyi phreng ba'i sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba la longs spyod can ma'i rtog pa/ rin chen phreng ba ma'i sgrub thabs/ klu mo zhal mtha' yas ma'i sgrub thabs/ klu mo nor skyong zhal ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ klu mo a phu zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ dga' bas tshim ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ gnod sbyin nā ḍa pho mo'i sgrub thabs/ gnod sbyin mo sa'i bdag mo bkra shis ma'i sgrub thabs/ gnod sbyin dga' byed kyi sgrub thabs/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po phur bus 'debs pa'i sgrub thabs/ rdeg par byed pa'i gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon gyi sgrub thabs/ dpal zla ba'i lha mo zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 'phrog ma rna cha 'dzin ma'i sgrub thabs/ yid 'phrog ma'i sgrub thabs/ legs par dga' ma'i sgrub thabs/ spyan yangs ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'dod chags dgas pa'i sgrub thabs/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ lhag par rgyal ba mi pham pa'i sgrub thabs/

gang ba bzang po'i sgrub thabs/ 'byung mo mdzes ma'i sgrub thabs/ dbang rgyal ma mdzes ma'i sgrub thabs/ dri med mdzes ma'i sgrub thabs/ sha za pi lū'i sgrub thabs/ sha za nor bu 'dzin pa'i sgrub thabs/ sha za nag po'i sgrub thabs/ sha za nag po snying po'i sgrub thabs/ sha za mo ha na ma na'i sgrub thabs/ a lu ka zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ a la gupta zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ bong bu'i gdong can ma'i sgrub thabs/ sha za a lu bi ni'i zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ utstshusma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ kṣu kṣu se ri kunda'i sgrub thabs/ sha za mo rna ba 'dzin ma'i sgrub thabs/ sha za mo kha nag mo'i sgrub thabs te/ de ltar sgrub thabs sum cu rtsa drug gshin rje gshed kyi yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi zhabs rdul la reg pa slob dpon shes rab skyong gis mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs bhaṃ ga la'i paṇḍi ta dā na shī la zhes bya bas gnas byin gyis brlabs pa drang srong srin po rir rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs lam gyi snying po zhes bya ba mkhas grub rnal 'byor chen po buddha dzñā na pā das u ga ya na 'bar ba'i phug tu badzra wā rā hī nyid las dngos su thob pa dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ sems dpa' gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag pa zhes bya ba rnams rdo rje phag mos dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ yul dbus kyi paṇḍi ta ā nanda bha dra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba se rtsa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis grong khyer ti ra ha ti'i lho phyogs rang byung gi mchod rten rnam par dag pa'i drung du yul dbus kyi dpe dang mthun par bsgyur zhing gtan la phab pa/ slar yang thar pa lo tsā ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis shrī nā lend+ra'i gtsug lag khang chen por bcos pa/

de ltar gshin rje gshed dmar la chos skor bdun cu don gnyis so// 'phags pa gshin rje tshe bdag nag po'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ gtor ma dang bcas pa dang*/ dpal gshin rje tshe bdag nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dran gsal dpal nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po nag po'i zhabs de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba gnyan dar gyi 'gyur rnams te/ de ltar tshe bdag la chos skor gsum mo// 'khrul 'khor mthar thug gshin rje gshed po'i rgyud// gshin rje gshed nag rdo rje 'jigs byed dang*/ gdong drug gshed dmar sogs dang tshe bdag bcas// chos skor brgya dang brgyad cu tham pa bzhugs// de dag gis ni gshin rje gshed dmar nag la sogs pa'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar gshin rje gshed dmar nag la sogs pa'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi lugs su bkral ba'i skor la/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon chen po tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta mngon shes can gyi phyag nas byung ba/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas dang shes rab brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa tshul gsum gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma 'di gnyis rgyud sde spyir bkral bar snang zhing the tshom gyi gzhi yod pa rnams bzhugs so// //tshi pa la/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa mtshan don gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad nas thugs kyi sras nyang ting nge 'dzin gyis zhus pa gnyags dzñā na'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa don gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad zer ba 'di ni the tshom gyi gzhi'o zhes gsungs so// mtshan yang dag par brjod pa nye bar bsdus pa'i rnam par rtog ge zhes bya ba mkhas pa chen po nges par sbyangs pa dpal gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po shrī badzra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpyal se rtsa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis gangs can pa'i skad du legs par bsgyur ba/ nor bu gling du sku 'khrungs pa'i dpal ldan byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa'i sngags don rnam par gzigs pa dang*/ de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i slob dpon chen po gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa'i nye bar bsdus pa'i rnam par rtog ge gnyis kyi don bsdus pa mtshan gyi sgron me zhes bya ba pradzñā gu rus mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal ldan gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' rin po che'i phyag rgya dri ma med pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa snying po mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'i sngags kyi spyod pa bcu pa/ rmi lam brtag pa/ sangs rgyas byang chub bsam gtan gyi dug sel bar byed pa'i mar me zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i yid 'jug pa'i bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ thig le grub pa/ thig le gcig pa zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i snying po grub pa zhes bya ba rnams rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal ldan gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor pa bsod snyoms pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na kīrti'i rang 'gyur/ slob dpon chen po mai tri pa'i gdams ngag nye bar bsdus pa dang*/ dpal mai tri pas mdzad pa'i 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zab cing rgya che ba zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa mkhas pa chen po dril bu pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po mañdzu shrī siddhi dang*/ dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs zhi ba 'od kyi rim pa zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal khro bo'i sgrub thabs rdo rje 'od kyi rim pa zhes bya ba/

dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dbang bzhi'i gdams pa/ rdo rje glu'i gdams ngag ces bya ba/ khrus kyi cho ga gtor ma'i cho ga bdun tshigs kyi cho ga ro bsreg pa'i cho ga sātstsha gdab pa'i rim pa/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga sbyin sreg gi cho ga thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi man ngag maṇḍal dbul ba'i man ngag ste bcu gsum po rnams ni bram ze sdom pa bzang pos mdzad cing*/ 'bro lo tsā ba dharmā bhi'i 'gyur/ 'di dag la the tshom za ba snang yang rgya gar mar byed kyin 'dug pas bris so zhes gsungs/ mtshan brjod rnal 'byor chen po bla med du// dgongs pa 'grel pa'i rgyud 'grel rnam pa lnga// sgrub thabs la sogs nyi shu rtsa brgyad de// dril bas chos skor sum cu rtsa gsum bzhugs// de dag gis ni 'jam dpal mtshan brjod bla med du bkral ba'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar 'jam dpal mtshan brjod rnal 'byor bla med du bkral ba'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ bde chen ral gcig gi skor la/ bde chen ral gcig ma byung*/ lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sgrub thabs/ dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba grub pa brnyes pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po a dzi ta mi tra guptas mdzad pa/ dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po mi pham sbas pas mdzad pa/ dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs mi pham sbas pa'i bshes gnyen nam/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa'i sgrub thabs rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po shrī badzra kīrtis mdzad pa/ dpal ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs 'khor gnod sbyin dang bcas pa mi tra dzo kis mdzad pa rnams shrī dza ga ta mi tra ā nanda dang*/ gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/

bsngo ba nor bu'i sgron ma zhes bya ba slob dpon mi pham zla bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta su bhā shānti dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ dpal bcom ldan 'das ral pa gcig pa la bstod pa kha che'i paṇḍi ta buddhā shrī bha dra dzñā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ de'i rdzogs rim ston pa'i man ngag rang gi sems ngal bso ba'i man ngag tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa lnga pa zhes bya ba jo bo spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug las dngos su gsan nas/ grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dza ga ta mi tra ā nanda dang*/ skad gnyis smra ba chen po byams pa'i dpal gyis yang dag par bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rtogs pa brjod pa sum cu pa/ dpal kharsa pā ṇi yab yum gyi sgrub thabs/ gnod sbyin spun gnyis kyi sgrub thabs rnams slob dpon a dzi ta mi tra dzo kis mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi tra ā nanda'i phrin las kyis lha'i rigs gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ 'di dag ma rgyud kyi phyogs su gtogs pa 'dra bar snang yang bla ma rnams kyis pha rgyud kyi phyogs su byas snang bas 'dir bris so// rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs kyi snang ba zhes bya ba rje btsun ma nyi mas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma dha ra dang*/ lo tsā ba yar lungs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba/ lnga bcu pa'i bshad pa kha che'i paṇḍi ta dri med dpal bzang pos mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba yar lungs pa shud ke grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ kul lo ka nā tha'i byin rlabs paṇḍi ta chen po bi ma la shrī'i zhal snga nas byung ba bzhin bris pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po'i rjes gnang gi cho ga kha che'i paṇḍi ta bi ma la shrīs mdzad pa/

paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ shong lo tsā ba blo brtan gyi 'gyur/ rigs kyi 'jig rten dbang phyug sgrub pa'i thabs bram ze bhriṅga ras mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yi ge bdun pa'i sgrub thabs mi tra dzo kis mdzad pa/ de nyid dang*/ gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ 'di rnams rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud du gsal bar gsungs shing*/ thabs shes rab kyi rgyud 'dir gtogs pa gsal bar ma gsungs kyang*/ thabs rgyud dang mthun pa gtso bor snang bas 'dir bkod do zhes bu ston gyis gsungs/ dpal thugs rje chen po'i dbang bskur ba'i man ngag gi rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba'am/ padma zab pa dang padma rgyal po gnyis kyi dbang chog sbyin sreg dpal dzā landha ras mdzad pa/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa'i phyag dpe las rgya gar phyag na'i zhal snga nas dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba pradzñā kīrti'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mos mdzad pa/ sba lcag ma'i gzhung la/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i rgya gzhung*/ rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rnams rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta zla ba bzang po dang*/ lo tsā ba glan dar ma tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po wa la tsand+ra bla ma dang*/ lo tsā ba glan dar ma tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sgrub thabs ye shes mkha' 'gro ma grub pa'i rgyal mos mdzad pa/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma grub pa'i rgyal mos byas pa yin zer ba rnal 'byor bla med du byas pa 'di rgya gzhung yin zer ba rnams so// spyan ras gzigs dbang rnal 'byor bla med du// gyur pa'i ral gcig 'jig rten mgon la sogs// tshe dpag med pa'i chos skor rnam brgyad de// bcu phrag gnyis la drug gis brgyan pa bzhugs// de dag gis ni bde chen ral gcig la sogs pa'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to//

//de ltar bde chen ral gcig gi chos skor rnams bkod nas/ phyag na rdo rje rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud du bkral ba la/ 'khor lo chen po'i skor ni/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can drag po gsum 'dul zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa bdud rtsi myu gu zhes bya ba dngos grub brnyes pa'i dza wa ri pas sa wa ri pa la man ngag tu zhus pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ de wa pūrṇa ma ti dang*/ lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs 'khor lo chen po zhes bya ba/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi gzungs kyi sgrub thabs bdud rtsi thigs pa zhes bya ba/ lag na rdo rje go sngon po can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba ste 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgrub thabs gsum dang*/ klu rigs bzhi'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon rnam par sbyong zhing sel ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ yi dwags dang grul bum dang sha za dang srul po rnams rnam par sbyong zhing sel ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba ste 'jig rten pa'i sgrub thabs gsum dang*/ dpal phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi gzungs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba rnams nam gru'i rigs las byung ba dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po bram ze'i btsun pa dza wa ri pas mdzad pa/ bla ma de wa pūrṇa ma ti dang*/ lo tsā ba she'u badzra de was bsgyur ba la/ slad kyis dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bla ma las shin tu legs par zhus te cung zad bcos pa/ rim pa drug pa zhes bya ba/ bsad pa bdud rtsis gso ba zhes bya ba/ bdud rtsi 'o ma'i mchod pa zhes bya ba/ klu khro bo bsad pa'i phrin las zhes bya ba/ klu rigs bzhi mnan pa'i cho ga phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/

phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi drag po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ mdze nad kyi mtshan nyid ces bya ba/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can 'khor lo chen po'i lha tshogs la bstod pa zhes bya ba rnams nam gru'i rigs las byung ba'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon dza wa ri pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de wa pūrṇa ma ti dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong mgar chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur te de ltar bco brgyad do// rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i srung ba zhes bya ba nam gru'i rigs las byung ba dngos grub brnyes pa dza wa ri'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de wa pūrṇa ma ti dang*/ lo tsā ba she'u badzra de wa'i 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud du bkral ba la/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gnod sbyin drag po chen po rdo rje me lce'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje'i sku dngos su sprul nus pa phyag na rdo rje zhes bya bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po mañdzu shrī dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon des

ma byung*/ mdzad pa'i me lce'i phreng ba'i sgrub thabs so// slob dpon bha wa pas mdzad pa'i skor la/ 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs che ba/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs chung ba/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga lung bstan sbyor ba'i man ngag rdo rje las kyi tshogs rim par phye ba rnams slob dpon bha wa pas mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba khu pa bīrya dang dge slong gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// //dzi pa la/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sbyor ka chen po'i cho ga phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi gtor ma'i cho ga tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor ka zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi sbyor ka rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi sbyor ka dbang gi sbyin sreg gi sbyor ka drag po'i las kyi sbyor ka bsdus pa'i las kyi sbyor ka phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga maṇḍal gyi sbyor ka rnams slob dpon bha wa pas mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ las kyi rim pa mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba slob dpon bha wa pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po rdo rje slob dpon bīrya gupta dang*/ slad kyis lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu tshul khrims kyis bsgyur te dur khrod nags tshal du brgyud pa'i slob dpon la shin tu gsang zhing legs par mnos pa/ phyag na rdo rje rdo rje lce dbab kyi 'grel pa mu tig phreng ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje lce dbab kyi gsang ba'i yang bkol gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba rgyal bu sprin gyi shugs can gyis mdzad pa/

slad kyis bla ma dza yā ka ra dang*/ lo tsā ba mar pa'i 'gyur/ 'dir lce dbab pa'i bya thabs/ rten 'brel gyi mthus bsrung ba gnyis mdzad 'gyur ma nges pa/ lag na rdo rje lce dbab kyi sngon 'gro'i lag len rnal 'byor gyi sbyor lam brgyad po slob dpon rgyal bu sprin gyi shugs can gyi mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta dza yā ka ra dang*/ mar pa lo tsā'i 'gyur/ gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po nag pos mdzad pa rnams so// gtum po lha lnga'i skor la/ rdo rje gtum po lha lnga pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga phyag na rdo rje'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa gnyis so// gtum po khyung gsham ma'i skor la/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can dang bya khyung gi sgrub thabs zhes nang sgrub yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ dpal phyag na rdo rje sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba gsang ba thugs kyi phur gcig ma paṇḍi ta las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta wa la tsand+ra dang*/ lo tsā ba glan chung dar ma tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ rig sngags bcad pa dang mnan pa'i cho ga dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sbyin sreg mdor bsdus/ klu gtor rgyas pa rnams glan chung dar ma tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ khro bo rdo rje gtum po'i sgrub thabs rgyal po zla ba'i snying pos mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba sgeg pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje khyung gi sgrub thabs slob dpon rdo rje padmas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta sa'i snying po dang*/ lo tsā ba rma ban gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzang po mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba slob dpon las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po zla ba bzang po dang*/ lo tsā ba glan chung dar ma tshul khrims kyi 'gyur ba rnams so// phyag na rdo rje be con mar grags pa'i skor la/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rnam par bshad pa sgron ma gsal ba zhes bya ba dge slong klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa/

be con can gyi rgyud kyi 'grel pa las rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po shrī bha dras mdzad pa/ 'phags pa gos sngon po can zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgya cher bshad pa slob dpon chen po mchog rab snying pos mdzad pa/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgya cher bshad pa rtog pa drug pa zhes bya ba slob dpon gu ya rū pa'i zhal snga nas bsgyur ba mkha' 'gro'i gling nas dum bu brgyad du legs par bris pa/ de'i bshad rgyud 'bum phrag phyed dang sum stong las phyung ba 'di rgyud du 'dod do// de kho na nyid sgron ma zhes bya ba phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs thams cad rdzogs pa'i rgyan dge slong klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta gu ru padma 'byung gnas dang*/ lo tsā ba glang dpal gyi seng ge'i 'gyur/ slad kyis kyang paṇḍi ta des rgya gar nas sgra rang 'gyur du bsgyur ro// 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sngags kyi rgyan gyi sgrub thabs/ rab gnas kyi rgyan rnams dge slong nā gārdzu nas mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i rgyan dge slong klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa/ dam tshig gi rgyan/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs dge slong klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa sngags kyi rgyan gyi 'grel pa dang*/ dam tshig gi rgyan gyi rnam par bshad pa slob dpon mchog rab kyis mdzad pa/ zangs dkar tshul khrims gzhon nu'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs kyi man ngag rgya cher bshad pa klu sgrub snying po zhes kyang bya/ slob dpon klu'i byang chub ces bya bas mdzad pa/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs kyi man ngag rgya cher bshad pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid sgron ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs pa dang*/

de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa slob dpon dpa' bos byin gyis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// phyag na rdo rje rnal 'byor chen por bkral ba'i skor 'di la the tshom za ba'i gzhi mang du snang yang bod na grags pa can du 'dug pas bris so zhes bu ston gyis gsungs so// 'khor chen gtum po be con la sogs pa// phyag na rdo rje rnal 'byor bla med du// dgongs pa bkral ba'i rgyud 'grel sgrub skor sogs// bcu phrag bdun la gcig gis spras pa bzhugs// de dag gis ni phyag na rdo rje rnal 'byor bla med du bkral ba'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar thabs kyi rgyud dang*/ shes rab kyi rgyud dang*/ thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi so so'i bstan bcos rnams bkod nas/ da ni rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud spyi'i dgongs 'grel gyi skor la/ wi pa la/ rgyud ma lus pa'i don nges par skul bar byed pa dpal gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba lha dang lha ma yin la sogs pa ma lus pas zhabs zung padmar me tog gi phreng bas mchod pa grub thob chen po padma badzras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛṣṇa paṇḍi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ thabs dang shes rab rnam par gtan la dbab pa grub pa slob dpon padma badzra'i slob ma slob dpon chen po yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po shānta bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ gzhung de gnyis la brtan nas slob dpon de'i slob ma rgyal po ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa'i ye shes grub pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rgya gar gyi mkhan po shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ slad kyis nag tshos kyang bcos pa'o// gzhung de rnams la brten nas slob dpon de'i slob ma bcom ldan 'das ma lakṣ+mī ka ras mdzad pa'i gnyis su med par grub pa'i sgrub thabs/

gzhung de rnams la brten nas lcam gyi slob ma slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dngos po gsal ma byung*/ ba grub pa/ dpal o rgyan nas byung ba gsang ba'i gsang ba chen po de kho na nyid kyi man ngag slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i slob ma slob dpon chen po dā ri ka pas mdzad pa/ slob dpon de'i slob ma lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma tsi tos mdzad pa'i dngos po gsal ba'i rjes su 'gro ba'i de kho na nyid grub pa paṇḍi ta zhi ba bzang po dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ dpal lhan cig skyes pa grub pa zhes bya ba sgeg pa rdo rje'i slob ma slob dpon chen po dpal ḍombi he ru kas mdzad pa de rnams la grub pa sde brgyad ces grag go /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal sa ra ha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i do ha mdzod ces bya ba'i glu de kho na nyid rnal du mtshon pa don dam pa'i yi ge phyag rgya bzhi gtan la dbab pa slob dpon klu sgrub snying pos mdzad pa/ bla ma dhi ri shrī dzñā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ 'di man ngag snye ma la sogs par slob dpon klu sgrub kyis byas pa ma yin te/ so so'i skye bo man ngag mi shes pa kha cig gis byas so zhes bshad mod kyi 'on kyang rgya gar ma yin cing bod la grags pa gtsor byas nas bris so// slob dpon klu sgrub kyis ārya de wa la bshad cing*/ des sems kyi sgrib sbyong mdzad de bris so// shes rab ye shes gsal ba zhes bya ba mkhas pa chen po de wa tsand+ras mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta badzra pā ṇi dang*/ lo tsā ba dharma kīrti'i 'gyur/ gnas pa bsdus pa slob dpon chen po dpal lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bla ma dhi ri shrī dzñā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur la/ phyis bar ston gyis zhus nas bla ma rgya gar ba dang*/ mtshur lo tsā bas dpe phyi mo la gtugs te gtan la phab pa/

bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa'i man ngag ces bya ba phyag rgya chen po thob pa'i slob dpon tog tse pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta bde ba'i myu gu dang*/ lo tsā ba 'gos kyi 'gyur te/ de ltar lnga dang*/ sems kyi sgrib ma byung*/ sbyong dang bcas pa'i drug po de la snying po'i skor zhes grags so// tha dad du chos spyod yod par ston pa lta ba ngan pa sel ba zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas pa chen po nges par sbyangs pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bla ma badzra pā ṇi dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mtshur ston ye shes 'byung gnas kyi 'gyur/ sngags kyi lta ba ston pa dbu ma drug pa slob dpon mkhas pa mai tris mdzad pa/ bla ma badzra pā ṇi dang*/ nag tsho'i 'gyur/ lta ba ngan pa sel ba'i dka' 'grel dpal ldan nges par sbyangs pa gnyis su med pas mdzad pa dang*/ sngags kyi spyod pa ston pa lhan skyes drug pa bla ma mai tri pas mdzad pa/ bla ma badzra pā ṇi dang*/ mtshur gyi 'gyur/ lta ba dpes ston pa rmi lam nges par bstan pa/ spyod pa dpes ston pa sgyu ma nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba/ lta ba'i don la 'bebs pa'i rab tu mi gnas par gsal bar ston pa zhes bya ba rnams slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta badzra pā ṇi dang*/ nag tsho tshul rgyal gyi 'gyur/ spyod pa gtan la 'bebs pa de kho na nyid bcu pa zhes bya ba slob dpon gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bla ma phyag na dang mtshur gyi 'gyur la/ phyis lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bcos pa/ thabs shes rab dbyer med du ston pa zung du 'jug pa rab tu gsal bar ston pa zhes bya ba slob dpon a wa dhū tīs mdzad pa/ badzra pā ṇi dang*/ nag tsho tshul rgyal gyi 'gyur/ snang stong dbyer med du ston pa dga' gcugs lnga pa slob dpon mai tri pas mdzad pa/ 'khor 'das gnyis med du ston pa mi phyed pa lnga pa slob dpon mai tri pas mdzad pa/

bden gnyis tha mi dad du ston pa'i bde ba chen po gsal ba slob dpon a wa dhū tī pa dpal gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams bla ma badzra pā ṇi dang rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ theg pa thun mong gi lta ba ston pa de kho na nyid rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba slob dpon a ba dhū tī pa gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ badzra pā ṇi dang*/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ gang zag gsum gyi rtogs thabs ston pa de kho na nyid rab tu bstan pa zhes bya ba dang*/ lha'i rnal 'byor gtan la 'bebs pa de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i phyag rgya rnam par bshad pa slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po phyag na rdo rje dang*/ lo tsā ba rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ dbang gi dgos pa mdor bsdus pa/ dbang gi bya ba mdor bsdus pa/ rang bzhin lnga pa/ thabs dang shes rab brtse ba lnga pa rnams slob dpon a wa dhū tī pa gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po badzra pā ṇi dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mtshur dzñā na ā ka ra'i 'gyur/ 'di ā ma nas kyi skor du mi bgrang bar snang*/ do ha ti zhes bya ba de kho na nyid kyi man ngag a wa dhū tī pas mdzad pa/ rje btsun dhi ri shrī dzñā na'i rang 'gyur/ gang zag gsum gyi sgom thabs ston pa theg pa chen po nyi shu pa slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de wā ka ra tsand+ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur/ yid la mi byed pa'i sgra la rtsod pa spong ba yid la mi byed pa ston pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po badzra pā ṇi dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba gnyan chung gi 'gyur/ mtha' bral rtogs pa'i shes rab ston pa de kho na nyid theg pa chen po nyi shu pa a wa dhū tī pa gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/

rje btsun dhi ri shrī dzñā na'i zhal snga nas/ lo tsā ba seng dkar shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ shes pa spro bsdu med par 'jog pa'i man ngag gsang ba dam pa 'di gzhan rnam grangs su mi bgrang bar snang*/ dbang gi khyad par gtan la 'bebs pa dbang bskur ba nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba slob dpon rgyal ba mai tri pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛṣṇa paṇḍi ta dang lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ chos sna nyi shu rtsa gnyis po de mnga' bdag mai tri dang*/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs gnyis med rdo rje zhes kyang bya/ a wa dhū tī pa zhes kyang bya bas mdzad pa'o// de'i rjes su 'brang ba bkas bskur ba'i chos bzhi la/ dbang bskur ba nges par bstan pa'i dka' 'grel slob dpon dga' ba skyong gis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta sa manta bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba nag tsho'i 'gyur/ de kho na nyid bcu pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa paṇḍi ta chen po slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po badzra pā ṇi las mnyan te/ slad kyis paṇḍi ta ka lyā na warma dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong dzñā na ā ka ra mtshur gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje'i tshig ces bya ba rdo rje slob dpon badzra pā ṇis zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba mtshur ston dge slong dzñā na ā ka ra'i 'gyur/ paṇḍi ta badzra pā ṇis mdzad pa'i lta ba ngan sel gyi dran pa ni ma rnyed de/ de ltar chos sna nyi shu rtsa drug la a ma na se ka ra'i skor zhes grags so// 'di'i gsang ba grub pa gsang 'dus kyi don 'grel yin pas de'i phyogs su rigs kyang*/ bod na grub rnying a ma na se'i skor zhes bshad bka' dang*/ man ngag gi bka' phyogs gcig tu yod pas 'dir lhan cig tu bris so// da ni de dag gi 'grel pa'i skor la/ do ha mdzod kyi dka' 'grel slob dpon chen po dpal gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar lho phyogs kyi yul ko sa lar sku 'khrungs pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po shrī bai ro tsa na badzra'i rang 'gyur/

mi zad pa'i gter mdzod yongs su gang ba'i glu zhes bya ba gnyug ma'i de nyid rab tu bstan pa'i rgya cher bshad pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal sa ra ha pa'i dgongs pa mkhas par grags pa dpal ldan gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor pa bsod snyoms pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na kīrti'i rang 'gyur/ do ha mdzod kyi bka' 'grel zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po thar pa'i 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po rgyal ba'i lha dang*/ rgya lo tsā'i 'gyur/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgya cher 'grel pa rin po che'i snying po zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas par grags pa bla ma bi ta karmas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor pa bsod snyoms pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na kīrti'i rang 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// dā ri ka pas mdzad pa'i grub mtha' bdun pa/

ma byung*/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta nags kyi rin chen dang*/ rtses thang lo tsā'i 'gyur/ dbang bzhi pa'i rab tu ma byung*/ byed pa paṇḍi ta nags kyi rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ byams pa gling pa'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// //zhi pa la/ lhan cig skyes grub rgyal po ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po zla ba mgon po dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba shes rab grags kyi 'gyur/ lhan cig skyes grub kyi gzhung 'grel zhes bya ba lha lcam rje btsun ma dpal mos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ma nā bi ha ra la dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong pradzñā kīrti'i rang 'gyur/ dpal de kho na nyid grub pa slob dpon chen po ke ra li pas mdzad pa/ 'di gsum kha cig grub pa'i chos skor du gtogs par 'dod do// da ni de dag dang phyogs mthun pa phyag rgya chen po ston pa'i gzhung do ha la sogs pa'i skor la/ do ha mdzod ces bya ba spyod pa'i glu dang*/ mi zad pa'i gter mdzod man ngag gi glu zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal bram ze chen po sa ra ha pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po badzra pā ṇi dang*/ bla ma a sus zhus pa/ 'di gnyis rgyal po do ha dang btsun mo do har grags shing*/ bram ze chen pos mdzad ma mdzad the tshom gyi gzhi'o// dmangs do ha dang*/ btsun mo do ha dang*/ rgyal po do ha dang*/ do ha mdzod ces bya ba spyod pa'i glu'i 'grel pa don gyi sgron ma rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bal po skye med bde chen gyis mdzad pa/ de nyid kyi rang 'gyur du gtan la phab pa/ gsal byed sum cu rtsa bzhi la sbyar te ston pa ka kha'i do ha zhes bya ba dang*/ de'i rang 'grel ka kha'i do ha'i bshad pa bris pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu lta bu dpal sa ra has mdzad pa/ rgya gar lho phyogs yul ko sa lar 'khrungs pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī bai ro tsa na badzra'i rang 'gyur/

do ha mdzod kyi snying po don gyi glu'i 'grel pa zhes bya ba slob dpon a wa dhū tī pas mdzad pa/ do ha sku'i mdzod 'chi med rdo rje'i glu/ gsung gi mdzod 'jam dbyangs rdo rje'i glu/ thugs kyi mdzod skye med rdo rje'i glu/ sku gsung thugs yid la mi byed pa'i phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba rnams sangs rgyas gnyis pa ltar grags pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal sa ra ha pa'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa/ bla ma nag po pa'i rang 'gyur/ do ha mdzod ces bya ba phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag dpal ri khrod pa chen po sa ra ha'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ shrī bai ro tsa na rakṣi ta'i rang 'gyur/ de rnams lnga po bram zer chen po sa ra ha pas mdzad pa'o// man ngag tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa/ rang byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal sa ra ha pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po shānta bha dra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag rtse mo do ha'i glu zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal sa ra ha'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa/ kṛṣṇa paṇḍi ta'i rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/ dngos po sbyong ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po badzra pā ṇi dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa phyed dang lnga pa'i 'grel pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon chen po ārya de was mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po ma hā kā ru ṇa dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ do ha mdzod ces bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pas mdzad pa/ do ha mdzod slob dpon chen po tilli pas mdzad pa/ brtul zhugs spyod pa'i slob dpon chen po nag pos mdzad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa/

dpal bi rū pas mdzad pa'i tshig rkang brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa rnams yul lho phyogs ko sa lar sku 'khrungs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī bai ro tsa na badzra'i rang 'gyur/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang*/ bdud rtsi grub pa'i rtsa ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po bi rū pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po rnal 'byor pa las grub pa thob pa'i rgya gar e na de wa'i 'gyur/ mkha' 'gro ma'i man ngag snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa gdung ba bcad pa'i gdams ngag ces bya ba sprul pa'i rnal 'byor pas gzhung du bkod pa/ phyag rgya chen po rdo rje'i glu brda brgyud gsang ba'i sgron ma dpal sha ba ri dbang phyug dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma ye shes kyi spyan ma dang*/ padma'i spyan gnyis rnams kyis snying po'i don mgur du bzhes pa/ slob dpon chen po nā ro pa'i rdo rje'i glu/ ma hā yo ga nā ro pa'i rdo rje'i glu/ yang rdo rje'i glu/ slob dpon nag po zhabs kyi rdo rje'i glu/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i rtog pa'i snying po zhes bya ba slob dpon dpa' bo 'od gsal gyis phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa dang*/ spyod pa'i glu'i mdzod grub pa rnams kyi rdo rje'i glu de kho na nyid gsal bar shes pa'i skye bo rnams la slob dpon thub pas byin gyis 'grel pa mdzad pa la/ rdo rje'i glu 'grel pa dang bcas pa paṇḍi ta chen po kīrti tsand+ra'i zhal snga nas gdams pa dang bcas pa zhus shing*/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan sa skya pa khu dbon rnams kyi sku drin la brten nas bal yul yam bu'i grong khyer du bod kyi lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dngos po'i gnas lugs bsgom pa zhes bya ba nor bu gling pa'i slob dpon bde ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ phyag rgya bzhi'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po badzra pā ṇi dang*/

bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ chos thams cad rab tu mi gnas par ston pa'i de kho na nyid tshigs su bcad pa phyed kyi 'grel pa dpal a wa dhū tī'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ ma rtogs pa rtogs par byed pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po dpal gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ snying po kun las btus pa'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon chen po shrī ā nanda badzras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po badzra pā ṇi dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas 'char ba ma byung*/ zhes bya ba slob dpon lū hi pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta nags kyi rin chen dang*/ byams pa gling pa'i 'gyur/ bsgom rim drug pa zhes bya ba sangs rgyas gnyis pa ltar grags pa'i badzra pā ṇis mdzad pa/ de nyid dang*/ nag tsho'i 'gyur/ na mo buddhā ya'i 'grel pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po slob dpon nag po rdo rjes mdzad pa'i do ha mdzod ces bya ba dang*/ dpal nag po rdo rje zhabs kyi do ha mdzod kyi rgya cher 'grel pa paṇḍi ta 'od dpag med kyis mdzad pa/ shrī bai ro tsa na badzra'i rang 'gyur/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag tilli pas nā ro pa la chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du gsungs pa/ rje nā ro'i lta ba mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyi 'gyur/ phyag rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tilli pas go ri shar ba'i rgyal po'i khab tu rnal 'byor pa la gdams pa dang*/ mthu chen la gdams pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tilli pas gyad kyi nor bu'i grong du gdams pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba dang*/ glu mkhan la gdams pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tilli pas 'dus pa rin po che'i tshong dus su gdams pa rol mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba dang*/ mu stegs la gdams pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po tilli pas rgyal po seng grags seng ge'i sgo drung du gdams pa chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba dang*/

shan pa la gdams pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tilli pas rigs ngan gtum mo'i grong khyer du gsod pa'i sbyar ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba dang*/ rig byed mkhan la gdams pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tilli pas grong khyer padma can du gdams pa sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba dang*/ sgyu ma mkhan la gdams pa rnal 'byor gi dbang phyug tilli pas grong khyer grags pa skyong du gdams pa dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba dang*/ smad 'tshong la gdams pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tilli pas sgyu ma sprul pa'i grong khyer du gdams pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bde ba chen po zhes bya ba ste tilli pa'i chos brgyad do// 'khor ba las yid nges par 'byung bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i glu slob dpon dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rgya brtson seng ges bi kra ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba/ slad nas bla ma de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bcos pa/ chos kyi dbyings su lta ba'i glu slob dpon chen po dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ zhi byed kyi man ngag sgron ma dgu skor la/ man ngag sku'i sgron ma zhes bya ba dang*/ theg pa gsung gi sgron ma zhes bya ba dang*/ yang dag lta ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba dang*/ rin po che'i sgron ma zhes bya ba dang*/ mnyam nyid gzhi'i sgron ma zhes bya ba dang*/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i sgron ma zhes bya ba dang*/ byang chub spyod pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba dang*/ rnal 'byor lam gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba dang*/ gsang ba thugs kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba dang*/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga zhes bya ba dang*/ de kho na nyid phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i man ngag rnams rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na gu hya dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bla ma ang lo btsun chung gi 'gyur ro// bskyed rim gyi skor la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal khro bor sgrub pa de rnams rje btsun ka ma la shī las mdzad cing*/ paṇḍi ta dzñā na gu hya dang*/ ang lo tsā ba'i 'gyur/ chos drug man ngag ces bya ba grub pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tilli pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa nā ro paṇḍi ta dang*/ mar pa lho brag pa chos kyi blo gros kyis kha che'i gnas puṣpa ha rir bsgyur/ bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma'i man ngag ka dpe dang po dang*/ ka dpe phyi ma gnyis 'gyur byang med pa/ rim pa lnga bsdus pa gsal ba zhes bya ba dpal nā ro pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyi 'gyur/ go bar byed pa'i snying po brgya pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po ārya de was mdzad pa/ go bar byed pa'i snying po brgya pa rnam par bshad pa zhes bya ba dpal he ru ka de wa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ tshe sgrub pa'i thabs rnams rgya gar shar phyogs satna ga ra'i paṇḍi ta chen po dpal nags kyi rin chen gyi spyan sngar/ dge slong chos smra ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sdes bsgyur/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i man ngag zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang tshig tilli pas bkod pa dang*/ snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang mkhas pa nā ro pas mdzad pa/ mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis puṣpa ha ri'i gnas chen du bsgyur/ bdag gi rnal 'byor zhes bya ba tog rtse pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs satna ga ra'i mkhas pa chen po nags kyi rin chen gyi spyan sngar/

dge slong chos smra ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sdes bsgyur ba/ las thams cad grub par byed pa zhes bya ba tsarba ṭi'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dge slong rgya mtshos bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //zi pa la/ lhan cig skyes pa'i glu rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shānti de was mdzad pa/ bla ma dhi ri shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ rang bzhin gyi do ha mdzod kyi glu'i lta ba zhes bya ba slob dpon lū hi pas mdzad pa/ rnam rtog spang ba'i glu zhes bya ba slob dpon li lā pas mdzad pa/ las kyi gtum mo'i do ha mdzod kyi klu zhes bya ba slob dpon bi rū pas mdzad pa/ lta bsgom spyod pa 'bras bu'i do ha'i glu zhes bya ba slob dpon sa ra ha pas mdzad pa/ do ha mdzod kyi de nyid kyi glu zhes bya ba slob dpon ka na ri nas brgyud pa tha ga nas mdzad pa/ spyod pa'i do ha mdzod kyi glu zhes bya ba slob dpon kām bha la nas brgyud pa slob dpon koṅka nas mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes dga'i do ha mdzod kyi glu'i lta ba zhes bya ba slob dpon bha des mdzad pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i lta ba'i glu zhes bya ba slob dpon dā ma pas mdzad pa/ rlung gi de nyid kyi do ha'i glu zhes bya ba slob dpon nag po pa nas brgyud pa slob dpon ma hi pas mdzad pa/ dpyid kyi thig le do ha mdzod kyi glu zhes bya ba slob dpon nag po nas brgyud pa slob dpon sa ra has mdzad pa/ rdo rje bzhi'i glu zhes bya ba a wa dhū tī gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bla ma mai tri pa'i glu/ sa ra ha'i glu/ yang sa ra ha'i glu/ bi rū byed pa'i rdo rje'i glu/ kahṇa pa'i glu/ mi gnas pa'i don thugs su chud pa bla ma rje btsun dhiṣṭi dzñā nas mdzad pa rdo rje'i glu/ yang bla ma dhiṣṭi dzñā na'i zhal snga nas kyi glu/ yang glu gcig gaṇḍā ri'i glu/ ma ti tsi ṭa'i glu/ yang glu gnyis/ ā tsārya dpa' bo rnam par snang mdzad kyi glu/

nā ro paṇḍi ta'i glu/ lū hi pa'i glu/ ḍombi pa'i glu/ bi rū pa'i glu/ la ba pa'i glu/ ma hā su kha ta'i glu/ rnal 'byor pa pra sa ra'i glu/ klu sgrub kyi glu/ dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na'i chos kyi glu/ thig le bcu drug gi nyams len zhes bya ba slob dpon kaṅka li pas mdzad pa/ phyi nang byang chub kyi sems bcing ba'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon bi nā pas mdzad pa/ rlung gi de nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon gho ra ṣas mdzad pa/ rlung gi de nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon tso rong gis mdzad pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa slob dpon bi rū pa nas brgyud pa slob dpon bhi na pas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i nyams len gyi thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon tanti pas mdzad pa/ thabs dang shes rab gtan la phab pa'i dngos grub bsdus pa zhes bya ba slob dpon tsa ma ris mdzad pa/ rang bzhin grub pa med pa'i gzhi'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rje btsun yi ge brgya pa'i sems dpa' gsum gyi sgom pa'i thabs slob dpon nā ro pas mdzad pa/ rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba slob dpon si la a lis mdzad pa/ snying rje bsgom pa'i byin rlabs zhes bya ba slob dpon tilli pas mdzad pa/ theg pa chen po'i gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po dho khindhas mdzad pa/ sems la gros 'debs zhes bya ba slob dpon a dzo gis mdzad pa/ gzhi lam 'bras bu bsgom pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len zhes bya ba slob dpon paṃ ka las mdzad pa/ rtsa rlung gi sgo nas rnal 'byor gyi spyod pa spyad pa zhes bya ba dang*/ yi ge gnyis pa'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon ḍombi he ru kas mdzad pa/ de kho na nyid kyi bde ba bsgom pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon chen po ku ku ri pas mdzad pa/

'dzag pa gcod pa'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon ku dzī pas mdzad pa/ mu stegs kyi gtum mo zhes bya ba slob dpon a tsintis mdzad pa/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsi zhes bya ba slob dpon na lis mdzad pa/ sems dang sems nyid 'dul ba'i thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon shānta de wa nas brgyud pa slob dpon me ko las mdzad pa/ lha kun gyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i lam zhes bya ba gha dha ris mdzad pa/ nyi zla bcing ba'i thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon bi rū pa nas brgyud pa ka ma ris mdzad pa/ sems nyid kyi thig le hūm̐ nyid bsgom pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon dzā landha ris mdzad pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bsgom pa zhes bya ba slob dpon rā hu las mdzad pa/ hūm̐ yig sems nyid thig le bsgom pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon nag po pa nas brgyud pa'i slob dpon dharma pas mdzad pa/ rang bzhin grub pa zhes bya ba slob dpon dho ka ris mdzad pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i gdams pa zhes bya ba slob dpon me dhi nis mdzad pa/ bla med sbyor ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon bā dā dzas mdzad pa/ a phreng ka phreng gi sngags kyi rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon gandhas mdzad pa/ ka phreng bsgom pa'i lam zhes bya ba slob dpon dha ma dhu mas mdzad pa/ a phreng ka phreng bde mchog 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor chen po bsgom pa zhes bya ba slob dpon sā ga ras mdzad pa/ rlung gnas nad kyi brtag pa zhes bya ba slob dpon a dzo kis mdzad pa/ sems kyi de nyid bcing ba zhes bya ba slob dpon ko dha lis mdzad pa/ gtum mo thig le bkram pa zhes bya ba slob dpon tsu li kis mdzad pa/ lus kyi rtsa thig mnyam pa nyid kyi man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon ni ku nis mdzad pa/ 'byung ba bzhi'i srid pa'i chags lugs zhes bya ba slob dpon tsa ra pa tis mdzad pa/ rang rig ye shes kyi lta ba'i nyams len zhes bya ba slob dpon tsampa kas mdzad pa/

'jigs pa brgyad rmongs par byed pa'i thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon bhe kha nas mdzad pa/ phyi nang gi dug sel gyi rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon tilli pas mdzad pa/ g.yung drung 'khyil pa gsum gyi zhal gdams kyi nyams len zhes bya ba slob dpon yum kaṅka la me ka las gsungs pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin zhes bya ba slob dpon kanthā ris mdzad pa/ a ti rnal 'byor gyi bsgom pa'i thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa/ byang chub sems kyi rlung rgyu ba'i man ngag bsgom pa zhes bya ba slob dpon su ta lis mdzad pa/ lta spyod skye med kyi bsgom pa zhes bya ba slob dpon pa na has mdzad pa/ tshe sgrub pa'i gdams ngag ces bya ba slob dpon ko ki las mdzad pa/ dug sel sgom pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon a rang gis mdzad pa/ gnyis med kyi rtsa ba sgom pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon nag po pa nas brgyud pa slob dpon ni la khandhas mdzad pa/ phra ba'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams len zhes bya ba slob dpon sa mu dras mdzad pa/ phyi nang bdud rtsi'i bcud len zhes bya ba slob dpon bhya ris mdzad pa rnams rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta ratna pha las rang 'gyur du mdzad nas bshad rgyud kyi gdams pa bar ma chad du gsungs so// do ha spyod pa'i glu'i lta ba zhes bya ba slob dpon lū hi pa nas brgyud pa slob dpon ki ra bas mdzad pa/ stong pa nyid kyi lta ba zhes bya ba slob dpon sha ba ri pas mdzad pa/ bde sdug gnyis bral gyi lta ba zhes bya ba slob dpon shānti pas mdzad pa/ 'brel med kyi lta ba zhes bya ba slob dpon kaṃ pa las mdzad pa rnams bla ma ratna pha la'i rang 'gyur/ zhen med kyi lta ba zhes bya ba slob dpon kaṃ pa las mdzad pa/ stong nyid snying rje'i lta ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po ārya de wa nas brgyud pa slob dpon tsa ta pas mdzad pa/ sems nyid rin chen gyi lta ba zhes bya ba slob dpon ka na pa nas brgyud pa slob dpon dhe ta nas mdzad pa/

de nyid brgyad kyi lta ba zhes bya ba slob dpon ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa/ sems nyid kyi rtog pa 'joms pa'i lta ba zhes bya ba kaṅka la dang me kha la nas brgyud pa slob dpon lakṣ+mīs gsungs pa/ mya ngan gyi lta ba zhes bya ba slob dpon ma hi la nas brgyud pa dha'u ri pas mdzad pa/ sems tsam gyi lta ba zhes bya ba slob dpon sa ra ha nas brgyud pa slob dpon mai tri pas gsungs pa/ snying rje'i spyod pa thod pa'i lta ba zhes bya ba slob dpon dha ri ka pa nas brgyud pa slob dpon sa ra bha khas mdzad pa/ 'brel med kyi lta ba zhes bya ba slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa/ de bzhin nyid kyi lta ba zhes bya ba slob dpon dā ri ka pas mdzad pa/ phyag rgya chen po brda'i brgyud pa dam pa rgya gar la bde bar gshegs pa bcu gnyis kyis gsungs pa/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa ltar grags pa bla ma rgya gar nag gu'i zhabs dang*/ bod kyi bande zha ma lo tsā bas byin rlabs kyi gnas mchog ding rir bsgyur te bla ma byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' la gsungs pa/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag rdo rje gsang ba'i glu zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal sa ra has zhal nas gsungs pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la shī la dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba zha ma ston pa seng ge rgyal pos bsgyur/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i mgur zhes bya ba zha ma lo tsā'i 'gyur/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i brda'i mgur zhes bya ba dbyings kyi gtso mo rnams bka' bgros nas rje dam pa rgya gar la gnang ba/ slad kyis ding ri glang 'khor du zha ma lo tsās bsgyur nas bla ma byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' la gtad/ thugs kyi gsang ba glur blang ba thig le dag pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba dang*/ grub thob pho mo brgyad cu'i rtog pa brjod pa dang*/ grub thob lnga bcu'i rtog pa brjod pa thig le 'od kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang mdzod nas phyung ste rje dam pa rgya gar la gnang ba zha ma lo tsā'i 'gyur/

phyag rgya chen po rin po che brda'i man ngag ces bya ba rje dam pa la mkha' 'gro mas gtad pa/ zha ma lo tsā'i 'gyur la dum bu drug dang le phran lnga bcu rtsa lnga yod do// mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gsang ba'i glu zhes bya ba brul tsho bdun du bstan pa mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba'i mdzod na gnas pa las dbyings kyi gtso mo rnams kyis bka' bgros nas ka ma la shī la la gtad pa/ zha ma lo tsā ba ston pa seng ge rgyal pos bsgyur/ rngon pa chen pos ka ma la shī la la gnad kyi gdams pa bstan pa sems kyi gsang ba zab don brda'i glur blangs pa zhes bya ba sha ba ri dbang phyug gis dam pa la gnang*/ dam pa'i zhal snga nas zha ma lo tsā bas gtan la phab ste dpal ding ri mkhan pa'i khrod du bsgyur ba/ dpal o rgyan gyi tshogs 'khor byas pa'i dus su rnal 'byor pa grub pa thob pa bzhi bcus rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa nyams kyi man ngag thig le gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sum cu rtsa lnga'i rtog pa brjod pa mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang mdzod na gnas pa las dbyings kyi gtso mo rnams kyis bka' bgros nas rje dam pa rgya gar la gnang ba/ zha ma lo tsā'i 'gyur/ mkha' 'gro ma'i 'byams glu zhes bya ba khyad par gyi brgyud pa brgyad las don skor rnam pa bzhi 'byams glu dang bcas pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po rin po che dbang gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba dur khrod rgyu skar dpal gyi rol par gsungs pa/ rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid snang ba zhes bya ba grub pa rnams kyi rdo rje'i mgur rgyal sras mi'i seng ge rje dam pa rgya gar rin po che'i zhal snga nas rang 'gyur du mdzad pa/ phyag rgya chen po gser phreng zhes bya ba grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang paṇḍi ta mang pos gsungs pa rnams rje btsun mnga' bdag mai tri pas gzhung gcig tu bsdebs pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyi 'gyur/

shes rab kyi phrin yig ces bya ba slob dpon chen po padma rdo rjes mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po shānta bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ rnal 'byor pa'i rtog pa'i gegs sel ba zhes bya ba dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ dug lnga sbas pa'i lam mchog tu gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba slob dpon 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid ldan pa mkhas pa chen po dpal byang chub bzang po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ shes rab brtsam pa dus kyi gtam zhes bya ba bhaṃ ga la'i mkhas pa dpal nges par sbyangs pa dpal ldan gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes bram ze bha lo la gdams pa/ ting nge 'dzin tshogs kyi le'u/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga gnyis slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 'di dag mdo phyogs su bris pa ni nor ba yin no// bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i gru bo zhes bya ba grub pa brnyes pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po a dzi ta mi tra guptas mdzad pa dang*/ 'ching ba rnam grol gyi bstan bcos rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po grub pa brnyes pa dpal ni ska laṃ kas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī dza ga ta mi tra nanda dang kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po buddhā shrī bha dras gtan la phab nas/ lo tsā ba gnubs tshul khrims shes rab kyi 'gyur/ lta spyod rnam dag gi man ngag ces bya ba kha che'i rigs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po dpal chos kyi shākya shrī bha dras mdzad pa/ mkhas pa chen po de nyid kyi spyan sngar lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis khro phu bzang lung du 'gyur/ sems rin po che sbyang ba'i lam 'bras kha che'i rigs las bal yul du sku 'khrungs pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po dpal lnga ris pa'i mchog buddha shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/

mkhas pa chen po de nyid kyi spyan sngar lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bal yul ya ma mgal gyi gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba/ 'ching ba rnam grol gyi man ngag ces bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shrī dza ga ta mi tra ā nandas gsungs pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug de nyid kyi spyan sngar lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bal yul bu lang gser khang du bsgyur ba/ grub pa dam pa'i lam nges pa/ rnal 'byor pa rang gi sems mdud pa 'grol ba'i man ngag dpal rnal 'byor bdun gyi lam rnam par nges pa rnams rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī dza ga ta mi tra ā nanda'i thugs kyi 'khor lo dam pa bkra shis kyi tshong 'dus chen po dpal mgur mo rin po che'i gling du mdzad pa'i bstan bcos gnubs lo tsā'i 'gyur/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba dang*/ pha rol dbang du bya ba bla ma mi tra ā nandas mdzad pa/ de nyid dang*/ gnubs lo tsā'i 'gyur/ rin po che 'khor lo dbang gi man ngag gi rim pa slob dpon ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa/ dbang gi rim pa bstan pa zhes bya ba rje btsun klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong ye shes bzang po'i 'gyur/ dbang gi rim pa mdor bsdus pa slob dpon dpal shes rab gsang bas mdzad pa/ bzhi pa'i rnam par nges pa'i man ngag ces bya ba kha che'i slob dpon chen po rig byed kyi mtha' 'dzin pa dpal rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po biryā bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims bkra shis kyi 'gyur/ dbang bskur ba'i nges pa bstan pa slob dpon mkhas pa chen po rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po shānti bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ dbang gi don nges par brjod pa zhes bya ba slob dpon rgyal ba bzang po dpal sbas pa zhes bya bas mdzad pa/

ru lag rgyang gi gtsug lag khang du rgya gar gyi mkhan po a wa dhū tī pa dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje theg pa rtsa ba'i ltung ba bsdus pa dang*/ ltung ba sbom po bsdus pa slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ ltung ba bco lnga pa/ yan lag gi nyes pa bdun pa/ rdo rje theg pa'i sbom po'i ltung ba brgyad pa rnams slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po padmā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur la/ slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po bla ma rje btsun paṇḍi ta chen po ma ṇi ka shrī dzñā na dang*/ chag lo tsā ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyis bcos pa/ yan lag gi dam tshig ces bya ba/ rdo rje theg pa'i ltung ba'i snye ma zhes bya ba mkhas pa chen po a bha yā ka ra guptas mdzad pa/ ma ga dhā'i mkhas pa chen po de nyid dang*/ mang du thos pa'i dge slong bsod snyoms pa rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags pas nā lend+rar 'gyur/ rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon chen po dpal lcam lakṣ+mī ka ras mdzad pa/ rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon chen po snying po zhabs kyis mdzad pa bha wa pa'i gdams ngag mngon par bkod pa/ slob dpon rgyal ba'i lhas mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa mkhas pa chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas gsungs pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa lam gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa/ myang ro stag tshal du dī paṃ ka ra bod du byon tsam na bsgyur ba/ bu ri sha'i grong khyer du ā tsārya u pa dha shrī badzra shī la dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong brtson 'grus seng ges legs par mnos te gus par bsgyur/

yang bal po'i khyim du rin chen grags pas kyang 'grel dpe rnying pa la gtugs te shin tu dag par bgyis pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba bla ma mngon shes can rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa/ yul dbus kyi dpe ji lta ba bzhin lo tsā ba dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gtsug lag khang chen po dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur ba/ dpal gsang ba thams cad kyi spyi'i cho ga'i snying po rgyan zhes bya ba slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa/ bal po'i mkhan po ka na ka shrī dang*/ lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur la/ slad kyis rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta hā sya badzra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong nyi ma rdo rjes bsgyur/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga zhes bya ba ma hā paṇḍi ta a bha yā ka ra guptas mdzad pa/ ma hā paṇḍi ta shrī ratna rakṣi ta'i rang 'gyur/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛṣṇa pa de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga paṇḍi ta bzang po sbyin pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya shrī bha dra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta ratna rakṣi tas mdzad pa dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga rim par phye ba zhes bya ba ā tsārya he ru ka badzras mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta ratna rakṣi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba zhang grub pa dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ kā ra de nyid dang*/ rgya brtson 'grus seng ges bsgyur ba/ gdugs la sogs pa rab tu gnas pa dang rnying pa 'byin pa'i cho ga dang*/ sa dang shing dang rdo'i cho ga gnyis kyi rgya dpe gnyal gyi phyogs nas rnyed cing zhwa lu lo tsā bas dpal sne'u gdong rtser bsgyur ba/

'di rnal 'byor chen po'i thabs rgyud las 'phros pa zhig 'dra na'ang gang gi dum bu yin ma gsal bas 'dir bkod do// dbyig gi phreng ba zhes bya ba cho ga'i bya ba bcu pa lo tsā ba dge slong chos skyong bzang pos dpal e waṃ chos 'khor du bsgyur/ 'di rgyud sna tshogs las btus par snang bas 'dir bkod do// 'dod pa'i bstan bcos slob dpon gzugs bzang gis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// rnal 'byor bla med spyi yi lta sgom dang*// dbang don sdom pa dam tshig la sogs dang*// tshogs 'khor rab gnas la sogs ston pa yi// chos skor nyis brgya brgyad cu rtsa bdun bzhugs// de dag gis ni bla med spyi'i lta sgom spyod 'bras la sogs pa ston pa'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar bla med spyi'i lta sgom spyod 'bras la sogs pa ston pa'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi skor la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud de nyid bsdus pa'i skor ni/ dang po slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i rjes su 'brang ba la/ 'i pa la/ rgyud kyi don la 'jug pa zhes bya ba 'phags pa de kho na nyid bsdus pa las rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gsungs pa'i ye shes sems dpa' mnyes par bya ba'i cho ga bsdus pa slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba 'jam dpal go cha'i 'gyur/ rgyud kyi don la 'jug pa'i 'grel bshad slob dpon chen po padma badzras mdzad pa gnyis bzhugs so// //yi ri gnyis la/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyi bzhed pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i skor la/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rgya cher bshad pa ko sa la'i rgyan zhes bya ba shlau ka stong phrag bcu gnyis pa mang du thos pa'i slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/
