rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha rnams kyi rnam par gzhag pa zhes bya ba slob dpon mu di ta ko ṣas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po padmā ka ra warma dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi thig gdab pa mdor bsdus pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi thig gdab pa'i mdor bsdus pa'i 'grel pa yul kha cher skyes pa'i rdo rje slob dpon shraddhā ka ra warmas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa/ thig gdab pa'i cho ga dka' ba spyod pa zhes bya ba slob dpon shuddhi pra bhas mdzad pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi thig gi cho ga slob dpon dharma kīrtis mdzad pa/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dum bu las 'phros pa 'phags pa 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa slob dpon mu di ta ko ṣas mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// //li shi gnyis la/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po'i rjes su 'brang ba'i skor ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi bshad pa de kho na nyid snang bar byed pa zhes bya ba shlau ka stong phrag bco brgyad pa slob dpon chen po kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ dum bu dang po yan chad lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur la/ man chad rgya gar gyi mkhas pa paṇḍi ta thugs rje chen po dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur ba bzhugs so// //si hi i gsum la/ cha mthun gyi rgyud dpal mchog dang po las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dum bu'i 'grel pa slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po padmā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal mchog dang po'i rgya cher bshad pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'byung ba dum bu dang po'i phyag rgya bshad pa zhes bya ba shlau ka stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa slob dpon chen po kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/

paṇḍi ta shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ ka ma la gupta dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ smad 'grel lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos ci rigs par bsgyur ba la/ gu ge'i yul gyi dbus byang chub sems dpa'i thugs dam sa'i snying po dpal dpe med lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po mant+ra ka la sha dang*/ sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po byang chub sems dpa'i gdung brgyud lha bla ma dge slong zhi ba 'od kyis hor kong bsabs te yongs su rdzogs par bsgyur ba'o// 'di la rgya dpe rnyed na hor kong bsabs dgos pa'ang da dung cha gnyis gsum snang ngo*// rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgya cher bshad pa slob dpon mkhas pa chen po kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dka' 'grel slob dpon rab tu zhi ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur ba/ rgyud 'di rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud du gsungs kyang*/ 'grel pa mkhan pos rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du bkral bas 'grel pa 'di gnyis phyogs 'dir bris so// dpal rdo rje snying po'i rgyan gyi rgyud chen po'i dka' 'grel slob dpon rab tu zhi ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen grub kyis yang dag pa nyid du bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //de ltar rgyud kyi 'grel pa'i skor rnams bkod nas/ sgrub thabs dkyil chog man ngag la sogs pa'i skor la/ ku pa la/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga rdo rje thams cad 'byung ba zhes bya ba slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya buddha shrī shānti dang*/

zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs gzhung tshad shlau ka brgya phrag gnyis dang rkang pa gcig bcas dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su buddha shrī shānti dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'phags pa de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud las btus pa slob dpon chen po kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ gzhung tshad shlau ka stong nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga pa zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal mchog dang po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang*/ spyan dbye ba'i cho ga slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa chung ba dang*/ che ba

ma byung*/ gnyis paṇḍi ta shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ che ba 'di the tshom gyi gzhi cig snang ste bla ma rnams yang dag tu bzhed kyin snang bas bris so// rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga slob dpon chen po kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ spyan dbye ba'i cho ga slob dpon pradzñā wa li tas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ thugs rje 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i bsgom pa dang bzlas pa'i cho ga slob dpon chen po ye shes rdo rje'am ming gzhan padma dkar po zhes bya bas mdzad pa dang*/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga slob dpon rab 'byor bskyangs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal ldan rgya che ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rab gnas kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga rdo rje thams cad 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i don bsdus pa ā tsārya mu nīnd+ra bha dras mdzad pa/ de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi don bsgom pa'i don bsdus pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ku mā ra ka la sha'i zhal snga nas bsgyur cing zhus pa/ bya ba bsdus pa zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta chen po ni saṃ ga ā tsārya dpal ldan rigs kyi byin pas mdzad pa/ bla ma paṇḍi ta chen po kīrti tsand+ras zhus shing gzhung sum gnyis bal po'i mthil du bsgyur nas sum cha gcig lo tsā ba dge slong yar lungs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ gzhu'i gtsug lag khang chen po nyid du yongs su rdzogs par legs par bsgyur cing shin tu dag par byas pa/

'di nyid ni dpal rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yin pas 'dir bris so// de nyid bsdus pa dpal mchog dang po dang*/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la sogs dgongs 'grel ba'i// mkhas grub gsum gyi gzhung lugs rjes 'brang bcas// bcu phrag gsum la gnyis kyis brgyan pa bzhugs// de dag gis ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud de nyid bsdus pa dang dpal mchog dang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de nyid bsdus pa la sogs pa'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ da ni rtsa ba'i rgyud de nyid bsdus pa'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dum bu las 'phros pa mtshan yang dag par brjod pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du bkral ba'i skor la/ khu pa la/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa 'grel brgya ru gsal/ slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa mtshan gsang sngags kyi don du rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po sgeg pa'i rdo rje nyi ma can gyi rin po che'i gling na bzhugs pa dpal ldan byang chub mchog gi skal ba dang ldan pa gang gi mtshan dpal sna tshogs gzugs can du grags pa des mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po smṛ ti dzñā na kīrti'i 'gyur la/ phyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po phyag na rdo rje dang*/ lo tsā ba klog skya shes rab brtsegs kyis bcos pa la yang gnyen gyis bcos pa/ gzhung tshad ni shlau ka nyis stong lnga brgya'o// 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i rgya cher bshad pa slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ ka ma la gupta dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur ba rnams bzhugs so//

//gu pa la/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa slob dpon chen po zla ba bzang po grags pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta chen po shrī ma hā dza na dang*/ sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po dge slong 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa bsdus pa'i gsal ba o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po a wa dhū tī pas mdzad pa dang*/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa mtshan don gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po gnyis su med pa'i sbas pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī mi tra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos o rgyan gyi dzambu dha ra zhes bya ba'i mthar bsgyur ba/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi bshad 'bum paṇḍi ta smṛ ti dzñā na kīrtis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid kyi rang 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i man ngag gi 'grel pa zhes bya ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po slob dpon gzhon nu grags pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de wa rā dza dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba shes rab bla ma'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dka' 'grel dbu ma la dga' bas mdzad pa/ 'di'i rgya dpe dpal sne gdong gi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa sngar ma 'gyur ba la/ dus phyis 'gos kyi rigs las 'khrungs pa'i skad gnyis smra ba chos skyong bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dka' 'grel bsdus pa zhes bya ba ratna ā ka ra guptas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kā la tsakra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dzñā na garbha dang 'bro jo sras dang chos kyi brtson 'grus la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon chen po phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes pa ḍombi he ru kas mdzad pa/

gzhung gi tshad la tshigs su bcad pa stong phrag gcig dang drug brgya lnga bcu mchis pa/ bkra shis kyi gdan sa chen po tsong ka ser to bla mkhar gyi nang du bod kyi lo tsā ba dge tshul khyung grags kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// gzhung 'di la'ang the tshom gyi gzhi can du snang ngo zhes sngon gyi mkhan pa dag gsung ngo*// de ltar mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa'i skor rnams bkod nas/ de dag gi rjes su 'brang ba'i sgrub thabs dang*/ dkyil chog dang*/ man ngag gi skor la/ ngu pa la/ mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa chung ba'i rjes su 'brang ba nam mkha' dri med chung ba zhes grags pa'i skor ni/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nam mkha' dri med ces bya ba 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su badzra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil chog la/ byang sems rdo rje dbugs dbyung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rnam par snang mdzad dbugs dbyung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mi bskyod pa dbugs dbyung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga snang ba mtha' yas dbugs dbyung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rin chen 'byung ldan dbugs dbyung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga don yod grub pa dbugs dbyung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i khrus kyi cho ga mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i chu sbyin/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i zas kyi rnal 'byor/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'byung po'i gtor chog mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i maṇḍal gyi cho ga mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i bskor ba bya thabs/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i yan lag bdun pas tshogs bsags pa'i thabs/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan 'don pa'i man ngag

mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i mi rtag pa sgom pa/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i mi rtag pa 'khor ba la yid byung ba/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i shes pa dug gsum las bzlog pa'i man ngag skyabs su 'gro ba'i cho ga sems bskyed pa'i cho ga byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i man ngag tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa'i man ngag dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas la lta ba/ dbang po tha mas mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i rjes su dran pa drug sgom pa'i man ngag dbang po 'bring gis mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgo nas rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis sgom pa'i man ngag dbang po rab kyis de kho na nyid sgom pa'i man ngag 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i byang chub chen po'i sku gdung gi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i mnyam par gzhag pa'i rim pa'i man ngag 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i cho ga mdo dang bsres pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i spyan dbye ba'i cho ga dang rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i ngan sngags byad kyi 'khor los bsad pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sdig pa sbyong ba tshe 'phos pa la phan gdags pa'i bdun tshigs kyi cho ga 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sdig pa sbyong ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/ ngan song sbyong ba 'gro ba rigs drug gi cho ga rnams slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa ste/ 'di dag ni paṇḍi ta su badzra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba gu rub chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/

'di la la rgya gzhung yin min the tshom za bar 'dug na'ang bla ma gong ma rnams rgya gzhung du bzhed cing*/ sngar gyi rnams la'ang bris 'dug pas bzhugs su bcug pa yin no// byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa don bcu gnyis bstan pa lung gi rjes su 'brangs pa siṅga la'i gling gi slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhi bcu pa'i 'grel pa 'di mdo phyogs su bzhed pa mi 'thad de/ gzhung nas rnal 'byor rgyud du gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'grel pa bar pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i skor la/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i gsang ba dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon chen po dpal ldan byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po smṛ ti dzñā na kīrti'i 'gyur/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa bklag pa'i sgom khog 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa zhes bya ba'i sbyin sreg gi rim pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yon tan 'byung gnas zhes bya ba rnams slob dpon dpal ldan byang chub mchog gi skal ba dang ldan pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa skye ba gcig la mtshan lnga thob pa'i slob dpon de'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po smṛ ti dzñā na kīrti'i 'gyur/ phyis slob dpon 'phags pa mchog gis zhus nas gtan la phab ste 'gyur phyi ma yang yin no// 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga slob dpon shāntiṃ garbhas mdzad pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i gsang ba ldan pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi 'grel pa ye shes gsal ba zhes bya ba dang*/ sgrub thabs gsang ba ldan pa'i thig gi cho ga spyan dbye ba'i cho ga rab gnas bcas pa rnams paṇḍi ta smṛ tis mdzad nas/ de nyid kyis sgra rang 'gyur du bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba dge bsnyen ma snyan grags dge mas mdzad pa/

'phags pa 'jam dpal rin po che'i cho ga dge bsnyen ma grags sbyin mas mdzad pa/ smṛ ti dzñā na kīrti'i rang 'gyur/ mtshan brjod 'grel chen gyi skor la/ nam mkha' dri ma med pa shin tu yongs su dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi snying po zhes bya ba slob dpon 'jam dpal grags dpe dngos pa mdzad 'gyur ci yang 'dus/ pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ de dag dang rjes su mthun pa dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sems can thams cad kyi bde ba skyed pa zhes bya ba rnams bzhugs so// //cu pa la/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa chung ba'i skor la/ byang chub kyi sems sgom pa dang*/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i cho ga mdo dang bsres pa slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa bar pa'i skor/ gsang ldan gyi dka' 'grel don bsdus sgron pa zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de wa ā ka ra tsand+ra dang*/ lo tsā ba klog skya'i 'gyur/ gsang ldan gyi tho yig don bsdus su mdzad pa/ smṛ ti dzñā na kīrtis mdzad pa/ de nyid kyi rang 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga paṇḍi ta shāntiṃ garbhas mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba smṛ ti dzñā na kīrti'i rang 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs gsang ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po pradzñā gu rus mdzad pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'khor lo'i rim pa/ mtshan ma byung*/ brjod kyi sgrub thabs rdo rje las bsgrub kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba slob dpon zla bzangs grags pas mdzad pa/ kha che'i mkhan po paṇḍi ta ma hā dza na dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims gzhon nu'i 'gyur/

mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa a wa dhū tī pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i skor la/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs/ yang 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'phags pa 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' de kho na nyid ces bya ba'i sgrub thabs rnams slob dpon gnyis su med pa sbas pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta dharma shrī mi tra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdor byas pa slob dpon mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' dang po'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po a wa dhū tīs mdzad pa/ dharma shrī mi tra dang*/ lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ mchod rten sgrub pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa slob dpon a ba dhū tī pas mdzad pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā shwa ka shrī dang*/ lo tsā ba 'a zha rgya gar brtsegs kyis 'gyur/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon a sho ka shrīs mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta dharma shrī mi tra dang*/ lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ gshin rje dgra nag po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs/ gtor ma'i cho ga 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi spyod lam gyi cho ga 'jam dpal rdo rje'i bum pa'i cho ga rnams slob dpon chen po mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa/ dpal o rgyan gyi mkhan po chen po dharma shrī mi tra'i zhal snga nas dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba/ ye shes sems dpa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon gnyis su med pa'i sbas pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta dharma shrī mi tra dang*/ lo tsā ba mgar chos bzang gi 'gyur/ 'di'i dgra nag 'jigs byed rnams kyang 'di nyid du bzhugs par bya'i/

gzhan du mi 'khyar bar bya'o zhes bu ston gyis gsungs/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon mi g.yo seng ges mdzad pa/ mar pa do pa'i 'gyur/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba pra bhā ka ras mdzad pa/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos thar pa gling gi gtsug lag khang chen por bsgyur ba/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs gnyan dar ma grags kyi rang 'gyur/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa klog pa'i man ngag kha che'i paṇḍi ta shākya shrī bha dras mdzad pa/ rnam pa nyi shus byang chub rim pas bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la bstod pa rnams slob dpon so ma shrīs mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ma hā dzā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu 'od kyi 'gyur/ 'jam dpal gyi gtor ma'i cho ga gcig rnams so// mtshan yang dag par brjod pa rnal 'byor gyi// rgyud du bkral ba'i 'grel skor bcu gnyis dang*// sgrub skor la sogs brgyad cu rtsa gsum ste// dril bas chos skor dgu bcu rtsa lnga bzhugs// de dag gis ni 'jam dpal mtshan brjod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du bstan pa'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs bkod zin to// //de ltar mtshan brjod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du bstan pa'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ da ni thams cad gsang ba dang ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi skor la/ dpal thams cad gsang ba'i bshad sbyar gsang ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/

rtsa rgyud de nyid bsdus pa'i dum bu gnyis pa khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dum bu las/ ngan 'gro dgug cing sdig pa sbyong ba las 'phros pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi skor la/ ngan song yongs su sbyong ba'i don gyi 'bru 'grel zhes bya ba slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad zer ba/ 'di paṇḍi tas chos gsung ba la lo tsā bas zin bris su byas pa yin nam yang zer/ 'phags pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba cho ga zhib mo'i rgyal po chen po'i rgya cher 'grel pa snying po rnam par bshad pa zhes bya ba dza landha ra'i rdo rje slob dpon kā ma dhe nu pa zhes bya ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ ā tsārya bi na ya tsand+ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis 'phen yul rgyal gyi lug lhas su bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //chu pa la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i rnam par bshad pa mdzes pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po rdo rje go cha'i slob ma slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad zer ba dang*/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa snang ba'i rgyan zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su bidyā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dbang phyug rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur zer ba gnyis bzhugs so// 'di la kun mkhyen bus sbyong rgyud kyi bshad pa byed lugs cung 'di nyid legs par gsungs pa dang*/ ngor pa rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyis 'khyin lo tsā ba dge tshul khyung grags kyis byas nas kun dga' snying po la kha 'phangs pa'i bod mar bzhed do// 'on te sngon gyi rnams kyis khungs mar bzung ste bcug pa ltar 'dir bris so//

rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po bla ma ni na shrī dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong g.yu rung 'od kyi 'gyur/ gtsug tor dgu'i rgyud la brten pa'i ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya buddhā shrī shānti dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'di rtsod med yang dag pa yin no// ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po sangs rgyas gsang ba dang*/ mañdzu shrī warma dang*/ bran ka mu ti'i 'gyur/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i ro'i sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon dharma kīrtis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya dharma pā la dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa yan chad rdzogs pa'i 'phro gcig slob dpon kun snying gis mdzad zer ba/ 'di bod ma 'dra ba cig 'dug ste sngar gyi rnams kyis kyang bris 'dug pas bris so// ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā nanda pa ra hi ta'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ ngan song sbyong

ma byung*/ ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta 'gro kun bzang pos mdzad pa/ dpal ldan byang chub rtse mo'i bka' drin las lo tsā ba mnga' ris pa rdo rje dpal gyis bsgyur ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po klu sgrub snying pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bai ro tsa na rakṣi ta dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba glan chung gi 'gyur la/ slad kyis stag lo tsā bas bcos pa/ de la brten nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa snying po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po dā ri ka pas mdzad pa/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag rdo rje lta bu zhes bya ba dpal kampa las mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na'i zhal snga nas/ bod kyi sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ de kho na nyid gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba dpal kampa la'i yum gyis mdzad pa/ mdo rgyas 'bring gi gleng gzhi'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnal 'byor rgyud du dgongs pa bkral te dkyil 'khor la bkod nas ston pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa dang*/ de la brten nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po ratna kīrtis mdzad pa/ bal po ma hā pa na'i rang 'gyur/ rab gnas kyi cho ga mdor bsdus pa slob dpon dad pa'i 'byung gnas go chas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kan ka warma dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul brgya lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du dgongs pa bkral ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na mi tras mdzad pa/ yi ge brgya pa'i cho ga slob dpon padma'i rdo rje lcags kyus stong phrag brgya pa las ji snyed pa rnams brjed du dogs nas bris pa/

yang yi ge brgya pa'i cho ga bsdus pa/ bzlas pa'i phreng ba'i mtshan nyid/ sku khrus kyi cho ga rnams paṇḍi ta pa ra hi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba nag tsho dge slong shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs las byung ba'i mchod rten sgrub pa'i cho ga rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang bsdebs te slob dpon zhi ba snying pos mdzad pa/ las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rgyun gcod par byed pa'i gzungs rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du dgongs pa bkral ba mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba rgyas pa dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ de'i dkyil chog las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par 'joms pa zhes pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dze tā ris mdzad pa/ bla ma gnyen dar ma grags kyi rang 'gyur/ yang mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ rdo rje chos kyi sgrub thabs lo chung legs pa'i shes rab kyi 'gyur ba 'di mdzad byang med pas/ sngar gyi rnams kyi bris 'dug pas bzhugs su bcug pa yin/ rgyan dam pa sna tshogs pa rim par phye ba bkod pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po sthi ra ma tis yo ga'i gzhung rgyud phyi nang las nges don mdor bsdus te mdzad pa/ bam po gcig pa/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis skad phyi mo dang gtugs pa'i 'gyur yin zer ba/ 'di rnying ma'am bod ma cig yin pa 'dra ste/ sngar gyi rnams kyis bris 'dug pas bzhugs su bcug pa rnams so// thams cad gsang ba ngan song sbyong rgyud dang*// sher phyin mi 'khrugs pa la sogs pa'i gzhung*// 'grel pa dag dang sgrub thabs la sogs skor// rnam grangs bzhi bcu tham pa legs par bzhugs// de dag gis ni thams cad gsang ba dang ngan song sbyong ba la sogs pa'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grags rnams bkod zin to//

//de ltar thams cad gsang ba dang sbyong rgyud la sogs pa'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi skor la/ nyu pa la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las rnam par snang mdzad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i don slob dpon shrī buddha gu hyas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dpal brtsegs rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ 'di la shlau ka nyis stong sum brgya yod do// rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud chen po'i 'grel bshad sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i stod dum bzhugs// //tu pa la/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i rgyud chen po'i 'grel bshad kyi smad dum slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas phyin ci ma log par mdzad pa/ dpal snar thang gi gtsug lag khang du bstan bcos bod kyi yul du 'gyur ba ji snyed pa bsdus pa'i tshe 'grel pa 'di'i dpe phyi mo ma dag cing gong 'og 'khrugs la bar bar nas cung zad ma tshang ba la brten pas bstan 'gyur thams cad du ma dag pa brgyud pa dang*/ skad gsar chad kyis gtan la ma phab pa'i 'gyur yang mi bde ba zhig snang bas/ skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba'i rgyud kyi tshig dang bstun te skad gsar bcad dang mthun par bcos pa 'di ni yul dbus kyi lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal zhes bya bas dpal rtse thang gi gtsug lag khang du bris pa zhes pa'i mtha' can/ rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par byang chub par rtogs pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga slob dpon skal bzang rab dgas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po padmā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga slob dpon rgyal ba'i 'od kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gsang ba'i rgyud kyi sgrub thabs dang las kun gyi gter zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa slob dpon lha sbas kyis mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po padmā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rig pa gzhon nu'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gsang ba'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon don yod pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi khro bo gshin rje gshed po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang*/ dngos grub kyi tshul nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba slob dpon don yod zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa gsang ba'i rgyud kyi rgya cher bshad pa gsham ma tshang ba cig rnams bzhugs so// rnam snang mngon byang rgyud 'grel la sogs skor// bzhi dang 'jam dpal gsang rgyud chos skor bzhi// khro bo rnam rgyal rtog pa'i 'grel pa gcig /spyod pa'i rgyud kyi chos skor dgu bzhugs so// de dag gis ni rnam snang mngon byang sogs spyod pa'i rgyud kyi chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar spyod pa'i rgyud kyi chos skor rnams bkod nas/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi skor la/ thu pa la/ bya ba spyi'i rgyud bsam gtan phyi ma rim par phye ba rgya cher bshad pa slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bidyā ka ra pra bha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i don slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ 'phags pa dpung bzangs kyis zhus pa'i rgyud kyi tshig gi don bshad pa'i brjed byang*/ 'phags pa dpung bzangs kyis zhus pa'i rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i don dgrol ba'i brjed byang*/ 'di bod kyis byas pa yin nam sems/ so so'i dgongs 'grel la/ dang po sku'i rigs 'jam dpal gyi skor la/ dpa' bo gcig tu sgrub pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa gtsug lag khang dza ga ta la'i paṇḍi ta su bhā ka ra zhes bya bas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta dā na shī las rang 'gyur du mdzad pa la/

bod kyi lo tsā ba rnams kyis legs par zhus pa/ gsung gi rigs thugs rje chen po'i 'grel pa ni mi snang ngo*// thugs kyi rigs phyag na rdo rje'i skor la/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi 'grel pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rgya brtson seng ges shrī nā lend+rar bsgyur cing zhus pa/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi gzungs kyi 'grel pa zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta chen po karma badzras mdzad pa/ dpal 'byung po 'dul byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po blo bzang skyong gis mdzad pa/ shlau ka'i grangs tshigs bcad bdun brgya pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta sgra pā ṇi ni yongs su rdzogs pa'i snyan ngag dang tshig gi sdeb la mkhas pa non ni paṇḍi ta dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba u rgyan pa rin chen dpal gyis ri bo chen po spu tra'i mgul du bsgyur ba/ phyag na rdo rje dang phyogs mthun pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi skor la/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi bshad pa slob dpon bo dhi sa twas mdzad pa/ de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi rnam par bshad pa rdo rje sgron ma zhes bya ba gsang sngags mtha' dag la mnga' brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi rgya cher 'grel pa rin po che gsal ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi grub pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ mkhan po de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba da bas mañdzu shrī warma'i 'gyur la/ phyis paṇḍi ta 'jon te ta'u la dang*/ lo tsā ba 'og bsod nams mos pa'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs zhes bya ba'i rnam par bshad pa dang*/

'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs rnam par bshad pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi 'grel pa slob dpon chen po rdo rje go chas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rnam par bshad pa slob dpon bde ba'i myu gus mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi 'grel pa dang*/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi man ngag paṇḍi ta smṛ ti dzñā na kīrtis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po de nyid kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba gzungs kyi 'grel pa rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po sa wa ri pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de wa puṇya ma ti dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs zhes bya ba'i rim par phye ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po theg pa chen po'i gsang sngags la mkhas pa slob dpon buddha gu hya dang*/ bod kyi zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ska ba dpal brtsegs rakṣi ta'i 'gyur la/ slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mkhas pa chen po rin chen bzang pos rgya dpe dang gtugs nas bcos zer ba/ de dag dang 'brel ba'i gtsug tor la sogs pa'i gzungs kyi skor la/ kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang dam tshig la rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi rnam par bshad pa slob dpon chen po dngos grub thob pa lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta dza ya de wa dang*/

zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba tshul khrims brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba gdugs dkar mo can zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa slob dpon shū raṅga warma badzras mdzad pa/ zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// //du pa la/ stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa'i mdo'i 'bum 'grel las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje'i rang 'gyur/ rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i mdo'i 'bum 'grel/ gsang sngags chen mo rjes su 'dzin pa'i mdo'i 'bum 'grel/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo'i 'bum 'grel zhes bya ba rnams slob dpon mkhas pa chen po las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta mkhas par grags pa mi mnyam rdo rje'i sras skye ba lnga brgyar sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu lnga rig la ma rmongs shing gsang sngags gdams pa thugs la mnga' ba'i mtshan don yod rdo rjer grags pas bod yul du byon nas/ 'dzam gling byang phyogs kyi brag dmar dpal bsam yas su rgyal po khri pa'i gdung brgyud kyi sras lha gcig lha lcam dar sgron gyi pho brang rdo lung dgon par rang 'gyur du mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// //nu pa la/ 'phags pa sgo drug pa'i gzungs kyi rnam par bshad pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa sgo mtha' yas pa sgrub pa'i gzungs rnam par bshad pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa dang*/ 'phags pa sgo mtha' yas pa sgrub pa'i gzungs kyi rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon ye shes snying pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ chos ma byung*/ spyod thams cad kyi mngon par rtogs pa'i man ngag gi rgyud kyi 'grel pa gzi brjid snang ba zhes bya ba klu'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ dge tshul khyung grags kyi 'gyur/ 'di rtsa 'grel gnyis ka rdzun ma yang dag pa cig 'dug ste/

nag tsho lo tsā ba yang dag tu bzhed pa yin zer nas/ sngar gyi rnams kyis bris 'dug pas 'dir yang bzhugs su bcug pa yin no// de ltar bya ba'i rgyud so so'i 'grel pa rnams bkod nas/ da ni de dag gi sgrub thabs dkyil chog la sogs pa'i skor la/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi lha gsum tshan lngar grags pa las/ dang po rigs kyi gtso bo gsum la/ sku'i rigs kyi gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad yin pas/ de dang phyogs mthun pa dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po'i yi ge brgya pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po ke dha ra ṇa dhis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta dpal go mi 'chi med dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'di spyod pa'i rgyud dang bskyed chog rnams mthun par bkod 'dug na'ang*/ rgyud 'grel dag las dam tshig gsum bkod bya rgyud du gsungs 'dug pas 'dir bris so// gsung gi rigs kyi gtso bo tshe dpag med kyi skor la/ tshe dpag med la bstod pa/ 'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sgrub thabs/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal bas bram ze nam mkha'i dbyings kyi bu'i ched du mdzad pa rnams rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī mañdzu dang*/ lo tsā ba lce dga' ba'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ rigs kyi bdag po gsum la/ sku'i rigs kyi bdag po 'jam dpal gyi skor la/ 'jam dpal rdo rje blo gros 'phel ba zhes bya ba slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'jam pa'i

ma byung*/ dbyangs kyi dpyad 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa shlau ka brgya pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge'i sgrub thabs rje btsun dam pa rgya gar gyi gdams pa/ zha ma seng rgyal gyi 'gyur/ rje btsun 'jam dpal shes rab 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po tsand+rā ka ra guptas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis 'gyur/ 'jam dpal g.yo ba'i 'khor lo'i man ngag kha che'i paṇḍi ta shākya shrī bha dras mdzad pa/ ngag gi dbang phyug la bu mo brgyad kyis bstod pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la khye'u bcu drug gis bstod pa/ 'phags pa ngag gi dbang phyug gtso 'khor lnga pa'i bstod pa paṇḍi ta thig le bum pas mdzad pa/ gur gum gzhon nu lta bu'i bstod pa slob dpon seng ge mi g.yo bas mdzad pa rnams rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa byin rlabs dang bcas pa snyan dngags mkhan rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu byang chub sems dpa'i rigs can mkhas pa chen po tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas pa chen po su ma ti kīrti'i zhal snga nas/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab dang mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po zhes bya ba'i bstod pa slob dpon rdo rje mtshon chas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa dang*/ bod kyi rngog lo tsā ba'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod pa rtog ge pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga slob dpon shraddhā ka ra warmas mdzad pa/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi bhū ti tsand+ra dang*/ chag lo tsā ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po shrī ban ratna'i bka' drin las/ lo tsā ba dge slong rgya mtshos sdes 'gyur rnying las cung zad bcos shing*/ rgya dpe dang rkang pa mthun par dpal gnod gnas kyi gtsug lag khang chen por 'gyur/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po shrī ban ratna'i spyan sngar chos 'khor lo tsā bas bsgyur ba la/ dge slong rgya mtsho bcos pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub pa'i thabs 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po ma tis mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi dza ga ta la'i paṇḍi ta chen po dā na shī las bod yul gyi dbus drang srong srin po'i rir lha'i skad las bod kyi brdar 'khrul pa med par bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa zhes bya ba dpal ldan mkhas pa rnams kyi nang nas rgyal mtshan rtse mo ltar shin tu mtho zhing gsal bar gyur pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po ma tis 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs dang bstun te bskyed rim gyi gsal 'debs bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bstod pa/ paṇḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba khro phu ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyis srin po'i rir bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa a ra pa tsa na'i mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ lo tsā ba dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos grub pa'i zhing dam pa mang yul skyid grong 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang po'i gtsug lag khang las mi ring ba'i chen po rnams kyi gdan sa dpal sher gyi gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba/

gsung gi rigs kyi bdag po thugs rje chen po'i skor la/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa lha lnga'i bstod pa slob dpon chen po tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba/ 'jig rten mgon po'i bstod pa yid 'phrog sdig 'joms zhes bya ba shar phyogs wa rend+ra'i slob dpon mkhas pa chen po tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ wa rend+ra'i dza ga ta la'i paṇḍi ta chen po dā na shī la'i rang 'gyur/ thugs rje chen po la bstod cing bskul ba dge bsnyen chen po zla bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pā ra me shwa ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa zhes bya ba tsarba ṭis mdzad pa/ sgra mkhan chen po rgyal ba'i snyan gyi zhal snga nas dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa lha lnga'i bstod pa paṇḍi ta chen po e ra ba tis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ lo tsā ba ba ri rin chen grags pa'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod pa grub thob chen po tsarba ṭis mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta nags kyi rin chen dang*/ lo tsā ba 'gos gzhon nu dpal gyi 'gyur/ dpal 'jig rten mgon po mkha' la spyod pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba grub chen padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po shrī ban ratna'i zhal snga nas dang*/ chos 'khor lo tsā bas bsgyur ba las/ slad kyis btsun pa rgya mtshos dag par bcos pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa brgya pa snyan dngags mkhan chen po shrī badzra de wa zhes bya bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po snyan dngags mkhan po ma hā paṇḍi ta lakṣ+mī ka ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shong ston gyi 'gyur/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la bstod pa dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa/

nor bu gling gi thugs rje chen po lha lnga la bstod pa slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod pa slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ thugs rje chen po la smre sngags kyis bstod pa zhes bya ba slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ thugs rje chen po la smre sngags kyis bstod pa byin rlabs can zhes bya ba lnga brgya pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu ltar gyur pa mthong lam rgyud las skyes pa'i gang zag slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ snying rje la bstod pa dge bsnyen kun sbyin gyis mdzad pa/ dpal 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod pa zhes bya ba dge slong ma zla mdzes kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi btsun pa tsand+ra shrīs ngag las 'byung ba dang rgya dpe dang bstun nas dge slong bsod nams rnam rgyal gyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyi bus bstod pa/ dpal nags kyi rin chen gyi zhal sngar bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs phyag stong pa'i sgrub thabs 'phags pa klu sgrub bdag nyid chen po mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rjer ldan pa sa drug pa'i byang sems yin yang sa dang po'i byang sems su byin gyis brlabs pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po slob dpon padma'i zhal snga nas bod kyi lo tsā ba btsun pa rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyis bsgyur ba/ rje btsun 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/

lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bstod pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bstod pa/ rje btsun thugs rje chen po la bstod pa rnams dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes grags pa la 'di'i rnam grangs ni/ thugs rje chen po kha sarpa ṇa'i sgrub thabs tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ thugs rje chen po ye shes sems dpa'i sgrub thabs/ spyan ras gzigs 'khor lo gsum bsgom pa/ thugs rje chen po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten mgon po tshad med bzhi'i sgrub thabs/ dpal 'jig rten mgon po yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ sems ngal bso ba'i thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs/ thugs rje chen po yi ge med pa'i sgrub thabs/ stong nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag dpal kha sarpa ṇi mar me sbar ba'i sgrub thabs/ dpal kha sarpa ṇi sku gsum gyi gdams pa/ thugs rje chen po mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ thugs rje chen po nam mkha' dri med kyi sgrub thabs/ thugs rje chen po nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgrub thabs/ spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal can gyi sgrub thabs/ dpal kha sarpa ṇi ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs/ dpal thugs rje chen po po ṭa la ke ri'i rtse mo'i sgrub thabs/ thugs rje chen po can dpal 'khor los sgyur ba'i sgrub thabs/ thugs rje chen po lus kyi 'khor lo 'bar ba/ thugs rje chen po dka' thub can gyi sgrub thabs/ dpal thugs rje chen po rtag tu bya ba'i rnal 'byor/ dpal 'jig rten mgon po sgrub pa'i man ngag thugs rje chen po'i gtor ma'i cho ga thugs rje chen po'i maṇḍal gyi cho ga thugs rje chen po'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga spyan ras gzigs kyi smon lam du bya ba/

dpal spyan ras gzigs bdud rtsi mnyes pa'i zas kyi cho ga rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po shrī mi tra'i gdams pa lus sbyin pa'i cho ga thugs rje chen po'i chu sbyin gyi cho ga dpal thugs rje chen po'i chab gtor gyi cho ga me'i mchod pa'i cho ga sku gzugs kyi cho ga sku gzugs dang mchod rten gyi cho ga ye shes spar ba'i gdams pa/ dri ma rnam dag gi cho ga chags nyams gso ba/ ting nge 'dzin myur du bskyed pa'i gdams ngag ting nge 'dzin brtan par byed pa'i gdams ngag sems brtan par byed pa/ byin rlabs mi zad pa'i cho ga 'khor lo 'bar ba/ dpal ngag gi mthu bskyed pa'i man ngag gsang sngags myur du 'grub pa'i cho ga rmi lam dri ma med pa'i bsgom pa/ rmi lam lta ba ngan pa rnam par zlog pa/ khro ba bsal ba/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i gdug pa 'dul ba'i cho ga skye bo gdul dka' ba rnams kyi snying gi dregs pa zhi bar byed pa'i sbyor ba/ bla ma'i man ngag dpal 'khor lo rnam dag gi sgrub thabs/ snying gi dug sbyong ba/ lus kyi 'khor lo bcing ba dang dgrol ba'i man ngag dpal rdo rje thod pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i sgrub thabs/ kha sarpa ṇi padma kha 'byed kyi man ngag thugs rje chen po gzugs brnyan la brten pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpal me tog gi gdan can gyi sgrub thabs/ me tog la brten pa'i sgrub thabs/ spyil bu can gyi sgrub thabs/ thugs rje chen po rnga sgra'i sgrub thabs/ nyi zla sgron ma'i cho ga grags pa bskyed pa'i cho ga gzi brjid bskyed pa'i cho ga sems mgu bar byed pa'i cho ga rmi lam ston pa/ yid 'gyod pa bsal ba/ longs spyod mi zad pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpag bsam gyi shing can gyi sgrub thabs/ bum pa bzang po can gyi sgrub thabs/ lam chen po'i sgrub thabs/ dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug wa ti can gyi sgrub thabs/ padmo'i sdong bu can gyi sgrub thabs/

spyan ras gzigs dri ma 'jig pa'i bum pa'i cho ga dpal rdo rje 'bar ba bsrung ba chen po'i man ngag srung ba'i 'khor lo/ rang srung ba'i cho ga gzhan skyab pa'i cho ga srung skud kyi cho ga gzhon nu bsrung ba'i cho ga dpal spyan ras gzigs kyi nad bsrung ba'i cho ga spyan ras gzigs kyi nad bsal ba'i cho ga 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi klu gso ba'i cho ga mdze'i nad gso ba/ gzhan las rnam par rgyal ba'i gdams ngag pha rol gyi gnod pa bsrung ba/ pha rol gyi sde gzhom pa/ pha rol dbang du bya ba/ chom rkun bcing ba/ slob ma la shes rab bskyed pa/ dpal spyan ras gzigs khros bas ser ba zlog pa'i cho ga rmi lam dri ma med pa bsgom pa/ slob ma byin gyis brlabs pa'i man ngag ye shes gzhug pa'i cho ga ting nge 'dzin gyi byin rlabs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur/ dpal ye shes 'bar ba'i 'khrul 'khor/ skye ba bsdams pa'i cho ga 'chi ba bslu ba'i gdams pa/ dpal lha'i grong khyer du 'jug pa/ rdo rje skar mda'i man ngag tshe 'das pa la bya ba'i cho ga ro bsreg cho ga sbyin sreg gi cho ga bkra shis kyi cho ga tsha tsha gdab pa'i cho ga rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rnams la brgya dang bzhi'o// 'di rnams grub pa brnyes pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po a dzi ta mi tra guptas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī dza ga ta mi trā nanda'i zhal snga nas dang*/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po buddha shrī dzñā nas gtan la phab nas/ bod kyi lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal bzang po zhes bya bas bsgyur ba/ 'di dag la rnal 'byor bla med dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi khongs su gtogs pa'ang snang mod kyi/ thugs rje chen po phyogs gcig tu bya ba'i phyir 'dir bris so// phyag stong spyan stong gi sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po dngos grub brnyes pa ta thā ga ta badzras mdzad pa/ mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas shar phyogs bhaṃ ga la'i paṇḍi ta nyi ma 'byung gnas zla ba dang*/

bod kyi lo tsā ba dge tshul khyung grags kyis 'dul ba'i bstan pa snying por gnas pa'i sa dpal ldan rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang du bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa la phan pa'i phyir bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'khor los sgyur ba'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dze tā ris mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta pūrṇa kīrti dang*/ sna nam rdo rje bla ma'i 'gyur/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal gyis nyung ngur bsdus te bsgyur ba/ yi ge drug pa'i rgyud kyi rim pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ma hā dza na dang*/ lo tsā ba gzhon nu 'od kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kha sarpa ṇi'i sgrub thabs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po pū dza badzras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs tshigs bcad bzhi pa dang*/ rnal 'byor snying po gnyis rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī dza ga ta mi tras mdzad pa/ de nyid dang*/ byams pa lo tsā'i 'gyur/ dpal kha sarpa ṇi 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu chen po shrī shānta ka ras mdzad pa/ bod kyi lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ kha sarpa

ma byung*/ ṇi lha lnga'i sgrub thabs ā tsārya padma ka ras mdzad pa/ chos 'khor lo tsā'i 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang phyug lha lnga'i sgrub thabs rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī mi tra ā nandas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ gnubs lo tsā'i 'gyur/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa dang*/ dpal chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra zhes bya ba'i bstod pa/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po ti la kas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba mal gyi 'gyur/ seng ge sgra'i srung ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ don yod zhags pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga gso sbyong blang ba/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i gso sbyong gi cho ga'i man ngag rnams kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po shākya shrī bha dras mdzad cing*/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rab mchog dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi rigs kyi skor la/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba 'jam dpal go cha'i 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du bkral ba la/ phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs su grags pa'i chos skor ni/ gos sngon po can gyi dngos grub nye bar byed pa'i mchod rten gyi man ngag gnod pa sel ba'i bdud rtsi/ rdo rje byab pa'i las tshogs/ yan lag bdun pa'i sgrub thabs rnams slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ phyag na rdo rje sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba 'grel pa las gzungs sgrub thabs su mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba gta'i gtor ma'i gdams ngag

'khor lo'i man ngag ces bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi gzungs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ sde dpon bzhi'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa/ don 'grel sgron ma/ sgrub pa'i go rim/ bum pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ de kho na nyid sgron ma zhes bya ba/ phyag na rdo rje'i spur bsad las tshogs bsdus pa rnams slob dpon su wā gī shwa ra kīrtis mdzad pa dang*/ phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs kyi man ngag lag tu blang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ gsang sngags bzlas brjod kyi man ngag nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po rdo rje sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba rnams slob dpon bīrya tsand+ras mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po shraddhā ka ra warmas mdzad pa/ rten 'brel gyi bsrung ba rnams jo bo rje dang*/ rgya brtson 'grus seng ge'i 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal stong nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ rang gi bla ma nyid las thos nas khams pa dge slong ba ri lo tsā ba chen po rin chen grags pas bsgyur cing*/ slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po a bhi yukta dang zhus dag byas nas gtan la phab pa/ phyag na rdo rje gos dkar can gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon klu sgrub dang 'gro bzang snying pos don gcig tu bsdebs pa rnams so// 'di dag la rgya gzhung yin min the tshom za ba ci rigs pa snang zhing*/ gzungs kyi ngo bo bya rgyud du gsal yang*/ bskyed chog dang*/ dbang chog rnams rnal 'byor gyi rgyud bzhin byas snang ngo*// dpal phyag na rdo rje la mtshan

ma byung*/ nyid bsdus pa'i sgo nas bstod pa slob dpon bīrya tsand+ras mdzad pa dang*/ phyag na rdo rje la don rtags kyi sgo nas bstod pa slob dpon dī paṃ kā ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba brgya brtson 'grus seng ge'i 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa bsdus pa gcig phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzangs kyi skor la/ phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzangs ma byung*/ ma'i sgrub thabs/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi chu gtor/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi klu gtor/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rnams slob dpon 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta te dza de wa dang*/ zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po dngos grub brnyes pa'i mkhas pa chen po nyin mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī ku mā ra ka la sha'i rang 'gyur/ dpal phyag na rdo rje gtum po chen po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon bram ze nyin mdzad rdo rjes mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje rdo rje snying po'i man ngag ces bya ba'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta dzñā na shrīs mdzad pa/ rig sngags gtad pa'i cho ga rgya gar gyi mkhan po nag po pa dang*/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po stong nyid ting nge 'dzin snying rje'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba khams pa ba ri dge slong rin chen grags kyi 'gyur/ khro bo rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ de'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/

bsrung ba'i cho ga las thams cad pa zhes bya ba rnams slob dpon ba su ta badzras mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor bsod snyoms pa pradzñā shrī dzñā na kīrti'i rang 'gyur/ khro bo'i rgyal po phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon su tsand+ra bha dras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi nā ya tsand+ra dang*/ lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dpal 'byung po 'dul byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po blo bzang skyong gis mdzad pa/ 'di'i shlau ka'i grangs tshigs bcad bdun brgya pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta sgra pā ṇi ni yongs su rdzogs pa'i snyan dngags la mkhas pa non ni paṇḍi ta dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba u rgyan pa rin chen dpal gyis ri bo chen po spu tra'i mgul du 'gyur/ dkyil 'khor drug gi cho ga rin po che'i mig thur zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po shū raṅga warmas mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dga' ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po rdo rje go chas mdzad pa/ bod kyi lo tsā ba pu rangs bsod nams blo gros kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i khrus kyi cho ga'i 'grel pa dang*/ las kyi mtha' bco brgyad pa'i man ngag slob dpon rdo rje go chas mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i khrus kyi cho ga slob dpon byang chub snying pos mdzad pa/ 'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bram ze dza ya warmas mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs dpal gaṅgā dha ras mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la bstod pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i bum pa'i cho ga

zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi sgrub pa'i cho ga rnams bram ze ma ṇi badzras mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi sgrub pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi sgrub pa'i bum pa'i cho ga rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las bzhi sgrub pa'i 'khor lo'i cho ga rnams paṇḍi ta chen po dzñā na shrīs mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga byang chub sems dpa' 'byams pa'i zhabs rdul la reg pa dpal gaṅgā dha ra'i sras kyi thu bo bram ze ma ṇi badzras mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las sna tshogs sgrub pa'i cho ga paṇḍi ta chen po dzñā na shrīs mdzad pa rnams paṇḍi ta dzñā na shrī dang*/ lo tsā ba rab zhi bshes gnyen gyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs cho ga zhib mo dang bcas pa bram ze rig sngags 'chang ba mkhas pa chen po ku mā ra se nās mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po buddha gupta dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dbang mañdzu shrī warma'i 'gyur la/ phyis paṇḍi ta dzñon teng hang ngu dang*/ lo tsā ba da 'og bsod nams mos pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa zhes bya ba dang*/ 'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi gtor ma'i cho ga'i rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dba' mañdzu shrī warma'i 'gyur/ las kyi thabs zhes bya ba dang*/ 'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i khrus kyi cho ga slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ khrus kyi cho ga'i rim pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi man ngag paṇḍi ta smṛ ti dzñā na kīrtis mdzad pa/

paṇḍi ta chen po de nyid kyi rang 'gyur/ rnam 'joms sa wa ri'i skor la/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rin chen snang ba zhes bya ba dang*/ rdo rje khro bos bsad pa'i las zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon chen po sa wa ri pas mdzad pa/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gtum po zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs o rgyan gyi slob dpon a mo pa nā tha zhes bya bas mdzad pa dang*/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga slob dpon chen po bram ze pa ra ma tis mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa gtum po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po dngos grub brnyes pa'i sa pa ri pas mdzad pa rnams bal po'i paṇḍi ta de ba pūrṇa ma ti dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus ma byung*/ kyi cho ga sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa 'gyur byang med pa/ rnam 'joms sgrub ma byung*/ skor slob dpon gaṅgā dha ras mdzad pa 'gyur byang med pa rnams bzhugs so// //pu pa la/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lag len go rim ji lta ba zhes kyang bya/ gzhan la phan pa zhes kyang bya ba rig sngags 'chang gi slob dpon ratna shrī pha las mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po badzra bo dhi dang*/ lo tsā ba tshul dge rin chen gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba dang*/ 'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba dang*/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po ratna kīrtis mdzad pa rnams bal po'i paṇḍi ta ma hā pā na'i rang 'gyur/ slob dpon ye shes rdo rje dang*/ slob dpon padma la sogs pas mdzad zer ba'i rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa las/

rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dbang bskur gyi cho ga dang*/ dam tshig bsrung ba slob dpon padmas mdzad pa/ khro bo brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba slob dpon dpal mar me mdzad kyis rgyud la brten nas mdzad pa/ lha mo brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i bdud rtsi'i bum pa'i cho ga dpal yab yum gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba bde sbyin dam pa zhes bya ba/ bdud rtsi thab sbyor zhes bya ba khro bo bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga zab mo/ sgo ma bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rin po che dri ma med pa zhes bya ba/ rgyal po bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ phyogs skyong bcu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ gza' chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga nyi ma bcud len zhes bya ba/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje go cha ma zhes bya ba/ lha chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs pa'i lam ston par byed pa zhes bya ba/ klu chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dug las rgyal ba zhes bya ba/ snga ma dang da lta dang phyi ma'i sdig pa ma lus pa las thar bar byed pa 'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga 'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rnams slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i las la sbyar ba 'grub par nges pa'i cho ga man ngag gi sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i tshe dang stobs sgrub pa zhes bya ba/ rgyud kyi bden pa'i don nges par sgrub pa rnal 'byor pa'i pra se na legs par brtags pa/ 'dod pa'i don dus la nges par sgrub pa/

rgyud kyi brten pa zhes bya ba'i tshig legs par sgrub pa zhes bya ba/ rgyud thams cad thogs pa med pa'i tshig legs par sgrub pa zhes bya ba/ mna' las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs/ tshong las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs/ pha rol gyi sde rab tu 'joms par byed pa'i sgrub thabs/ rang rtags rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs bdun pa las kyi bye brag bcu rnams slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bsgrub bya gza'i byang du gzhug pa'i 'khor lo can/ the tshom med par 'grub pa las bsgrub bya thog gis bsad pa'i cho ga drag shul zhes bya ba/ bsgrub bya skrag pa'i las chu thigs zhes bya ba/ 'gal ba skrag par byed pa'i las sna tshogs pa'i cho ga 'gal ba ma'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba rnams dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa/ gzhan gyi rig sngags gcod pa rgyun gcod spu gri zhes bya ba/ gzhan gyi rig sngags mnan pa gser gyi ri bo zhes bya ba/ las thams cad 'joms pa'i ye shes 'dus pa'i tho ba zhes bya ba/ gzhan gyi rig sngags bshig pa'i phyir bzlog pa zhes bya ba/ gzhan gyi las 'jig par byed pa rdo rje rnon po zhes bya ba/ mu stegs can gyi rig sngags 'jig pa'i sgrub pa nye ba'i las phyi ma zhes bya ba/ gdon thams cad brlag par byed pa rdo rje tho ba zhes bya ba/ lha'i gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag 'byung po'i gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag dri za'i gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag tshangs pa'i gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag srin po'i gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag sha za'i gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag klu'i gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag log 'dren gyi gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag rjed byed kyi gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag smyo byed kyi gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag lha ma yin gyi gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag gzhon nu'i gdon bzhi las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag

gnod sbyin gyi gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag 'byung po 'gugs pa'i sgrub pa rdo rje lcags kyu zhes bya ba/ las kyi bye brag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bkod pa yid bzhin nor bu 'od 'bar ba zhes bya ba/ gzungs sngags kyi las ma grub pa rnams grub par byed pa'i rdo rje be con zhes bya ba/ gzungs sngags kyi las grub pa rnams chud mi za bar byed pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba rnams slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ klu'i char dbab pa bdud rtsi'i rgyun zhes bya ba/ klu rnams mnyes par byed pa chu la brten pa'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ sems can bsrung ba'i las sprin dral ba'i 'byung ba gcod byed ces bya ba rnams dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa/ byis pa gdon las thar bar byed pa'i sgrub thabs gsang ba me'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgyud kyi zhi ba'i mtshan don zhes bya ba/ rgyud kyi rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i tshig legs par bsgrub pa rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi rgyas par byed pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mngon spyod kyi sbyin sreg gi sgo nas tshar bcad pa'i las dbang du bya ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga sems can thams cad rengs par byed pa'i las jag chings 'phrul yig ces bya ba/ bsgrub bya rengs pa'i las sna tshogs pa bstan pa rlung gi zhags pa zhes bya ba rnams slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bsgrub bya klu rnams kyi byed du gzhug pa'i cho ga sreg gcod kyi spu gri zhes bya ba dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa/ tsha ba'i rims kyis dgra bsad pa'i ral gri'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ sems can thams cad rmugs par byed pa'i las kyi mtha' gzi mdangs chen po zhes bya ba/ dpal bkra shis bskyed pa nyi ma'i 'od ces bya ba dpal kun gyis brgyan pa'i mtha'/ mig gi dbang po nyams pa gso ba'i cho ga gsal ba'i snang ba zhes bya ba/

rna ba'i dbang po nyams pa dang de'i nad gso ba'i cho ga dgra las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba/ sna'i dbang po nyams pa dang na ba gso ba dri ma dang bral ba'i sbyong byed ces bya ba/ lce'i dbang po nyams pa gsol ba'i cho ga padma rgyas pa zhes bya ba/ lus kyi dbang po nyams pa dang lus na ba gsol ba'i cho ga rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba/ tshe zad pa bsring ba'i cho ga rgyun gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba rnams slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ shi ba'i sems can sdig pa las thar bar byed pa'i ro bsreg pa'i cho ga dug sbyong gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba dang*/ mchod rten gdab pa shi ba'i sdig pa byang bar byed pa rang byung 'jigs bral zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ sems can tshe zad pa bsring ba'i cho ga sgrub pa padma dbyig sgrub ces bya ba/ dal 'byor chen po'i sgrub pa bcud kyis len pa zhes bya ba/ lan chags dang bral bar byed pa'i gtor ma'i las dpag bsam gyi sdong po zhes bya ba/ longs spyod dang ldan par nges pa'i dpal tshogs kyi gtor ma rin po che'i gser phreng zhes bya ba/ phun sum tshogs pa'i las kyi nye bar sgrub par byed pa las tshogs stong rgyas zhes bya ba rnams slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'jig rten gyi lha mnyes par byed pa don grub pa zhes bya ba dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa/ skye bo sdang ba'i las myur byed chen mo zhes bya ba/ gzhan gyi lce 'bab pa bzlog pa zhes bya ba/ sdang ba gsum gyi las thor bu pa/ bran dang bza' mi gdon gyis gtses pa bsrung ba'i cho ga chen mo zhes bya ba/ mi mthun pa zhi bar byed pa'i rtsi sbyor dbyig gi nor bu zhes bya ba/ nor 'grib pa dgang ba'i cho ga dpag bsam gyi shing rgyas pa zhes bya ba rnams slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ tshogs bdag gi sgrub pa dbul ba gter sbyin zhes bya ba dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa/

sbas pa'i ga'u zhes bya ba slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ gza' ngan pa bzlog pa'i cho ga rgya mtsho sprin zhes bya ba/ gza'i gdon las grol bar byed pa'i cho ga rin po che grol byed ces bya ba/ gza' brgyad kyi las ma grub pa rnams grub par byed pa'i cho ga 'dod pa rab tu zhi ba zhes bya ba/ rgyu skar ngan pa zlog par byed pa'i cho ga rgyu skar rnams kyi las sna tshogs pa sgrub par byed pa dus 'dzin bzang po zhes bya ba rnams dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa/ bzlog pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ klu chen po brgyad mchod pas mi bzad pa'i nad yams drag po las thar bar byed pa/ klu sgrub rin po che dbyig sgrub ces bya ba/ klu'i gdon las grol bar byed pa sbrul 'dzin gsang ba zhes bya ba/ klu'i srog med dbal gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba klu'i rnam par 'joms pa'i snying gzer du bkod pa rnams slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ mi zad pa'i nad zhi bar byed pa gser gyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ tshe 'phel ba'i sgrub thabs rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo zhes bya ba/ bsod nams 'phel bar byed pa'i dpal ye shes kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba rnams slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sgra la gnas pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya ba/ sgra la mi gnas pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya ba rnal 'byor pa'i 'khor rkyen drungs nas 'don pa/ sgra mthar gyis rnal 'byor pa'i lus sems kyi 'brel pa bcad pa rnams slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i thim yig gsang ba zhes bya ba slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ de rnams la chos kyi rnam grangs brgya dang brgyad do// khro bo'i rgyal po gnam lcags 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs klu 'dul ba'i ngan thabs bal po'i man ngag dang*/ khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gnam lcags 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la bzhugs pa'i bla ma mai tri pas mdzad pa/

paṇḍi ta bal po de ba puṇya badzra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gar chos kyi bzang pos bal yul du 'gyur/ rigs kyi yum spyan ma dang*/ gos dkar mo dang*/ mā ma kī gsum gyi sgrub thabs so sor bkod pa ni mi snang la/ phyogs mthun ni 'og na mar 'god par bya'o// rigs kyi khro bo gsum la/ sku'i rigs kyi khro bo gshin rje gshed po sgrub pa'i thabs rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ gsung gi rigs rta mgrin gyi skor la/ rta mgrin gyis sgrub thabs slob dpon nā gārdzu nas mdzad pa/ dge slong ba ri'i 'gyur/ rtog pa bdun brgya pa nas gsungs pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba dang*/ rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ rgyud thams cad kyi snying po bla na med pa rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta pra bhā ka ras mdzad pa rnams rgya gar yul wā rā ṇa sī'i paṇḍi ta pu ru ṣotta ma'i zhal snga nas legs par mnyan te/ lo tsā ba dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gtsug lag khang chen po dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba dang*/ dpal rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ thugs kyi rigs khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sgrub thabs dngos su ni mi snang ngo*// de'i phyogs mthun mi g.yo ba'i skor la/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba bla ma gser gling pas mdzad pa/ slob dpon dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas rang 'gyur du mdzad nas dge slong dbang phyug rgyal mtshan la gnang ba/ khro bo'i rgyal po 'phags pa mi g.yo ba la bstod pa dang*/ yang khro bo'i rgyal po 'phags pa mi g.yo ba la bstod pa slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ khro chen gtum po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon pra bhā ka ra kīrtis mdzad pa/ mkhas pa chen po sbyin pa tshul khrims kyi rang 'gyur/ khro bo gtum po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta suṇyā ya shrī dang*/ lo tsā ba klog skya gzhon nu 'bar gyi 'gyur/ gtum po dkar po chen po'i sgrub thabs lhug pa ma dang*/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po dā na shī las mdzad pa/ de nyid kyi rang 'gyur/ de ltar rigs gsum po so so'i sgrub thabs rnams bkod nas/ rigs gsum spyi'i sgrub thabs ni/ legs par grub par byed pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs bsdus pa bde bar gshegs pa'i sras po slob dpon byang chub mchog gi mdzad pa/ dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i sgrub thabs zhes dge ba'i 'dod 'jo'i rnam par bshad pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po nag po pa dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ gtsug tor la sogs pa gzungs sna tshogs kyi skor la/ 'phags pa kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs bklag cing mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad dam mchod rten lnga gdab pa'i cho ga mdo sde las btus pa dang*/ yang 'phags pa kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba'i gzungs bklag cing mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad dam mchod rten lnga gdab pa'i cho ga mdo sde las btus pa slob dpon bo dhi sa twas mdzad par grags pa/ bi ma la uṣṇī ṣa'i gzungs dang rgyud dag pa las tsai tya dang sātstsha gdab pa la sogs pa'i cho ga ā tsārya dharma kīrti dang*/ badzra kīrti dang badzra bo dhi la sogs pa la thos nas slob dpon de dag gis lung bstan te gtan la phab par byas pa'i dang po mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad bya ba/

mchod rten gcig gdab pa'i cho ga mchod rten gnyis gdab pa'i cho ga mchod rten gsum gdab pa'i cho ga mchod rten lnga gdab pa'i cho ga mchod rten dgu gdab pa'i cho ga mchod rten bye ba gdab pa'i cho ga sangs rgyas kyi sku bshad pa rnams btsan po'i phyag nas mkhan pos btus pa/ mchod rten gyi cha rnam par dbye ba 'dul ba las byung ba'i mdo slob dpon zhi ba snying pos mdzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig bsrung ba'i sgrub thabs rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ sātstsha lnga gdab pa'i cho ga gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs chog yang gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs chog slob dpon dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ de nyid dang*/ nag tsho tshul rgyal gyi 'gyur/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa gdugs dkar mo can gyi gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ tho ling gi gtsug lag khang du dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs/ srung ba'i 'khor lo/ 'khrul 'khor bcing ba/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba bzlog pa'i thabs/ bgegs bzlog cing gzir ba'i thabs/ dmag dpung gzhom pa'i thabs/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i thabs/ ser ba srung ba'i thabs/ mdze nad gdug pa can gso ba'i thabs/ gtor ma'i cho ga paṇḍi ta ma hā dza na'i rang 'gyur yin gsungs/ gdugs dkar mo can gyi

ma byung*/ gzungs kyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ rims bsrung ba'i cho ga phyugs nad gor bsrung ba'i cho ga zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mngon spyod kyi las/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i sgo nas sri'u gso ba/ bzlog pa'i zor bya ba'i cho ga mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho ga'i rim pa rnams slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ zangs dkar 'phags pa lo tsā'i 'gyur/ gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga slob dpon rdo rje rnon pos mdzad pa/ 'phags ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba dang*/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can gyi sātstsha'i cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon padma'i lcags kyus mdzad pa/ zangs dkar lo tsā bas tho ling gi gtsug lag khang du 'gyur/ gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdug dkar mo can gyi cho ga zhes bya ba slob dpon shu raṅga warma badzras mdzad pa/ zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo la bstod pa/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba'i nye bar bshad pa bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong ba ri'i 'gyur/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa gdugs dkar mo can zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon gi ri wa tas mdzad pa/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba mang du thos pa'i slob dpon padma'i lcags kyus rigs ldan ha ra pa'i slob dpon ka ma la dhe nu pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas sbyar ba/

ā tsārya bi nā ya tsand+ra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa sgrub pa'i thabs/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta bi bhū ti tsand+ra dang*/ glo bo lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab rin chen gyi 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma la bstod pa slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ 'phags ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo la bstod pa slob dpon gi ri wa tas mdzad pa/ srung ba lnga'i skor la/ 'phags pa ma rig pa chen mo so so 'brang ma'i 'khor lo'i sems sbyong slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chos kyi sde dang*/ lo tsā ba dge tshul nam mkha' rdo rje'i 'gyur/ so sor 'brang ma'i 'khor lo bri ba'i thabs slob dpon ratna ā ka ra shānti pas mdzad pa/ so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs/ rma bya chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs/ gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma'i sgrub thabs/ bsil ba'i tshal chen mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po dze ta ri dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa/ so sor 'brang ma chen mo'i srung ba slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta su ma ti kīrti dang*/ lo tsā ba chen po dharma kīrti'i 'gyur/ 'phags ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo'i rig pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba rgya gar yul wā rā ṇa sīr paṇḍi ta pu ru ṣotta ma'i zhal las legs par mnyan te/ lo tsā ba dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gtsug lag khang chen po thar pa gling du 'gyur/ srung ba lnga'i cho ga slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po mu di ta shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba bande bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba las/ slar chag chos rje dpal gyis bcos pa/ so sor 'brang ma chen mo'i 'khor lo bri ba'i cho ga slob dpon dze tā ris mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ma ti kīrti dang*/ dge slong pra dzñā kīrti'i 'gyur/ srung ba lnga'i sgrub thabs dang mdo ma byung*/ klog pa'i cho ga bal po'i dpe las mnga' ris pa rdo rje dpal gyis bsgyur ba/ srung ba lnga'i mchod pa'i cho ga dang*/ gza' dgu'i mchod pa'i cho ga rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta nags kyi rin chen gyis nyid kyi slob dpon hang sa zhes bya ba'i gsung zin bris su bgyis pa'i yi ge las rtses thang lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa dra bi ta'i bum pa'i cho ga rim par phye ba/ rab gnas kyi cho ga slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ khams pa lo tsā ba ba ri'i 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo sde'i man ngag de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i gzungs bklag pa'i cho ga mdo sde las btus pa/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i mdo sde bklag cing de bzhin gshegs pa bdun mchod de smon lam gdab pa'i cho ga mdo sde las btus te rim par bklag pa mkhan po bo dhi sa twas mdzad pa 'di gsum cho ga rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yin no// gzungs thams cad kyi sgrub thabs rim pa gnyis pa zhes bya ba/ gzungs thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ sgrub thabs thams cad kyi las kyi bya ba rnams slob dpon chen po ratna kīrtis mdzad pa/ bal po ma hā pā na'i rang 'gyur/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po'i cho ga zhib mo mkhan po nar ban rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga paṇḍi ta dpal su ma ti kīrtis mdzad pa/ mkhas pa de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba pradzñā kīrti'i 'gyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //'dir bkod pa'i sgrub thabs 'ga' zhig rnal 'byor rgyud dang mthun pa dang*/
