spyod rgyud dang mthun pa'i bskyed chog tu byas pa ci rigs pa snang yang brten pa'i rgyud phal cher bya rgyud du snang ba dang*/ sde tshan phyogs gcig tu snang ba'i phyir 'dir bkod do zhes kun mkhyen bus gsungs so// sku gsung thugs kyi rigs gsum gtsor gyur pa'i// bya ba'i rgyud dang 'brel ba'i 'grel pa dang*// sgrub skor la sogs chos skor brgya phrag bzhi// bcu phrag bdun la lnga yis spras pa bzhugs// de dag gis ni bya ba'i rgyud kyi chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar rgyud sde so so ba dang 'brel ba'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ rgyud sde bzhi thun mong ba ci rigs pa dang 'brel ba'i dgongs 'grel bstan bcos kyi skor la/ phu pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje phreng ba zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta chen po gnas brtan a bha yā ka ra guptas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba kher gad bande 'khor lo grags kyi 'gyur la/ dus phyis lo tsā ba shes rab dpal gyis bcos shing*/ slad nas paṇḍi ta ratna rakṣi ta dang*/ rā hu la shrī bha dra dang*/ ma ni ka shrī dzñā na dang*/ chag chos rje dpal gyis bcos pa las/ slad nas dpang lo tsā ba blo brtan gyis mi bcos su mi rung ba rnams bcos nas dag par byas pa/ rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba shlau ka stong nyis brgya pa rdo rje phag mos mngon sum du byin gyis brlabs pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta chen po thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpal bzang pos 'gyur rnying pa la brten nas smon 'gro'i gtsug lag khang du rang 'gyur du mdzad cing*/ yang paṇḍi ta de nyid kyis lan gnyis su zhus shing gtugs/ slad kyis rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta chen po mkhas btsun mchog gi grub pa brnyes pa bla ma rje btsun chen po re wend+ra'i zhal snga nas/

chag lo tsā ba dge slong dpal gyi mtha' can gyis zhus shing dag par bsgyur nas bcos pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'od kyi snye ma zhes bya ba rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po a bha yā ka ra guptas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta chen po thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen dpal bzang pos bod yul gyi dbus drang srong srin po rir rang 'gyur du mdzad pa la/ slad kyis paṇḍi ta chen po rig pa'i gnas rnams thugs su chud pa'i mkhas pa dag dang grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu chen po rnams kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis thugs gtams shing de kho na nyid la gzhol ba'i slob dpon nyi ma'i dbang po'i 'od zer dang*/ chag lo tsā ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyis legs par bsgyur zhing bcos pa la/ dus phyis shong lo tsā ba dge slong blo brtan gyis legs par bcos shing dag par byas pa/ tshigs bcad brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //pa tshab tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa'i rnam grangs la/ dang por 'phags pa sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa/ de nas rim gyis dam tshig gsum gyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta chen po ku mud 'byung gnas blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta a bha yā ka ra'i zhal snga nas pa tshab kyi brgyud kyi dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dam tshig gsum rgyal gyi rtog pa nas gsungs pa rdo rje 'dzin pas legs par gsungs pa'i bstod pa/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud rdo rje dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan las gsungs pa'i bstod pa'i phan yon/ dam tshig gsum gyi dam tshig gi sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta chen po rin chen 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ gdams ngag gi rim pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gdan gyi sgrub thabs/ yang rdo rje gdan gyi sgrub thabs gcig 'phags pa yi ge drug par rig pa chen mo'i sgrub thabs/

'phags pa yi ge drug pa rig pa chen po rje btsun 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gdams ngag rgyud nas 'ongs pa'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga yi ge drug pa'i gdams ngag gi khyad par rnams pa tshab tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ bde ba 'byung ba'i kharsa pa ṇi'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta ratna ā ka ra gupta dang*/ dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ bde ba 'byung ba kharsa pa ṇi zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs padma 'byung gnas blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta a bha yā ka ra dang*/ dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ seng ge sgra'i gzungs/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta ratna ā ka ra dang*/ dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ snying rje khros pa zhes bya ba'i ha la ha la 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs a bha ya dang*/ tshul rgyal gyi 'gyur/ snying rje khros pa'i ha la ha la'i sgrub thabs dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ padma gar gyi dbang phyug ces bya ba'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs dang*/ padma gar gyi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs mkhas pa ratna ā ka ra'i zhal snga nas tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ seng ge dang bya khyung dang khyab 'jug la bzhugs pa las byung ba'i sgrub thabs/ seng ge dang bya khyung dang khyab 'jug la bzhugs pa las byung ba'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ o rgyan nas byung ba'i rim pa 'jig rten gsum dbang du byed pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs sa ra ha'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ a bha ya'i zhabs drung nas pa tshab tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ au ḍi yā na nas rnam par byung ba'i 'jig rten dbang phyug 'jig rten gsum dbang du byed pa'i sgrub thabs sa ra ha'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ mkhas pa ratna ā ka ra dang*/ dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po'i sgrub thabs/

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lugs kyi 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta chen po shānta ā ka ra dang*/ dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta ārya ā ka ra dang*/ pa tshab kyi 'gyur/ tshig lhug pa'i brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa dpal dang ldan pa 'jam dpal gsung gi mnga' bdag gi sgrub thabs/ gsung gi mnga' bdag gi sgrub thabs/ spros pa med pa'i sgrub thabs/ spros pa med pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba tshig lhug pa'i a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ 'phral du nyams su myong ba'i spros pa med pa'i sgrub thabs/ lha lnga'i khyad par gyi gdams ngag rdo rje lus med kyi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal rdo rje lus med kyi sgrub thabs/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ chos kyi dbyings ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs las dbang du bya ba'i cho ga chos kyi dung gi ting nge 'dzin thob par byed pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs rnams paṇḍi ta a bha ya las/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ ngag gi sgrub pa'i thabs ngag grub pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po shānta rakṣi ta la sogs pa'i zhal snga nas mnyan te dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ ngag sgrub pa'i thabs/ rgyal po chen po brjid pa zhes bya ba'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i sgrub thabs/ yang dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i sgrub thabs/ khor yug mngar ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ dbang du byed pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las byung ba'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ shes rab mngon par bskyed pa/ shes rab 'phel ba'i cho ga 'jam dpal gyi shes rab 'khor lo/

'phags ma seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma chen mo zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rnams paṇḍi ta chen po a bha yā ka ra'i zhal snga nas dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ yang rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs mkhas pa chen po byang chub sems dpa' dang a bha ya la sogs pa las dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rgya nag po'i lugs kyi 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ gdams ngag gi khyad par gyi sgrub thabs/ rgya nag chen po'i lugs kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'chi ba bslu bar byed pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ yang sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ yang sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ dug sel ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma nor sbyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma las byung ba'i ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs rtog pa las gsungs pa/ sgrol ma las byung ba'i ku ru kulle'i tshig lhug pa'i sgrub thabs/ ku ru kulle'i dbang du bya ba'i gdams ngag gdams ngag gi khyad par/ ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs/ yang ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs ind+ra bhū tis zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ bung ba'i rnal 'byor gyi ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs/ yang ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs/ yang ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs rnams a bha yā ka ra'i zhal snga nas dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ o rgyan nas nges par byung ba'i ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs mkhas pa chen po byang chub sems dpa' ma la ba dā na shrī dzñā na'i zhal snga nas dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ gser mdog gi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta chen po a bha ya'i zhal snga nas dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ mdor bsdus pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta chen po mā la ba zhes bya ba dā byang chub sems dpa'i zhal snga nas dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ gzhan yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs dang*/ dbyangs can ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs mkhas pa a bha ya las dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs ma la ba zhes bya ba dā'i zhal snga nas dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'phags ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta chen po dā dang a bha ya dang ā ma ra la sogs pa las dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// //bu pa la/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can dkar mo'i sgrub thabs dang*/ mya ngan med pa la dga' ba'i 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs mkhas pa dā na shrī dang*/ dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rtog pa nas gsungs pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta chen po a bha ya'i zhal snga nas dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ yang 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ o rgyan gyi 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ o ḍi yā na nas byung ba'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs o rgyan nas 'byung ba'i bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa'i sgrub thabs/ mya ngan med pa la dga' ba'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ gdams ngag gi khyad par/ 'phags ma 'od zer can gyi gzungs 'don pa'i man ngag nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs rnams paṇḍi ta chen po a bha ya las dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs dang*/ nor rgyun ma'i gzungs kyi man ngag dā byang chub sems dpa' las dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma'i sgrub thabs ma la ba'i zhal snga nas dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/

gdams ngag gi khyad par gzhan gyi rdo rje lcags sgrog ma'i sgrub thabs a bha ya'i zhal snga nas dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ khro gnyer can gyi sgrub thabs ma la ba'i zhal snga nas dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ yang khro gnyer can gyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma dug sel ma'i gzungs rnams a bha ya'i zhal snga nas dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'phags ma dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs byang chub sems dpa'i zhal snga nas dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ skul byed ma'i sgrub thabs a bha ya'i zhal snga nas dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta chen po dā dang a bha ya las dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma gdugs dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje tsartsi ka'i sgrub thabs/ so sor 'brang ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ rma bya chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma'i sgrub thabs/ gsang sngags kyi rjes su 'brang ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ bsil ba'i tshal chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ gdams ngag gzhan gyis lha lnga legs par bstan pa zhes bya ba/ phyir bzlog ma chen mo/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dri ldan ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma rab tu dang ba'i sgrub thabs rnams a bha ya'i zhal snga nas tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ gtum mo cher khros pa'i yan lag dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po dā dang a bha ya las dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ khro bo gtum po chen po'i sgrub thabs a bha ya las tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ byams pa'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta chen po shānta dang a bha ya las dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/

yang byams pa'i sgrub thabs/ dzambha la chen po'i sgrub thabs/ dzambha la'i sgrub thabs rnams a bha ya las dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dzambha la'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta dā dang a bha ya las tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ yang dzambha la'i sgrub thabs a bha ya las tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dzambha la'i sgrub thabs dang*/ mdor bsdus pa'i dzambha la'i sgrub thabs dā las dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dpal dzambha la'i sgrub thabs dang*/ dzambha la'i rgyun 'babs pa'i gdams ngag a bha ya las dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dzambha la'i gdams ngag dā dang a bha ya'i zhal snga nas dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ gdams ngag gi khyad par a bha ya las dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dzambha la'i khyad par gyi gdams ngag dā dang a bha ya las dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje me 'bar ba'i gzi brjid kyi sgrub thabs/ rta mchog gi sgrub thabs/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/ yang gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/ yang gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje mthar mdzad kyi sgrub thabs/ yang gshin rje mthar byed kyis sgrub thabs/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs/ gtor ma'i cho ga rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi sgrub thabs/ stobs po che'i sgrub thabs/ he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa rnams a bha ya las dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dges pa rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ bdag med ma 'ba' zhig gi sgrub thabs dā dang a bha ya las dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje phag mo dbang du bya ba'i cho ga

rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje phag mo'i rtog pa don thams cad sgrub par byed pa/ dpal o rgyan gyi rdo rje gdan nas nges par byung ba'i rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs/ mdor bsdus pa'i rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs rnams a bha ya'i zhal snga nas dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs dā dang a bha ya'i zhal snga nas dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ dpal 'byung po 'dul byed kyi mdor bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs yan lag dang bcas pa 'jig rten gsum gyi rdo rjes mdzes par bsdebs pa/ mgon po nag po'i sgrub thabs rnams paṇḍi ta a bha ya la sogs pa las dge slong pa tshab tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur ro// de ltar na sgrub thabs brgya dang drug cu rtsa bzhi bzhugs shing*/ 'di rnams saṃ skṛ ta'i skad mchog tu gyur cing don bzang la gdams ngag che ba rnams paṇḍi ta chen po a bha ya'i phyag dpe las paṇḍi ta chen po de dag dang*/ pa tshab kyi rigs su skyes pa'i dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis legs par bsgyur ba/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba kun las btus pa dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon chen po paṇḍi ta a wa dhū tī pa dpal ldan 'gro ba'i me long gis mdzad pa/ bi kra ma shī la'i paṇḍi ta chen po mañdzu shrī dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/ slar yang dpal ldan byang chub rtse mo'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa dge slong badzra shrīs kyang bcos shing dag par bgyis pa'o// //mu pa la/ ba ri ba'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa las/ rje btsun rdo rje gdan gyi man ngag gi sgrub thabs kyi cho ga khams pa ba ri lo tsā'i 'gyur/ brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i cho ga rgya gar gyi mkhan po bīrya bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/

brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon bha wa skandhas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong ba ri'i 'gyur/ tshig lhug pa'i brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ tshig lhug pa'i a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gupta dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ rgyal po chen po 'jam dpal rol pa'i sgrub thabs/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod du gsungs pa'i mdor bsdus pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod kyis bsdus pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'jam dpal gyi shes rab kyi sbyor ba/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ chos kyi dbyings ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub pa'i thabs/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal shes rab 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ 'phral du nyams su myong ba'i a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/ yang gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/ yang gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong ba ri'i 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje chos kyi sgrub thabs slob dpon su dza na bha dras mdzad pa/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong ba ri'i 'gyur/ ha la ha la'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ kharsa pa ṇi'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ yi ge drug pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs dpal lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/

ha ri ha ri ha ri la zhon par gyur pa'i spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub pa'i thabs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ ha la ha la'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i ros pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong ba ri'i 'gyur/ padma gar gyi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rdo rje myu gus mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal pos mdzad pa/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub pa'i thabs ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i slob ma'i thu bos mdzad pa/ o rgyan gyi 'od zer can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ rtog pa nas gsungs pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i cho gas 'od zer can dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ o rgyan gyi 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ o rgyan gyi rim pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ tsunda'i sgrub thabs/ dpal gnod gnas kyi mdor bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon tsand+ra go mas mdzad pa/ u tstshusma dzambha la'i sgrub pa'i thabs rnal 'byor pa dga' ba sbyin gyis mdzad pa/ lha mo nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/ khro gnyer can gyi sgrub thabs/ byams pa'i sgrub thabs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dge 'dun sbyin gyi sras kyis mdzad pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ mdor bsdus pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/

mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs pra bhā ka ra kīrtis mdzad pa/ gtum po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ ri khrod ma lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma ri khrod ma lo ma can gyi gzungs sngags/ 'phags ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ bgegs dgra'i sgrub thabs/ ral gcig ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'phags ma dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs/ dug sel ma'i gzungs/ lha mo rigs byed ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i lha mo rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ lha mo rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ o ḍi yā na nas byung ba'i rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon sa ra has mdzad pa/ dpal gnod gnas kyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ rgya nag po'i rim pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ so sor 'brang ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma rma bya chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma'i sgrub thabs/ gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma'i sgrub thabs/ bsil ba'i tshal chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ phyir bzlog ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs/ rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje gandha rī'i sgrub thabs/ dpal mgon po nag po'i sgrub thabs bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje lcags sgrog gi sgrub thabs/ stobs po che'i sgrub thabs/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma zhes bya ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi sgrub thabs/ rta mgrin gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'i he ru ka'i sgrub thabs/ bdag med ma gcig pu'i sgrub thabs/

bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs/ gser mdog can gyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ rtog pa las brgyud pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs/ rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis gsungs pa/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rim pa'i spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa/ de rnams paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong ba ri chos grags kyi 'gyur/ 'di rnams la chos kyi rnam grangs dgu bcu go drug yod do// //lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'i sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rkang grangs la/ sgrub thabs kun las btus sam dam tshig gsum gyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta chen po ku mu ta 'byung ba'i blo gros zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dam tshig gsum gyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ dpal rdo rje gdan gyi sgrub thabs kyi man ngag gi cho ga rdo rje gdan gyi sgrub thabs/ yang rdo rje gdan gyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa yi ge drug pa rig pa chen mo'i sgrub thabs dpal lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs za ma tog bkod pa'i man ngag gis mdzad pa/ 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs/ yi gi drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa kharsa pā ṇi'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs slob dpon rnyogs pa med pas mdzad pa/ po ta la'i kharsa pā ṇi'i sgrub thabs slob dpon padma 'byung gnas blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ dpal kharsa pā ṇi'i sgrub thabs dge slong dge byed kyis mdzad pa/ dpal mkha' spyod 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs cung zad rgyas par byas pa a nu ba ma rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ dpal ldan mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta a wa dhū tī dpal ldan gnyis med rdo rje'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/

'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ha la ha la'i sgrub thabs/ ha la ha la'i sgrub thabs slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje chos kyi sgrub thabs cho ga bsdus pa/ 'jig rten mgon po padma gar gyi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ padma gar gyi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ ha ri ha ri ha ri la zhon par gyur pa'i sgrub thabs/ ha ri ha ri ha ri la zhon par gyur pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ o ḍi yā na rim pa'i 'jig rten gsum dbang du byed pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs sa ra ha'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ o ḍi yā na nas byung zhing sa ra ha'i zhabs kyis gdan drangs pa'i 'jig rten gsum dbang du byed pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gis lhag par dbang du bya ba'i cho ga bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mgrin pa sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rim pa'i spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ shes rab bskyed pa padma'i phyag gi gzungs/ sran ma ma ṣa'i gzungs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten gsum dbang du byed pa'i 'phags pa bhugma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dpal ldan shū n+ya tā sa mā dhi badzra pā das mdzad pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon bha ba skandhas mdzad pa/ tshig lhug pa'i brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/

dpal ldan ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta dpal ldan yid bzhin nor bu sbyin pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas gsungs pa'i 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan 'phags pa ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ shes rab 'phel ba'i gter gyi ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs dpal ldan paṇḍi ta 'phrog byed 'joms pas mdzad pa/ ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs slob dpon mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ tshig lhug pa'i a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal bsgom pa'i man ngag 'phral du nyams su myong ba'i a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal yan lag med pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ chos kyi dbyings ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ chos kyi dbyings ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs kyis dbang du bya ba'i cho ga sems can thams cad dbang du byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ chos kyi dbyings ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ ngag gi sgrub thabs/ dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i sgrub thabs/ ngag gi sgrub thabs gcig 'jam dpal rgyal po chen po rol pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal rdo rje dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i sgrub thabs/ bung ba myos pa'i sgrub thabs/ lhag par dbang du byed pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las byung ba'i bsdus pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod so so nas bsdus pa'i 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs/ shes rab 'phel ba'i cho ga mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i man ngag shes rab 'khor lo'i dngos grub mchog gi sgrub thabs/

chos kyi dung gi ting nge 'dzin 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ yi ge gcig pa'i rab tu sbyor ba cung zad pa/ gtum po chen po'i sgrub thabs cho ga dang bcas pa slob dpon 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pas mdzad pa/ gtum po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ yang gtum po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ yang gtum po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ sgrol ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ mchog sbyin sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ dbang du byed pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon rdo rje myu gus mdzad pa/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta chen po chos 'byung zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta chen po rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs cung zad rgyas pa paṇḍi ta gnas brtan chen po dpe med srung bas mdzad pa/ 'phags pa 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ rgya nag rim pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ rgya nag chen po'i rim pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i slob ma thu bos mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal pos mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma sgrol ma dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma nor sbyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'od dpag med kyi snying po'i rgyud las bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rtog pa gsungs pa/

ngan song las sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ lha mo sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i man ngag gi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ sna tshogs yum gyi cho ga don thams cad rab tu grub pa sbyin pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i cho ga 'phags ma dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma dug sel ma'i gzungs/ 'phags ma dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma dug sel ma'i rig sngags chen mo/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma dug sel ma'i rtog pa/ 'phags ma dzaṃ gu lī'i sgrub thabs/ 'od zer 'bar zhing mche ba gtsigs pa ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang ral pa gcig ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs/ ral pa gcig ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang ral pa gcig ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon klu sgrub kyis bod nas gdan drangs pa/ tsunda'i sgrub thabs/ yang tsunda'i sgrub thabs/ yang tsunda'i sgrub thabs/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can dkar mo phyag bcu pa'i sgrub thabs/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i cho ga 'od zer can dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ 'od zer can phyag brgyad ma ser mo'i sgrub thabs/ sku mdog dmar mo phyag bcu gnyis ma o ḍi yā na'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ yang sku mdog dmar mo phyag bcu gnyis ma o ḍi yā na'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ sku mdog dmar mo phyag bcu gnyis pa'i o ḍi yā na'i rang byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta slob dpon snying po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/

dpal 'od zer can pi tsu pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ 'phags ma 'od zer can gyi gzungs 'don pa'i man ngag ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs/ yang ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma ri khrod lo ma can gyi gzungs/ dpal ldan nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo'i sgrub thabs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dge 'dun sbyin gyi bus mdzad pa/ yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta dpal ldan padma 'phel gyis mdzad pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma gser mdog can gyi sgrub thabs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ gser mdog can gyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ dbyangs can ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ yang rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje pi wang dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud las byung ba'i rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ khro gnyer can gyi sgrub thabs/ yang khro gnyer can gyi sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma'i rtog pa las byung ba'i ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma'i rtog pa las byung ba'i tshig lhug pa'i rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ ku ru kulle'i dbang du byed pa'i man ngag

rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan 'phags ma rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ o ḍi yā na nas byung ba'i rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ rigs byed ma'i sgrub thabs dpal lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ kye rdo rje'i rim pa'i ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs/ ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs dpal kye rdo rje'i rgyud las phyung ba snyan dngags mkhan chen po brtse ba can zhes bya bas tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa/ rje btsun ma ku ru kulle phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ rigs byed ma phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ rigs byed ma phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs ind+ra bhū ti'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs/ rigs byed ma'i man ngag gi rim pa kheg pa rigs byed ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rnal 'byor gyi rgyud chen po stong phrag bcu drug pa las byung ba'i ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs mchog tu gyur pa slob dpon dpal nag po spyod pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs/ ku ru kulle'i las rab tu skyong ba sbyor ba/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma gdugs dkar mo can gyi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje tsartsi ka'i sgrub thabs/ so so 'brang ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ yang so so 'brang ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ yang so so 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma rma bya chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma gsang sngags chen mo rjes su 'dzin ma'i sgrub thabs/ bsil ba'i tshal chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ lha mo lnga'i sgrub thabs mdor bstan pa/ phyir bzlog ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje ghandha rī'i sgrub thabs/

yang rdo rje gandha rī'i sgrub thabs/ srung ba lnga'i cho ga rdo rje lcags sgrog gi sgrub thabs/ man ngag gi rim pa'i nang nas byung ba'i rdo rje lcags sgrog gi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje lcags sgrog gi sgrub thabs kyi cho ga rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta chos kyi 'byung gnas blo gros zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs/ lha mo nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/ nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/ yang nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/ nor rgyun ma'i gzungs kyi man ngag rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta chen po a wa dhu tī pa dpal ldan gnyis med rdo rje'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ shes rab kyi snang ba bsgrub pa'i cho ga rdo rje phag mos dbang du bya ba'i cho ga dpal rdo rje phag mo'i rtog pa las gsungs pa'i don thams cad grub pa/ byams pa'i sgrub thabs/ yang byams pa'i sgrub thabs/ khro zhing dgyes pa dzambha la'i sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ dzambha la'i sgrub thabs bzhi/ bar gyi man ngag dzambha la'i sgrub thabs/ dpal dzambha la'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa slob dpon chen po tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ yang dzambha la'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ dzambha la'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa/ dpal ldan dzambha la'i sgrub thabs/ dzambha la la chu rgyun dbul ba'i man ngag rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ rtog pa bdun brgya pa las gsungs pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ rgyud thams cad kyi snying po phyi ma'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs paṇḍi ta pra bhā ka ras mdzad pa/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs/ rta mchog gi sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs/

gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/ yang gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje dgra nag po'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs/ yang gshin rje mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi sgrub thabs/ stobs po che'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa stobs po che'i sgrub thabs/ yang 'phags pa khro bo stobs po che'i sgrub thabs dge slong shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ ārya tsand+ras rang 'gyur du mdzad pa la sgra bag tsam bcos/ he ru ka'i sgrub thabs/ dgyes pa rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs tā ra shrīs mdzad zer ba/ bdag med ma rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs/ dpal 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs kyi cho ga dam pa thams cad 'dren pa'i 'jig rten gsum gyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ dpal ldan nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ yang dpal ldan nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs rnams so// lha so so'i sgrub thabs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di rnams ni dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen por paṇḍi ta chen po gau tam shrī las brgyud cing paṇḍi ta chen po kīrti tsand+ra'i zhal snga nas zhus te/ de shānta ri yo gi grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bya lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i dkar po'i tshes gsum la dben gnas dam pa chu mig rdzing khar yongs su rdzogs par bsgyur ba/ 'di la chos kyi rnam grangs nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa lnga bzhugs so// //klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon bdag nyid chen po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ yig brgya'i cho ga slob dpon padmas mdzad pa/ 'phags pa byams pa'i sgrub thabs kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po shākya shrī bzang pos mdzad pa/

de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa byams pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ jo bo chen po dang dge bshes ston pa'i 'gyur la/ dus phyis paṇḍi ta chen po buddha shrī dang*/ gnubs lo tsā bas dag par bcos pa/ dpal mi pham mgon po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon nai ri ti pas mdzad pa/ gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa kharsa pa ṇi 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs/ lha mo sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rgyal po chen po sgeg pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa gshin rje gshed kyi sgrub thabs/ lha mo nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/ ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs/ gnod gnas kyi sgrub thabs/ khro gnyer can gyi sgrub thabs/ lha mo 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs rnams slob dpon chen po phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes pa dri ma med pa'i lhas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bcu gcig lha mo 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ yang lha mo 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ yang 'phags ma 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon mya ngan med pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta su ma ti kīrti dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mkhas pa mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje'i 'gyur/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/

lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ slad kyi rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta dā na shī la dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba blo gros grags pas bcos pa/ sgrol ma tshe 'phel ba'i cho ga slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ ma hā paṇḍi ta ratna rakṣi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba zhang grub pa dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/ dpal chen mo sgrol ma'i bstod pa zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta chen po tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po rgyal ba'i snyan gyi zhal snga nas/ lo tsā ba dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis lo tsā ba blo gros rgyal po'i 'gyur la cung zad dag par bcos pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bstod pa phrin las thams cad sgrub pa/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bstod pa me tog phreng ba/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi bstod pa/ 'phags pa 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rnams slob dpon chen po tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba las/ slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po byang chub sems dpa' dā na shrī dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mal gyo blo gros grags pas bcos pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i slob ma thu bos mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ lo tsā ba khams pa dge slong ba ri'i 'gyur/ sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa dang*/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po bha ba bha ṭas mdzad pa/ ma hā paṇḍi ta shrī bi ma la kīrti'i zhal snga nas dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa zhang grub pa dpal bzang pos bal po'i grong khyer yam bu'i nub phyogs nyi ma'i gtsug lag khang du 'gyur/

sgrol ma yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma'i khrus kyi cho ga gso sbyong gi cho ga rnams sgrol ma'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon bha wa bha dras mdzad pa/ ma hā paṇḍi ta shrī ratna rakṣi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba zhang grub pa dpal gyi 'gyur/ sgrol ma'i maṇḍal gyi cho ga snyan dngags mkhan chen po snying rje chen pos mdzad pa/ sgrol ma mchog sgrub pa zhes bya ba dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa/ 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta ta thā ga ta bha dra dang*/ dge slong 'phags pas rgya'i yul cong to'i mkhar du bsgyur ba/ dpal sgrol ma dkar mo 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrub thabs slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa/ dpal chos kyi rje sa'i steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba paṇḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra dang*/ sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs dā byang chub sems dpas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta ta thā ga ta rakṣi ta dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rin chen grags pa'i 'gyur/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 'phags ma lha mo sgrol ma bsgom pa'i cho ga rgyas pa slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po dul ba'i lha dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa dī paṃ kā ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/

'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po buddha ka ra warma dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ chom rkun bcing ba zhes bya ba'i rim pa ma hā paṇḍi ta shrī ratna rakṣi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba zhang grub pa dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rjes su spyod pa'i gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs rgya gar gyi mkhan po bai ro tsa na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dar ma blo gros kyi 'gyur/ me tog phreng 'dzin sgrol ma'i bstod pa dang bcas pa'i bsgrub pa ma hā paṇḍi ta ratna rakṣi ta pā da'i zhal snga nas lo tsā ba grub pa dpal bzang po'i 'gyur/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i bstod pa slob dpon ma ti tsai tras mdzad pa/ rje btsun ma 'phags pa sgrol ma la bstod pa chos kyi rje paṇḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pas mdzad pa/ yang 'phags ma lha mo sgrol ma la bstod pa/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bla ma chen po shākya shrī bha dras mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs dza ga ta la'i paṇḍi ta chen po bi bhū ti tsand+ra'i rang 'gyur/ dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs bram ze phur bus mdzad pa/ tshangs pa'i bu mo dbyangs can ma la bstod pas grub pa ngag gi 'od zer zhes bya ba lha mo nyid kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i bram ze phur bus mdzad pa/ sum pa lo tsā ba dharma yon tan gyi 'gyur/ dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa paṇḍi ta nag mo khol gyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta dzñā na shī la dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ dpal rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs snyan dngags mkhan chen po slob dpon zla ba gzhon nus mdzad pa/ rnam par bshad pa'i paṇḍi ta mkhas pa chen po buddha shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ dpal lha mo nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma nor rgyun ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/

dpal nor rgyun ma'i smon lam/ dpal nor rgyun ma'i bstod pa rnams dpang lo tsā ba dpal ldan blo gros brtan pas zhol bug tu rgya dpe las bsgyur cing zhus pa'i yi ge pa ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin chen mtha' can yin no// mkha' lding grub pa'i bstan bcos bram ze shang kus mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal bram ze a wa dhū tī pa chen po dpe med kyi spyan sngar lo tsā ba bande pradzñā kīrti'i 'gyur/ lha mo dbyangs can gyi bstod pa lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byung ba'i mkhas pa chen po paṇḍi ta nag mo khol gyis dbyangs can ma zhal gzigs pa'i dus su dgyes te bstod pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta dzñā na shī la dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos 'bar gyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// lha so so sna tshogs kyi sgrub thabs 'di rnams rgyud sde sna tshogs nas btus pa dang*/ rgyud sde mtha' dag gcig tu ma nges pa rnams 'dir thun mong du bkod pa'o// //tsu pa la/ dkyil 'khor spyi'i bya ba dang 'brel pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mdor bsdus pa slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po sangs rgyas gsang bas dbas mañdzu shrī dang*/ bran ka mu di ta gnyis la brdzangs pa/ bod yul du lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ gzhal yas khang gsal ba'i mngon rtogs mun sel sgron me zhes bya ba slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad zer ba rnams so// rgyud sde bzhi po spyi dang 'brel pa dang*// khyad par so so'i sgrub thabs sna tshogs pa'i// gzhung lugs ngo mtshar brgya phrag lnga dang ni// bcu phrag bdun la gcig gis brgyan pa bzhugs// de dag gis ni rgyud sde bzhi po sna tshogs dang 'brel pa'i sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog la sogs pa'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar rgyud sde bzhi po sna tshogs dang 'brel pa'i sgrub dkyil la sogs pa'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/

da ni theg pa gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la sogs pa'i khyad par dang*/ mtshan nyid kyi rnam gzhag dang*/ bsgom rim la sogs gtan la 'bebs pa'i skor la/ tshul gsum gyi sgron ma slob dpon chen po mtho btsun tri pi ṭa ka ma las mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po padma ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ de kho na nyid grub pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ slad kyis paṇḍi ta ku mā ra ka la sha dang*/ lo tsā ba 'bro shākya 'od kyis tshad ma'i skabs bcos shing gtan la phab pa/ de kho na nyid la 'jug pa zhes bya ba bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' ma lus pa mdor bsdus te bshad pa'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon dpal ye shes grags pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta padma ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ gsang sngags kyi tshul gyi snang ba zhes bya ba rdo rje slob dpon chen po mtho btsun tso yag gis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po padma ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ de kho na nyid kyi snying po bsdus pa slob dpon chos kyi dbang pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dza nar dā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ theg pa gsum rnam par gzhag pa zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas pa chen po rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛṣṇa pa dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi don la 'jug pa bsdus pa slob dpon shraddhā ka ra warmas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shraddhā ka ra warma de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/

rdo rje theg pa'i mtha' gnyis sel ba slob dpon dzñā na shrīs bkod pa/ de nyid mthong ba'i lam dpal ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba rngog buddha pā las dpal shing kun du tshogs 'khor sar gsol ba btab nas lha khang bi hā rar bsgyur ba/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa'i man ngag ces bya ba phyag rgya chen po rnal du mtshon par byed pa slob dpon chen po badzra pā ṇis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dhi roṣkṛ dzñā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba 'brog mi jo sras kyi 'gyur/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon skal ba bzang po'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang*/ sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur/ gsang sngags la 'jug pa'i rab tu byed pa drug cu pa slob dpon dzñā na ā ka ras mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta dzñā na ā ka ra nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ gsang sngags la 'jug pa'i rab tu byed pa drug cu pa'i 'grel pa paṇḍi ta ā tsārya dzñā na ā ka ras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na ā ka ra nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //tshu pa la/ theg pa chen po'i don bsdus pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛṣṇa pa de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la sogs pa'i rnam gzhag gi skor la/ bla ma lnga bcu pa slob dpon chen po rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po padma ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i dka' 'grel rgya gar shar phyogs kyi mkhas pa chen po dpal nags kyi rin chen gyi bka' drin las/ mkhas pa gzhon nu dpal gyis dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i dben gnas lha khang steng du 'gyur/

spyi'i dam tshig mdor bsdus pa dpal sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ tshul khrims dang sdom pa dang dam tshig dang mi 'gal ba zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas pa chen po ye shes dpal bzang pos mdzad pa/ kha che'i mkhan po dzñā na shrī bha dra de nyid dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong blo gros snying po dang*/ dge slong rab zhi bshes gnyen gnyis kyi 'gyur/ dam tshig thams cad bsdus pa zhes bya ba mkhas pa chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ rje btsun bla ma chen po de nyid kyi zhal snga nas dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ las dang po pa'i dam tshig mdor bsdus pa dbang pos mtshan pa'i yul gyi rtsa na gnas pa'i slob dpon dzñā na bo dhis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gupta dang*/ lo tsā ba bsod nams rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ sdom gsum 'od kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba rgya gar shar phyogs dza ga ta la'i paṇḍi ta chen po bi bhū ti tsand+ras mdzad de/ de nyid kyi rang 'gyur/ rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i las kyi cho ga bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta a bha yā ka ra gupta dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags kyis bsgyur ba/ zhen log sgron ma zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad zer ba 'di the tshom gyi gzhi gcig snang bas mjug tu bkod pa yin no// chos skyong dang nor lha la sogs pa'i skor la/ rnam sras kyi sgrub thabs rnam sras bde byed kyi rtog pa dang*/ rnam sras drag byed kyi cho ga slob dpon 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar dbus kyi paṇḍi ta chen po te dza de wa dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ gnod sbyin rgyal po rnam sras gsang ba'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgyal po chen po lus ngan po'i sgrub thabs grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa/

sgra pa chen po rgyal ba'i snyan la legs par zhus shing*/ lo tsā ba dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal thar pa gling gi gtsug lag khang du legs par bsgyur ba/ rnam thos sras kyi sgrub pa'i thabs slob dpon shū raṅgā warmas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta te dza de wa dang*/ lo tsā ba zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ bai sha wa ṇa'i rtog pa dang bstod pa/ bde byed kyi rnam sras kyi rtog pa cho ga sna tshogs pa'i mdzod/ rnam sras kyi bstod

ma byung*/ pa thugs rje ba 'jo zhes bya ba snyan dngags kyi phreng ba slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta te dza de wa dang*/ lo tsā ba zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs 'di rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro las phyung ba'o// tshogs kyi bdag po gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba dpal dngos grub brnyes pa'i paṇḍi ta a mo gha badzras mdzad pa/ tshogs kyi bdag po chags pa rdo rje'i dam tshig gi bstod pa paṇḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ tshogs kyi bdag po sprin gyi sgron ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon bram ze rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs 'jur gegs sel ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po ind+ra bhū tis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ges yam bu karta rir legs par bsgyur/ 'chol ba'i sgrub thabs sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po dā na shī la'i rang 'gyur/ rmugs 'dzin 'chol ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta a bha yā ka ra guptas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta a laṅka de wa dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims 'byung gnas sbas pas chos 'khor shod ma'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba la/ slad kyis paṇḍi ta ma hā bi bhū ti tsand+ra dang*/ chag lo tsā ba dge slong chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur zhing dag par bcos pa/ dzambha la'i sgrub thabs rgyal po ārya ma tis mdzad pa/ dge slong dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ dpal rmugs 'dzin 'chol ba nag po'i sgrub thabs gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba sbas pa bum pa 'khyil pa zhes bya ba slob dpon nor sbyin gyis mdzad pa/ dpal chos kyi rje sa'i steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i paṇḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra dang*/

bod kyi lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bod yul gyi dbus ngam shod kyi mthil bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang rgyal po'i pho brang yid bzhin nor bu'i mdzod dbu rtse rim gsum lha khang gi steng du legs par bsgyur ba/ dzambha la nag po'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa paṇa chen shākya shrīs zhal nas gsungs pa/ de nyid dang*/ gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin chu'i dbang po la phrin las nyi shu'i sgo nas khyad par gyi bstod pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po nor 'dzin dpal gyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po buddha shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis mang yul gyi grong gi 'phags pa wa ti'i pho brang du bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin la bstod pa slob dpon chen po btsun pa zla bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po mu di ta shrī dzñā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis legs par bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin la bstod pa paṇḍi ta dzñā na badzras mdzad pa/ dzambha la la bstod pa mi'i dbang po nyi ma rnam par gnon pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma dha ra dang*/ yar lung pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ rmugs 'dzin 'chol ba'i man ngag gi bstod pa bla ma dā byang chub sems dpas mdzad pa/ kha cig slob dpon nyi ma sbas pas mdzad zer ro// lha mo nor rgyun ma'i bstod pa paṇḍi ta dza ma ris mdzad cing*/ de nyid kyi rang 'gyur/ dpal lha mo nor rgyun ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di ni mkhas pa chen po zhwa lu lo tsā ba dge slong dharma pā la bha dra'i 'gyur/ gnod sbyin chen po gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rgyud rgya gar gyi bla ma dza ma ri'i 'gyur/ rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud las dkyil 'khor bdun pa'i rim pa rnam par phye ba'i sgrub thabs te legs ldan nag po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon snang mdzad myu gus mdzad pa 'di rnying ma yin pa 'dra'o zhes bu ston rjes gsungs so// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi sogs kyi// spyi yi rnam gzhag sngags kyi theg pa yi// dam tshig la sogs gsal bar ston pa'i gzhung*// bcu phrag lnga la gcig gis brgyan pa bzhugs// de dag gis ni sde snod dang rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag dang*/

sngags kyi theg pa'i dam tshig la sogs pa ston pa'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi sogs kyi spyi'i rnam gzhag dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa'i dam tshig ston pa'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ da ni gnas chen du bgrod tshul dang*/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i skor la/ po ṭa la kar 'gro ba'i lam yig rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal snga nas gsungs pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta a bhi yukta de wa shrī dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dharma yon tan gyis ji ltar rnyed par bsgyur/ byang chub chen po mdor bstan pa zhes rdo rje gdan gyi bkod pa zhwa lu lo tsā bas pho brang chen po sne'u gdong gi gtsug lag khang du rgya gar gyi dpe las bod kyi skad du bsgyur ba/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i gsol 'debs bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta bai ro tsa na dang*/ lo tsā ba shrī chos kyi grags pa'i 'gyur/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams dpal zhes bya ba la bstod pa/ rgya gar lho phyogs kyi yul dpal ldan 'bras phung zhes bya ba'i mchod rten bzhugs pa'i gnas der bla ma man lungs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa rlabs po che byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa dang cha mthun pa la mos pa'i paṇḍi ta bi ma la shrī zhes bya ba mkhas shing btsun pa des tshigs su bcad pas bstod pa/ dpal ldan man lungs kyi gtsug lag khang chen por paṇḍi ta gau taṃ bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba grags pa byang chub gnyis kyi 'gyur/ maṇḍal dang sātstsha la sogs pa'i nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi chos spyod kyi skor la/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon mkhas pa chen po kampa la'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ sngon gyi lo tsā ba rnams kyi 'gyur rnying ngo*// maṇḍal bya ba'i cho ga dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/

pha rol tu phyin pa dang gsang sngags gnyis ka'i thun mong ngo*// bla ma'i maṇḍal gyi cho ga maṇḍal gyi cho ga slob dpon chen po byang chub sems dpa' dgra las rgyal ba gsang ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a tu lo pa dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ yang maṇḍal gyi cho ga dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon mkhas pa chen po rin chen 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ slob dpon srid gsum rnam par dag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i las dang po pa'i tshogs sog bya ba'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa/ byang chub gzhung lam zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas pa chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ shlau ka sum brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga pa kha che'i mkhan po chen po chos kyi rje shākya shrī bha dra las mnyan nas/ bod yul dbus kyi sde snod 'dzin pa chag lo tsā ba dge slong dgra bcom gyi 'gyur/ maṇḍal gyi cho ga kha che paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa/ de nyid dang*/ gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon shī la swa bhā was las dang po pa'i ngor bsdus te mdzad pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga sna tshogs kyi skor la/ rgyud sna tshogs las btus pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga slob dpon dpal klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po rdo rje slob dpon chen po karma badzra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ chos skyong thams cad kyi gtor ma'i cho ga slob dpon chen po ba liṃ ā tsāryas mdzad pa/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rma ban chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ gtor ma'i phreng ba slob dpon blo bzang seng ges mdzad pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi dge slong dharma dī paṃ ka ra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong dharma pā la bha dras dpal e waṃ chos 'khor du 'gyur/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i gtor ma paṇḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/

lo tsā ba dge bshes ston pa'i 'gyur/ gtor ma chen po'i las kyi rim pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon rdo rje mi bskyod pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po badzra kīrti dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ cha gsum 'bring po'i cho ga nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje'i gdams ngag la brten nas paṇḍi ta shraddhā ka ra warmas nye bar sbyar ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ chu gtor gyi cho ga 'jam dpal ma'i rtsa ba slob dpon dza ya se nās mdzad pa dang*/ chu gtor 'jam dpal ma'i 'grel pa phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon shākya mi tras mdzad pa gnyis dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ gtor ma'i 'grel pa slob dpon bid dzñā nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shāntiṃ garbha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ā tsārya rin chen mchog gi 'gyur/ bdud rtsi 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad cing*/ lo tsā ba khu dngos grub kyis gtan la phab pa/ chab gtor dri ma med pa'i gzhung slob dpon dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ klu gtor gyi cho ga sgrol ma'i zhabs rdul la reg pa'i mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ bkra shis dang bde legs su byed pa'i skor la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa slob dpon snang byed zla bas mdzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ dpal rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol mas gsungs pa'i bkra shis brgyad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi nā ya shrī mi tra dang*/ lo tsā ba ldan ma tshul khrims seng ge'i 'gyur/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rnams bzhugs so// gsang ba 'dus pa le'u bcu bdun pa'i 'grel pa bam po brgya rtsa bcu dang shlau ka bcu gnyis pa slob dpon rab tu byung ba'i mtshan pra bha wa gsang mtshan 'phags pa snying pos mdzad zer ba/ paṇḍi ta phra ras kyis 'bal byams pa shes rab dang*/ gnyan byang chub tshul khrims gnyis kyi don du bsgyur ba 'di rdzun ma yang dag yin pas ma bris so zhes kun mkhyen bus gsungs so// bla ma'i gsol 'debs nyin zhag phrug gcig gi /bya rim chos skyong nor lha'i bkra shis kyi// tshigs su bcad pa la sogs bstan bcos grangs// dri ma med pa sum cu tham pa bzhugs// de dag gis ni las dang po'i bya ba'i rim pa dang chos skyong dang nor lha dang bkra shis la sogs pa'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar sngags phyogs kyi chos skor la bstan bcos nyis stong bdun brgya gya gcig bzhugs so// sngags kyi bstan bcos skabs te gnyis pa'o// gnyis pa phyi mtshan nyid kyi phyogs la/ rig pa'i gnas lnga ston pa'i bstan bcos las dang po nang rig pa'i bstan bcos la theg pa che chung gnyis las/ theg chen gyi snying po bka' bar pa rgyal ba'i yum gyi dgongs 'grel la shing rta chen po'i srol bzhir grags pa las/ dang po rgyal ba'i yum gyi mngon par rtogs pa'i don ston pa ni/ ka pa la/ bcom ldan 'das byams pa mgon pos mdzad pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ paṇḍi ta go mi 'chi med dang*/ lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i 'grel pa la/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa legs par spyad pa'i las can theg pa chen po la yang dag par gnas pa 'phags pa mang pos bkur ba ku ru kulle'i sde pa gtsug lag khang du ma'i bdag po slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bangs kyi tsha bo dge slong 'phags pa rnam par grol ba'i sdes mdzad pa/

nyi khri snang bar grags pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po shar phyogs kyi dge bsnyen chen po go mi 'chi med dang*/ lo tsā ba chen po dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur gnyis bzhugs so// //kha pa la/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa'i rnam par 'grel pa mkhas pa chen po mos pas spyod pa'i sa brnyes pa slob dpon rnam grol sdes mdzad pa/ bal yul gyi paṇḍi ta chen po shānti bha dra dang*/ 'bro seng dkar dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ 'di la shlau ka lnga stong bzhi brgya yod do// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'bum pa dang nyi khri lnga stong pa dang khri brgyad stong pa gsum don mthun par mngon rtogs brgyad du bstan pa paṇḍi ta chen po smṛ ti dzñā na kīrtis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// 'di la dpe rnying dag po rnams na paṇḍi ta byams pas mdzad bya ba snang ste/ de ltar na mai tri pa la smṛ tir nor ba yin nam sems so zhes bu ston gyis gsungs so// //ga nga ca gsum la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi rjes su 'brangs nas dag par gtugs pa slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa nyi khri le brgyad mar grags pa bam po bdun cu rtsa bzhi pa/ bal yul yam bu'i bsod nams rgyun 'byung gi gtsug lag khang du paṇḍi ta zhi ba bzang po dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur bzhugs so// //cha pa la/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i bshad pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi snang ba zhes bya ba mkhas pa chen po slob dpon seng ge bzang po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa shlau ka stong phrag brgyad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su bhā ṣi ta dang*/ sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur nas/

slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba chen po dge slong rin chen bzang pos yul dbus kyi dpe dang yang gtugs nas bcos pa la/ dus phyis paṇḍi ta chen po gzhung 'bum phrag gnyis kyis mgrin pa brgyan pa dhi ra pā la dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur ba bzhugs so// //ja pa la/ mngon rtogs rgyan sdud pa dang sbyar ba'i 'grel pa'am/ bcom ldan 'das yon tan rin po che sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa'i bka' 'grel rtogs par sla ba zhes bya ba shlau ka nyis stong chig brgya pa slob dpon chen po seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa/ bal yul gyi paṇḍi ta dze ta hang ngu shānti bha dra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba 'phro seng dkar shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa bam po lnga pa slob dpon seng ge bzang pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bidyā ka ra pra bha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba la/ slad kyis paṇḍi ta dpal go mi 'chi med dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis legs par bcos shing gtan la phab pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa rtogs par dka' ba'i snang ba zhes bya ba'i 'grel bshad slob dpon gser gling pa chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa'i bsdus don nub kyi sgo glegs pa dpal mkhas pa chen po shes rab 'byung gnas blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po su ma ti kīrti dang*/ lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so//

//nya pa la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa'i 'grel bshad tshig rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba yul chen po bai da lar skyes pa'i slob dpon mkhas pa chen po grub pa'i mtha' rab 'byams la mkhyen pa'i snang bas khyab pa theg pa chen po dbu ma'i slob dpon dpal chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po a bhi yukta katta ra shrī mi tra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don bsdus rgya gar gyi mkhan po ku mā ra shrī bha dras mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa'i bka' 'grel slob dpon seng ge bzang po'i dngos slob buddha shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa bam po drug pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bidyā singha ka ra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa grags pa'i cha zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta chen po ratna kīrtis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta chen po ratna kīrti de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba la chings yon tan 'bar gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// //ta pa la/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa shes rab sgron ma'i phreng ba zhes bya ba dpal chos kyi rje byang chub sems dpa' dam pa mkhas pa thams cad kyi bla mar gyur pa kha che'i rigs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po buddha shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po de nyid dang*/ gnubs lo tsā ba dge slong byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ mngon rtogs rgyan sems tsam gyi lta bar bkrol ba 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi dngos grub brnyes pa mkhas pa chen po slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa'i 'grel pa dag ldan zhes bya ba nyi khri dang sbyar ba'i 'grel pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī su bhū ti shānti dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong shākya blo gros dang*/ dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyi bsgyur ba la/ slad kyis paṇḍi ta chen po shānta bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis bcos te gtan la phab pa/ stong phrag brgya pa'i rnam par bshad pa mngon rtogs rgyan dang mthun par bshad pa kha che'i paṇḍi ta dharma shrīs mdzad do zhes grags pa rnams bzhugs so// //tha pa la/ mngon rtogs rgyan brgyad stong pa dang sbyar nas sems tsam du ston pa 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i bka' 'grel snying po mchog ces bya ba shlau ka stong phrag brgyad pa/ rgyal po'i slob dpon mkhas pa chen po rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta shrī su bhu ti shānti dang*/ lo tsā ba shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don bsdus sgron ma zhes bya ba dpal shānti pa'i slob ma slob dpon mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba mkhas pa chen po tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //da pa la/ brgyad stong pa

ma byung*/ mngon rtogs rgyan dang sbyar ba'i 'grel pa slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i 'grel pa gnad kyi zla ba'i 'od ces bya ba paṇḍi ta chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po de nyid dang*/ mkhas pa shes rab dpal gyis dpal nā lend+rar bsgyur ba/ sdud pa mngon rtogs rgyan dang mthun par bshad pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdzod kyi lde mig ces bya ba kha che'i mkhan po bla ma dharma shrīs mdzad pa/ 'phags pa sdud pa'i gdams ngag 'di byang chub sa'i snying po dpal 'bum steng gi gtsug lag khang gsar du bzhengs pa'i dus mkhas pa chen po ba reg lo tsā bas bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// de ltar mngon rtogs rgyan gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i 'grel pa nyi shu rtsa gcig go /shing rta'i srol 'byed gnyis pa dbu ma rig pa'i tshogs ni 'og tu dbu ma dang lhan cig bri'o// na pa gnyis la/ shing rta'i srol 'byed gsum pa slob dpon daṃṣṭā se nas mdzad par grags pa'i 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'bum pa rgya cher 'grel pa le'u lnga bcu nga gnyis pa'i 'phro la lus pa bzhugs/ 'di la dkar chag 'phang thang mar rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis mdzad zer ro// //pha pa la/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'bum pa dang*/ nyi khri lnga stong pa dang*/ khri brgyad stong pa'i rgya cher bshad pa bam po nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ 'di la kun mkhyen bus kha cig daṃṣṭa se nas mdzad zer mod kyi/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung gi 'grel par bzhed pa nyid 'thad par rtogs te/ rgya 'grel rnams su lung drangs pa'i gzhung rnams de na mi snang ba'i phyir 'dis lta ba sems tsam du bkrol zhing*/

'di dang 'bum ṭīka che ba gnyis ka sgo gsum rnam grangs bcu gcig tu 'chad do zhes bshad do// shing rta'i srol 'byed bzhi pa gtso bo'i don sum cu rtsa gnyis su ston pa 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma bsdus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa dang*/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma bsdus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa'i rnam par 'grel pa slob dpon bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi 'bangs kyis mdzad pa/ shlau ka lnga brgya bzhi bcu pa/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta thig le bum pa dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //ba pa la/ dpal ldan rgyal po dza gatta tā lar gnas pas mdzad pa bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i rnam par bshad pa man ngag gi rjes su 'brang ba gzhung tshad shlau ka stong phrag brgyad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a laṅka de wa dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba ga rod tshul khrims 'byung gnas kyis dpal sgye'u ri'i drung du chos 'khor dben pa'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba/ 'di brgyad stong don bsdus dang*/ nyi khri gzhung 'grel gnyis ka'i rjes su 'brang ba'i 'grel pa yin no// //ma pa la/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dgu pa slob dpon chen po kampa la'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dgu pa'i rgya cher bshad pa slob dpon chen po kampa la'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kā ma la gupta dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdun brgya pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa mgon po ngag gi dbang pos spobs pa bskyed pa'i slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa bam po bdun pa/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bdun brgya pa'i rgya cher bshad pa slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa bam po drug pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi ma la mi tra dang*/ li'i mkhan po su rend+ra ka ra pra bha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong nam mkha' skyong gis bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje gcod pa'i gnas bdun gyi rgya cher 'grel ba slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa 'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa gzhon nu dpal ba'i zhal snga nas gsar 'gyur mdzad pa'i 'phro cung zad lus pa/ zhwa lu lo tsā ba 'gos chos skyong bzang pos lugs gnyis kyi mdun sa chen po pho brang sne'u gdong rtser chos kyi rje chos kyi rgyal po chen po dpal ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal gyi mnga' thang chen po la brten nas legs par bsgyur/ slar yang rgya dpe la gtugs shing slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa'i 'grel par brjod bya ris mthun pa rnams dang sbyar te/ tshig phrad dang 'khrugs sdeb sogs cung zad legs char 'gyur ba rnams 'bad cing dag par bgyis pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdo rje gcod pa dbu ma'i tshul du rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta mañdzu shrī dang*/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i rgya cher bshad pa don brgyad ma rgya gar gyi mkhan po dri ma med pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi ma la mi tra de nyid dang*/ bod kyi zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande nam mkha' dang ye shes snying po la sogs pas bsgyur ba/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i 'grel pa slob dpon dzñā na mi tras mdzad pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i 'grel pa don gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba dge slong seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po rgya cher 'grel pa don bcu pa gsal bar bstan pa slob dpon pra shast+ra se nās mdzad pa/ sher snying gi 'grel pa ma byung*/ ma tshang ba gcig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i don yongs su shes pa paṇḍi ta shrī ma hā dza nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba dge slong seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ shes rab snying po'i rnam par bshad pa dge slong legs pa'i shes rab kyis slob dpon mar me mdzad dpal ye shes la gsol ba btab nas legs par bshad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ sher snying gi ma byung*/ 'grel pa slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad zer ba rnams bzhugs so// gsung rab kun gyi snying po bla na med// dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus skyed pa'i yum// shes rab pha rol phyin ma'i mdo yi don// gsal byed bstan bcos bzhi bcu tham pa bzhugs// de dag gis ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i skor rnams bkod nas/ gnyis pa bka' thams cad kyi dgongs pa 'grel zhing*/ khyad par du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs pa 'grel pa dbu ma'i skor la/ tsa pa la/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa shes rab ces bya ba slob dpon bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rjer ldan pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i theg pa bla na med pa'i tshul gsal bar byed pa rab tu dga' ba'i sa bsgrubs nas bde ba can du gshegs pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po dbu ma pa dzñā na garbha dang*/

zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'di la rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa bdun/ shlau ka bzhi brgya bzhi bcu rtsa dgu/ bam po phyed dang gnyis su byas so// slad kyis grong khyer dpe med kyi dbus gtsug lag khang rin chen sbas pa'i dbus su kha che'i mkhan po ha su ma ti dang*/ bod kyis sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis 'grel pa tshig gsal dang bstun nas bcos pa dang*/ slad kyis ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang du lo tsā ba de nyid kyis zhu chen bgyis pa'o// rigs pa drug cu pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa zhes bya ba slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po mu di ta shrī dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ zhib mo rnam par 'thag pa zhes bya ba'i mdo slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta ā nanda dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ stong pa nyid bdun cu pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa zhes bya ba slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba gzhon nu mchog dang*/ gnyan dar ma grags dang khu'i 'gyur dag las don dang tshig bzang du bris pa/ rtsod pa bzlog pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa zhes bya ba slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na garbha dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur ba las/ slad kyis kha che'i paṇḍi ta dza ya ā nanda dang lo tsā ba khu mdo sde dpal gyis bcos pa/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa ga las 'jigs med ces bya ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa slob dpon bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po theg pa chen po dbu ma pa dzñā na garbha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ 'di la rab tu byed pa nyi shu rtsa bdun/

shlau ka ni nyis stong chig brgya/ bam po ni bdun du byas so// 'dir rigs pa drug cu pa'i rang 'grel rnyed na bri'o// zhib mo rnam par 'thag pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta dzā ya ā nanda dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po dge slong khu mdo sde 'bar gyi 'gyur/ stong pa nyid bdun cu pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rtsod pa bzlog pa'i 'grel pa sa dang po la rab tu dga' ba la bzhugs pa slob dpon 'phags pa nā gārdzu nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na garbha dang*/ lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ theg pa chen po nyi shu pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po tsand+ra ku mā ra dang*/ dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ dpal kha che'i grong khyer dpe med du bande gzhon nu shes rab kyis bsgyur ba la/ slad kyis paṇḍi ta ā nanda dang*/ lo tsā ba grags 'byor shes rab kyis bcos pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i snying po'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i snying po'i rnam par bshad pa/ ma rtogs pa rtogs par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa rnams slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta ā nanda dang*/ lo tsā ba grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ skye med rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba 'phags pa klu sgrub snying pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka na ka warma dang*/ lo tsā ba sūrya kīrtis lha sa ra mo cher 'gyur/ dbu ma srid pa 'pho ba zhes bya ba 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ zla ba gzhon nu'i rang 'gyur/

srid pa 'pho ba'i ṭī ka paṇḍi ta byams pa mgon pos mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta zla ba gzhon nu la gru ston chung gis zhus nas rang 'gyur/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa buddha pā li ta zhes bya ba slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bka' grub pa bstan bcos du ma'i rnam bshad mdzad pa theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa rig sngags 'chang grub pa'i gnas khyad par can du gshegs pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na garbha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ rang bzhin gsum la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta dge slong zla ba grags pa'i rang 'gyur/ cha shas kyi yan lag ces bya ba'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa dang*/ cha shas kyi yan lag ces bya ba'i rab tu byed pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shraddhā ka ra warma dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //tsha pa la/ slob dpon 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor spyod pa bstan bcos bzhi brgya pa zhes bya ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ kha che'i grong khyer dpe med kyi dbung rin chen sbas pa'i kun dga' rwa bar rgya gar gyi mkhan po sūkṣ+ma dzā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ 'khrul ba bzlog pa'i rigs pa gtan tshigs grub pa zhes bya ba slob dpon 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzñā de wa dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ rab tu byed pa lag pa'i tshad kyi tshig le'ur byas pa dang*/ lag pa'i tshad kyi 'grel pa slob dpon 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na shī la dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong dpal 'byor snying pos bsgyur cing*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs rakṣi tas zhus pa/
