dbu ma 'khrul ba 'joms pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po ārya de was mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ ye shes snying po kun las btus pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po 'phags pa lha'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛṣṇa pa dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ ye shes snying po kun las btus pa'i bshad sbyar slob dpon byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shānti bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa shes rab sgron ma slob dpon btsun pa legs ldan 'byed kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po theg pa chen po dbu ma pa dzñā na garbha dang*/ bod kyi zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba 'di la rab tu byed pa nyi shu bdun/ shlau ka drug stong*/ bam po nyi shur byas so// dbu ma rin po che'i sgron ma zhes bya ba bdag gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu la mkhyen pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa/ sku tshe 'di nyid kyis rig 'dzin gyi gnas su gshegs pa'i slob dpon mkhas pa chen po bha byas slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi gsung bzhin du mdzad pa/ phyis so ma pu ri'i gtsug lag khang du lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ge dang nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba gnyis kyis yang dang yang du zhus nas bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //dza pa la/ dbu ma'i snying po'i tshig le'ur byas pa dang*/ dbu ma'i snying po 'grel pa rtog ge 'bar ba slob dpon chen po bha byas mdzad pa bam po nyi shu rtsa bdun pa dang*/ dbu ma'i don bsdus pa slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyis mdzad pa rnams jo bo rje dang*/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ dbu ma rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zhes bya ba slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so//

//wa zha za gsum la/ slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyis nye bar sbyar ba dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa shes rab sgron ma'i rgya cher 'grel pa theg pa chen po dbu ma pa'i slob dpon yul sa ke ta nas byung ba bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag chub pa rang dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' thams cad la mkhas pa spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po theg pa chen po dbu ma pa dzñā na garbha dang*/ bod kyi zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur ba bzhugs so// 'di la rab tu byed pa ni nyi shu rtsa bdun/ shlau ka ni nyi khri bzhi stong*/ bam po ni brgyad cur byas so// //'a pa la/ dbu ma rtsa ba'i 'grel pa tshig gsal ba zhes bya ba slob dpon zla ba grags pa theg pa mchog la thugs gzhol ba/ mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje mnga' ba/ ri mo bris pa'i ba drus las 'o ma bzhos pas bden par zhen pa bzlog par mdzad pas sbyar ba/ kha che'i grong khyer dpe med kyi dbus rin chen sbas pa'i gtsug lag khang gi 'dabs su rgya gar gyi mkhan po rtog ge pa chen po ma hā su ma ti dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis kha che'i dpe dang mthun par bsgyur ba las/ phyis ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang du kha che'i mkhan po ka na ka warma dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis nyi 'og shar phyogs kyi dpe dang gtugs shing legs par bcos pa/ dbu ma la 'jug pa slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ti la ka ka

shānti paṇḍi ta/ la sha dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi tshul khrims rgyal ba/ ma grags kyis kha che'i dpe dang mthun par bsgyur/ phyis ra sa ra mo cher rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka na ka warma dang*/ lo tsā ba de nyid kyis nyi 'og shar phyogs kyi dpe dang gtugs shing bcos pa/ dbu ma la 'jug pa'i bshad pa zhes bya ba slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ kha che'i yul gyi grong khyer dpe med kyi rin chen sbas pa'i gtsug lag khang du kha che'i rgyal po 'phags pa lha'i sku rings la rgya gar gyi mkhan po ti la ka ka la sha dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis kha che'i dpe dang mthun par bsgyur ba las/ phyis ra sa ra mo cher rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka na ka warma dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba de nyid kyis nyi 'og shar phyogs kyi dpe dang gtugs shing legs par bcos te gtan la phab pa/ gzhung tshad ni bam po bcu gcig dang bam po sum gnyis so// dbu ma shes rab la 'jug pa slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //ya pa la/ rigs pa drug cu pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po dbu ma'i slob dpon yul sa ma ta nas skyes pa mu stegs can rtog ge ngan par smra ba'i tshogs thams cad kyi mun pa mang po rnam par 'joms pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnal 'byor spyod pa bzhi brgya pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ dpal grong khyer dpe med kyi dbus rin chen sbas pa'i kun dga' rwa bar rgya gar gyi mkhan po sūkṣ+ma dzā na zhes bya ba gdung rabs grangs med par paṇḍi ta brgyud pa'i rigs su sku 'khrungs pa bram ze rin chen rdo rje'i dbon po bram ze chen po sadzdza na'i sras gcig pu bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa la gces spras su mdzad pa'i zhal snga nas dang*/

bod kyi sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba dge slong pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis bsgyur ba/ phung po lnga'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ tshangs pa'i 'byung gnas gtsug lag khang du rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas legs par bsgyur ba/ stong nyid bdun cu pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ dpal nā lend+ra'i gtsug lag khang du paṇḍi ta a bha yā ka ra dang*/ snur lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ 'di'i gzhung grangs stong phrag gnyis dang brgya phrag gcig gis lhag pa'o// stong nyid bdun cu pa'i rnam par bshad pa kha che'i yul gyi mkhas pa chen po so ma shrī'i zhabs rdul la brten par mdzad pa'i slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal gzhan la phan pas mdzad pa/ thugs dam sa'i snying po tho ling du kha che'i mkhan po pa ra hi ta'i zhal snga nas dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu mchog gi 'gyur/ rtog ge tho ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa zhes bya ba kha che'i paṇḍi ta dza ya ā nandas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba khu mdo sde 'bar gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// //ra pa la/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel bshad don gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po dza ya ā nandas mdzad pa/ kha che'i mkhas pa chen po dza ya ā nanda de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba kun dga' grags kyis bsgyur ba bzhugs so// //la pa la/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa slob dpon shānta de was mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzñā de wa dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyis kha che'i dpe las zhus te gtan la phab pa la/ slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharmā shrī bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po dang*/ shākya blo gros kyis yul dbus kyi dpe 'grel pa dang mthun par bcos pa/

slar yang dus phyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ma ti kīrti dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis dag par bcos pa/ shlau ka stong du grags pa/ bam po gnyis su byas so// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i dka' 'grel shes rab kyi le'u'i rgya cher bshad pa dge slong mkhas pa shes rab 'byung gnas blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ 'grel bshad 'di'i le'u dang po gnyis dang*/ brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab kyi ṭī ka mkhas pa chen po su ma ti kīrti dang*/ lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug dang*/ gnyan dar ma grags gnyis kyis stod smad bgos nas bsgyur ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i rnam par bshad pa'i dka' 'grel mdzad byang 'gyur byang mi gsal ba rnams bzhugs so// //sha pa la/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i legs par sbyar ba shlau ka chig stong dgu brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga pa slob dpon dge ba lhas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī ku mā ra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i rtogs par dka' ba'i gnas gtan la dbab pa'i gzhung slob dpon mkhas pa chen po kṛṣṇa pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛṣṇa pa de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i dka' 'grel dpal bi kra ma la shī la'i gtsug lag gi mkhas pa chen po dge slong bai ro tsa na rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ spyod 'jug gi shes rab le'u'i bka' 'grel paṇḍi ta mi mnyam khol po dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur la/ li ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mos pa'i dbang gis legs par bsgyur ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i shes rab le'u dang*/ bsngo ba'i le'u'i dka' 'grel mdzad byang 'gyur byang med pa gcig

byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i don sum cu rtsa drug tu bsdus pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i gtso bo'i don bcu gcig tu bsdus pa gser gling gi bla ma chos skyong la gus pa dang ldan pa'i slob ma ka ma la rakṣi ta dang*/ dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas gsol ba btab nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ byang chub kyi spyod pa la 'jug pa'i dgongs pa'i 'grel pa khyad par gsal byed ces bya ba rgya gar shar phyogs dza gatta la bi ha ra'i paṇḍi ta chen po bi ghū ti tsand+ras mdzad cing*/ paṇḍi ta chen po de nyid kyis ru lag gtsang stod 'bring mtshams kyi sa'i cha dpal rgya rtags kyi gtsug lag khang du rang 'gyur du mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// //sa pa la/ bden pa gnyis rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa dang*/ bden pa gnyis rnam par gtan la dbab pa slob dpon ye shes snying pos mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ bden pa gnyis rnam par 'byed pa'i dka' 'grel slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa/ bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang*/ dzñā na garbha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dbu ma rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa slob dpon chen po zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dbu ma'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa slob dpon chen po zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dbu ma rgyan gyi dka' 'grel slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rend+ra bo dhi dang*/ pradzñā warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di la shlau ka stong sum brgya brgyad cu bam po bzhi yod do// dbu ma snang ba zhes bya ba/

de kho na nyid snang ba zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa nyid du grub pa rnams slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dpal brtsegs rakṣi tas bsgyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //ha pa la/ sku gsum la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos slob dpon klu'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sku gsum 'grel pa slob dpon ye shes zla bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di la shlau ka bdun brgya drug cu mchis so// de kho na la 'jug pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon dpal sbas kyis mdzad pa/ dbu ma lugs kyi snying po mdor bsdus pa'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon bidyā ka ra pra bhas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bidyā ka ra pra bha de nyid dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ rnam pa med pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa bal yul gyi paṇḍi ta dga' ba'i dpal gyis mdzad pa/ snang ba'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon kampa las mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ku mā ra ka la sha dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ snang ba'i phreng ba zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel yid kyi dga' ba skyed pa dge bsnyen btsun pa ngo bo nyid med pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ku mā ra ka la sha dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta gnas brtan chen po stobs bcu dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa 'gyur byang med pa rnams bzhugs so// //a pa la/ lta ba tha dad pa rnam par phye ba mdor bsdus pa slob dpon dbu ma'i seng ges mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ta ro shrī mi tra dang*/

lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gzhung rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa bhaṅga lar 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa chen po dzai tā ri pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta shānti bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gzhung rnam par 'byed pa'i bshad pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la gcig tu gzhol ba'i slob dpon dgra las rgyal bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po ka na ka shrī mi tra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba shes rab grags kyi 'gyur/ dbu ma rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba slob dpon paṇḍi ta chen po tsand+ra ha ri bas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba cog ro ting nge 'dzin bzang po'i 'gyur/ bden pa gnyis la 'jug pa slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ge'i 'gyur/ thub pa dgongs pa'i rgyan shlau ka stong phrag phyed dang drug pa/ slob dpon mkhas pa chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ mkhas pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' rab 'byams la mkhyen pa'i snang ba skyes pa'i mkhas pa chen po de la mnyan nas/ de nyid kyi spyan sngar dge slong dpang zho gsal ba grags zhes bya bas yul dbus kyi grong khyer chen po mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas dpal nā lend+rar bsgyur ba la/ dus phyis lung rigs kyi dbang phyug stag sde pa chen po seng ge rgyal mtshan pa'i bka' drin dang*/ de nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i blo gros kyi stobs mtha' yas pas shes bya'i chos la dbang sgyur ba shong ston lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis legs bshad kyi srol la brten nas phyi nang gi gzhung lugs la blo'i snang ba cher rgyas pa/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dbang dge slong dpal ldan blo gros brtan pas rgya dpe dang gtugs te legs par dpyad nas bsgyur cing zhus pa zhes pa'i mtha' can/

tshad ma rnam par 'joms pa mdor bshad pa'i 'grel pa zhes bya ba rtsa 'grel gnyis ka ma tshang ba'i dum bu gcig theg pa chen po'i mtshan nyid kun las btus pa zhes bya ba slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta karṇo pa ti dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong pradzñā singhas dpal nā lend+ra'i gtsug lag khang chen por bsgyur/ sems brtag pa slob dpon tshul khrims 'phags pas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta ka na ka dang*/ lo tsā ba rma chos 'bar gyi 'gyur/ theg pa thams cad du snang bar byed pa'i bye brag tu bshad pa zhes bya ba bram ze'i btsun pa rab 'byor dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po rab 'byor dbyangs de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong ting nge 'dzin bzang po'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// //ki pa la/ lta ba gtso cher gtan la phab nas/ bsgom pa'i rim pa ston pa'i bstan bcos ni/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i bsgom pa'i rim pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta lo ta dang*/ dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i lam 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhabs kyi padma'i ze'u 'bru spyi bos len pa sde snod gsum la mkhas pa slob dpon ye shes snying pos mdzad pa/ cig car 'jug pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i bsgom don slob dpon chen po bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma tā shī la dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i man ngag padma spungs pa zhes bya ba dang*/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i yi ge rin po che'i sgron ma zhes bya ba slob dpon dpal mkhas pa chen po rta dbyangs kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po padmā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa slob dpon chen po ka ma la shī la'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/

zhwa lu lo tsā ba dge slong dharma pā la bha dra zhes bgyi bas gra thang du bsgyur ba/ tshad med bzhi'i rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa/ bsgom rim dang po/ bsgom rim bar pa/ bsgom rim tha ma/ rnal 'byor sgom pa la 'jug pa rnams slob dpon chen po ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag rdo rje lta bu zhes bya ba dpal kampa las mdzad pa/ lus yongs su dpyad pa'i sgom pa'i rim pa slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ mi sdug pa bsgom pa'i rim pa slob dpon dge ba'i go chas mdzad pa/ 'di ni sngon gyi lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyis bsgyur ba ste 'gyur rnying lags skad do// pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa bsgom pa'i rim pa'i man ngag slob dpon chen po dpal ye shes 'di de kho na nyid la zhug pa'i dum bu yin/ grags pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po padmā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bla na med pa bsgom pa zhes bya ba dkyil 'khor chen po'i slob dpon ma hā ma tis mdzad pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi le'u zhes bya ba slob dpon byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi nā ya tsand+ra las zhus te/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi le'u slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛṣṇa pa de nyid dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ bsam gtan gyi chos drug rnam par gzhag pa slob dpon chen po a wa dhū tī pas mdzad pa dang*/

bsam gtan gyi chos drug rnam par bzhag pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon dā na shī las mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dran pa gcig pa'i man ngag dang*/ dbu ma'i man ngag ces bya ba paṇḍi ta dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas lha sa 'phrul snang du 'gyur/ dbu ma'i man ngag rin po che'i za ma tog kha phye ba zhes bya ba ma hā paṇḍi ta dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge bsnyen chen po rgya brtson 'grus seng ge dang*/ dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ dbu ma'i man ngag ces bya ba'i 'grel pa paṇḍi ta shes rab thar pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shes rab thar pa de nyid dang*/ dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur ting nge 'dzin gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnam par gzhag pa rgya'i mkhan po ha shang zab mo la sogs pa dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rnam par mi rtog pa'i 'gyur/ bsgom pa'i rim pa mdo kun las btus pa rnal 'byor spyod pa'i bsam gtan rje btsun ka ros mdzad pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang spyod pa gtso cher ston pa'i skor ni/ mdo kun las btus pa ā tsārya ārya nā gārdzu nas mdzad pa/ bam po lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ mdo kun las btus pa'i bshad pa rin po che'i snang ba'i rgyan zhes bya ba lung gi tshad mas rab tu sbyar ba slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ shlau ka sum stong lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta nag po'i zhabs dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 'di lta ba sems tsam du smra ba'i paṇḍi tas brtsams mod kyang rtsa 'grel stabs gcig pa'i phyir 'dir bris so// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas pa chen po chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'di bsgom pa'i bstan bcos yin kyang dus phyis rnyed pas sprod pa'i pusti'i gsham du bzhugs su bcug pa yin no// mdo kun las btus pa'i don bsdus pa slob dpon dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ge'i 'gyur/ rim gyis 'jug pa'i bsgom don slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sdes ka chur gtan la phab pa rnams bzhugs so// //khi pa la/ bslab pa kun las btus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa dang*/ bslab pa kun las btus pa slob dpon zhi ba'i lhas mdzad pa/ bam po bcu bzhi pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur ba las/ slad kyi kha che'i paṇḍi ta ti la ka ka la sha dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis sri mda'i dgon par zhu gtugs legs par byas pa/ bslab pa kun las btus pa nas 'byung ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa'i bsrung ba dang sdig pa bshags pa'i cho ga slob dpon zhi ba'i lhas mdzad pa/ bslab pa kun las btus pa'i mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba bla ma gser gling pas mdzad pa/ dpal mar me mdzad ye shes dang*/ dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ bslab pa kun las btus pa'i phyogs tsam zhig blangs pa'i bshad pa bslab pa'i me tog snye ma zhes bya ba bi kra ma shī la'i paṇḍi ta chen po bai ro tsa na rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ma ti kīrti dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong zha ma seng rgyal dang*/ klog skya gzhon nu 'bar gyis bsgyur ba la/ slad nas bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis bcos pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa bsdus pa ārya wī ras mdzad pa/

lo tsā ba ā tsārya bai ro tsa na rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ las dang po pa'i sa sbyang ba slob dpon mkhas pa chen po byang chub sems dpa'i dgra las rgyal ba gsang ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛṣṇa pa dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mdo tsam gdams ngag tu byas pa slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ byang chub lam gyi sgron ma slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po de nyid dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ chos 'di zhang zhung gi tho ling gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa'o// byang chub lam gyi sgron me'i dka' 'grel zhes bya ba bhaṅga la'i rgyal po'i rigs rgyud dge slong mkhas pa chen po byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mdzad pa dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po bhaṅga la pa dpal mar me mdzad ye shes zhabs dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ snying po bsdu ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims 'byung gnas de ba rtses bsgyur ba/ snying po nges par bsdu ba zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i nor bu'i phreng ba/ byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa'i lam la 'jug pa bstan pa rnams slob dpon dpal mar ma mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ skyabs su 'gro ba bstan pa zhes bya ba/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi sgrub thabs yi ger bsdus pa/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa/ rang gi bya ba'i rim pa la bskul ba dang bcas pa yi ger bris pa rnams slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po de nyid dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ mdo sde'i don kun las btus pa'i man ngag mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam bstan pa/ las rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba/ spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma rnams slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// //gi pa la/ mdo kun las btus pa chen po zhes bya ba mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta rgyal ba kun dga' dang*/ skad gnyis smra ba'i dge slong nyi ma grags pa dang khu mdo sde 'bar gyi 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi rim pa mdor bsdus pa 'di la chag chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur ba cig kyang yod mod kyi 'di dang gcig tu 'dug pas ma bris/ theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa 'di gnyis ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas chos rje shākya shrīs yul 'khor so sor byon pa'i tshe zhu ba po rnams kyi skal ba dang sbyar te zhar byung du brtsams shing gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa kha 'thor ba rnams mdzad pa/ ma hā paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa zhes bya ba kha che'i paṇḍi ta buddha shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba chag dgra bcom gyi 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i mdo'i don mdor bsdus pa slob dpon dpal sgra gcan 'dzin bzang pos mdzad pa/ dpal chos kyi rje sa'i steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba kha che shākya shrī bha dra dang*/ gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed la sogs kyi cho ga'i skor la/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga slob dpon mkhas pa chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i cho ga slob dpon mkhas pa chen po byang chub bzang pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po bla ma su nā ya shrī mi tra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang*/ yi dam blang ba'i cho ga slob dpon mkhas pa chen po byang chub sems dpa' dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ma ti kīrti dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i cho ga'i rim pa slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur ba la/ slad kyis paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bcos pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa bzung ba'i cho ga slob dpon mkhas pa chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ kha che paṇḍi ta chen po shākya shrī bha dra dang*/ chag lo tsā ba dge slong dgra bcom gyi 'gyur/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bdun bcu pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ skyabs 'gro yan lag drug pa slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa/ ltung ba bshags pa'i cho ga thams cad yod par smra ba'i paṇḍi ta de wa shāntis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ ltung ba bshags pa'i cho ga slob dpon dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/

kha ton dang glegs bam bklag pa'i sngon du bya ba'i cho ga pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i tsha tsha gdab pa'i cho ga bla ma'i bya ba'i rim pa rnams slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ sdom pa gsum gyi rim pa slob dpon chen po rnyog med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a tu lya dā sa dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ chos spyod yan lag bzhi pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī dza ga ta mi trā nandas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug de nyid dang*/ gnubs lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ dam pa'i chos spyod la 'jug pa'i yan lag bdun pa kha che'i paṇḍi ta shākya shrī bha dras mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// chos rnams rang bzhin stong par ston pa'i tshul// 'phags mchog klu sgrub rjes 'brangs bcas pa'i gzhung*// lta sgom spyod pa gsal bar byed pa yi// bstan bcos brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa bdun bzhugs// de dag gis ni dbu ma'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar dbu ma'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ bka' 'khor lo rim pa gsum pa legs par rnam par phye ba dang ldan pa'i bka'i dgongs pa gtso cher 'grel par byed pa'i bstan bcos la/ bka' so so'i dgongs 'grel dang*/ spyi'i dgongs 'grel gnyis las/ dang po bka' so so'i dgongs 'grel ni/ ngi pa la/ 'phags pa dgongs pa nges par 'grel ba'i rnam par bshad pa slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i 'grel pa/ chos rjes su dran pa'i 'grel pa/ dge 'dun rjes su dran pa'i bshad pa rnams slob dpon thogs med kyis mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dge slong a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa sā lu ljang pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa dang*/ 'phags pa sā lu ljang pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo'i rgya cher bshad pa brgya phrag bcu gnyis pa slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba legs pa'i blo gros dang dzñā na ku mā ras bsgyur nas/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande dpal brtsegs kyis gtan la phab pa/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na shī la dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dpal brtsegs rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa'i bshad pa/ 'phags pa sgo drug pa'i gzungs kyi rnam par bshad pa/ 'phags pa chos bzhi pa'i rnam par bshad pa rnams slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa chos bzhi pa'i rnam par bshad pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon ye shes byin gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dā na shī la dang pradzñā warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ ga ya go ri'i mdo'i rnam par bshad pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa ga ya go ri'i mdo dang spel mar bshad pa 'phags pa 'jam dpal gtso bo'i zhabs la brten pa mang du thos pa gnas brtan shākya'i blos mdzad pa/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i 'phags pa mdo sde sa bcu pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po mañdzu shrī garbha dang*/ pradzñā warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde dang bande dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// //ci pa la/ 'phags pa blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa'i mdo'i rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa bzhugs so//

//chi pa la/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang po dang rnam par dbye ba bshad pa bam po bzhi pa slob dpon ba su bandhus mdzad pa dang*/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang po dang rnam par dbye ba bstan pa'i rgya cher bshad pa slob dpon yon tan blo gros kyis mdzad pa bam po bcu gcig pa/ li'i mkhan po su rend+ra ka ra pra bhā dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong nam mkha'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rnam par bshad pa slob dpon ngang tshul bzang pos mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// //ji pa la/ sa bcu'i rnam par bshad pa'i rnam par bshad pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel bshad slob dpon nyi ma grub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dpal brtsegs rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa sa bcu'i mdo sde'i gleng bzhi'i bshad pa slob dpon shākya'i blos mdzad pa/ 'phags pa rnam par mi rtog par 'jug pa'i gzungs kyi rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa sā lu ljang pa'i mdo sde'i rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i bshad pa slob dpon chen po mdzes bkod kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa 'da' ka ye shes kyi mdo'i rnam par bshad pa slob dpon pradzñā sa mu dras mdzad pa/ 'phags pa 'da' ka ye shes kyi mdo'i don gsal ba zhes bya ba slob dpon zhi ba lhas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma rā dza dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab kyi 'gyur/ byang chub kyi ltung ba bshags pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shānta rakṣi ta dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba rnye ba de wa gho ṣa'i 'gyur/ byang chub kyi ltung ba bshags pa'i 'grel pa byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon dzai ta ri dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa/

bal po paṇḍi ta dang*/ chag lo tsā ba'i 'gyur/ las kyi sgrib pa rnam par sbyang ba'i cho ga'i bshad pa zhes bya ba slob dpon dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa dang*/ phung po gsum pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon kṛṣṇa pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs le'u stong phrag brgya pa las 'od srungs kyi le'u'i rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon blo brtan gyis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// //nyi pa la/ 'phags pa chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid rnam par spros pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo'i 'grel pa grags pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po zhi ba bzang po'i zhal snga nas dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po chen po'i bshad sbyar 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ kha che'i mkhan po thig le bum pa dang*/ sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ kun du bzang po'i spyod pa'i smon lam gyi don kun bsdus te slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po'i rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon shākya'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya singha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po'i rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon rgyan bzang pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na garbha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ska ba dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta ā tsārya ā nanda dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong bha dra pā la'i 'gyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //ti thi di gsum la/ 'phags pa dgongs pa zab mo nges par 'grel pa'i mdo'i rgya cher 'grel pa rgya'i slob dpon mkhan po wen tsheg gis mdzad pa/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos chos grub kyis rgya'i dpe las bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dam pa'i chos padma dkar po'i 'grel pa yul siṅga la'i slob dpon sa'i rtsa lag gis mdzad pa dang gnyis bzhugs so// //ni pa la/ 'phags pa laṅkar gshegs pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon ye shes dpal bzang pos mdzad pa bzhugs so// //pi pa la/ 'phags pa laṅkar gshegs pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo'i 'grel pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i rgyan zhes bya ba rgya'i mkhan po dzñā na badzras mdzad pa bzhugs so// yod dang med pa'i mtha' gnyis legs spangs pa'i// nges don rtsod med legs par rnam phye ba'i// 'khor lo gsum pa'i dgongs 'grel gtso che ba'i/ gsal byed bstan bcos bzhi bcu tham pa bzhugs// de dag gis ni bka' tha ma'i mdo sde sna tshogs kyi 'grel pa'i skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar mdo sde sna tshogs kyi 'grel pa'i skor rnam bkod nas/ gnyis pa spyi'i dgongs 'grel la/ bka' 'khor lo gsum pa'i don gtso bor ston cing*/ spyir theg chen thams cad kyi dgongs pa 'grel pa/ rnal 'byor spyod pa sems tsam dang tshul mthun par ston pa'i bstan bcos la/ phi pa la/ theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan zhes bya ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa 'phags pa byams pas mdzad pa bam po gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya singha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ slad kyi paṇḍi ta pa ra hi ta dang*/ bram ze chen po sadzdza na dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis cung zad bcos te legs par bshad nas gtan la phab pa/

mjug gi shlau ka gcig cig 'gro don 'phel ba dang gzhung gzhan na 'dug pa ltar bris pa'o// dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa 'phags pa byams pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ chos dang chos nyid rnam par 'byed pa 'phags pa byams pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta shānti bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba la/ slad kyis kha che'i mkhan po paṇḍi ta pa ra hi ta dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dga' rdor gyis thugs dam tho ling gi gtsug lag khang du gtan la phab pa/ chos dang chos nyid rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa mgon po byams pas mdzad pa/ kha che'i mkhan po ma hā dza na dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong zha ma seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ theg pa chen po'i rgyud phyi ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ston par byed pa'i mdo zab mo rnams kyi dgongs 'grel theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos mgon po byams pas mdzad pa dang*/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa slob dpon thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ dpal grong khyer dpe med kyi mkhas pa chen po bram ze rin chen rdo rje'i dbon po paṇḍi ta mkhas pa chen po sadzdza na dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis grong khyer dpe med de nyid du bsgyur ba/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde'i rgyan gyi bshad pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ gzhung tshad shlau ka sum stong drug brgya lnga bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya singha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs la sogs pa'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// //bi pa la/ dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/

zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ chos dang chos nyid rnam par 'byed pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta ma hā dza na dang*/ lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur/ theg pa chen po mdo sde'i rgyan gyi rgya cher bshad pa slob dpon btsun pa ngo bo nyid med pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya singha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ mdo sde rgyan gyi tshigs su bcad pa dang po gnyis kyi bshad pa kha che'i yul gyi mkhas pa chen po dpal btsun pa so ma shrī'i zhal snga nas kyi zhabs kyi padmo'i ze'u 'bru'i rdul la reg pa slob dpon gzhan la phan pa bzang pos mdzad pa/ kha che'i mkhan po paṇḍi ta pa ra hi ta bha dra'i zhal snga nas dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu mchog gi 'gyur/ theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan gyi don bsdus pa slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dzñā na shrīs mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi brtson 'grus kyi 'gyur/ dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa'i 'grel bshad slob dpon blo brtan gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i mdo las 'phags pa byams pa'i le'u nyi tshe'i bshad pa slob dpon ye shes snying pos mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// //mi tsi gnyis la/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel bshad slob dpon chen po blo gros brtan pas mdzad par grags pa/ mang yul du mkhan po mu ne tsand+ra dang*/ lo tsā ba lce bkra shis kyis ṭī ka rnam pa gnyis kyi gzhi bzung ste mkhan pos kyang ci mkhyen du ṭī ka gsar du bsgyur ba rnam pa gnyis dang gtugs na yang ṭī ka gsar pa las mi mngon pa dag kyang 'di las zhib tu 'chad pas 'di yang gces par gyis/ mjug cung zad cig ma tshang ba 'di stor bas ṭī ka gnyis dang gtugs pa bzhugs so//

//tshi pa la/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i sa sde lnga'i dang po rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa'i dngos gzhi sa mang po pa 'di la shlau ka brgyad stong dgu brgya brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa bzhugs so// //dzi pa la/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa las nyan thos kyi sa rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur bzhugs so// 'di la shlau ka drug stong yod do// //wi pa la/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa las byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po'i go rim rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur bzhugs so// 'di la shlau ka drug stong bdun brgya lnga bcu yod do// //zhi pa dang zi pa'i stod la/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang*/ su rend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ smad la/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa las gzhi bsdu ba'i nang gi mdo sde bsdu ba bam po nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang*/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur bzhugs so// 'di la shlau ka drug stong bdun brgya dgu bcu rtsa gsum mchis so// //'i pa la/ gzhi bsdu ba'i nang gi rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa las 'dul ba bsdu ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang*/ dzi na mi tra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rnam grangs bsdu ba shlau ka bdun brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ rnam par bshad pa bsdu ba 'di ni 'phags pa thogs med bdag gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa chos kyi rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin byang bar brnyes pa 'phags pa mi pham pa'i zhabs kyi padmo rnyog pa med pa'i ze'u 'bru spyi bos len pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang*/

su rend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di la shlau ka lnga brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga yod do// de ltar sa sde lnga la shlau ka bzhi khri lnga stong*/ bam po brgya dang lnga bcu bzhugs so// rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa rnam par bshad pa zhes pa'i stod 'grel ji snyed pa bzhugs/ 'di la sngon gyi gna' mchan las/ dzi na mi tras bshad par bshad/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i 'grel pa sbyin pa'i rim par phye ba dgu pa yan chad slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i 'grel pa las ji snyed 'gyur ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims le'u'i 'grel pa slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi le'u'i rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon rgyal ba'i sras kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ pradzñā warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //yi pa la/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa las byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i rnam par bshad pa slob dpon rgya mtsho sprin gyis mdzad pa/ bal yul gyi paṇḍi ta chen po shānti bha dra'i zhal snga nas dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// //ri pa la/ theg pa chen po'i sdom theg pa chen po bsdus pa bam po bzhi pa dang*/ theg pa thun mong gi sdom chos mngon pa kun las btus pa bam po lnga pa slob dpon thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ theg pa chen po bsdus pa'i 'grel pa theg pa chen po la rab tu gnas pa bstan bcos phul du byung ba du ma mdzad pa'i slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas yul drag dmar lha sdings ri khas po ri'i rtsa chu bo lo hi ta'i 'gram dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas dbyig 'dul pe dkar gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'di la shlau ka ni nyis stong chig brgya brgyad cu/ bam po ni brgyad du byas so// theg pa chen po bsdus pa'i bshad sbyar slob dpon dge bsnyen btsun pa ngo bo nyid med pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur la/ dge slong dpal brtsegs kyis kyang zhus so// 'di la shlau ka nyis stong bdun brgya bdun bcu rtsa bzhi yod/ bam po bdun du byas so// theg bsdus kyi gnas dang po'i bshad pa don gsang ba rnam par phye ba bsdus te bshad pa ji snyed pa rnams bzhugs so// 'di la sngon gyi dkar chag las slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad zer ba snang ste min pa 'dra'o// //li pa la/ chos mngon pa kun las btus pa'i bshad pa bam po bcu pa slob dpon chen po rgyal ba'i sras kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ chos mngon pa kun las btus pa'i rnam par bshad pa slob dpon rgyal ba'i sras kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rtsa 'grel 'di gnyis lo paṇa ches cher mkhas pa rnams kyis legs par bsgyur mod kyi/ 'on kyang rgya gar gyi dpe la 'grel pa'i nang na rtsa ba'i tshig yongs su rdzogs par yod pa dang*/ skabs la lar 'grel pa chad pa dang*/ de ltar dris lan dang mtshams sbyor gyi tshig chad pa dang*/ 'grel pa'i tshig gong 'og ha cang bsnur ches par bsgyur ba dang*/ 'grel pa'i tshig ji lta ba ma yin par don tsam bsdus te bsgyur ba dang*/

mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad mi mtshungs par bsgyur ba dang*/ rang bzor bsgyur ba'i tshigs bcad byas pa la sogs pa'i skyon 'ga' zhig la brten slar yang rgya gar gyi dpe dang mthun par mang du thos pa'i lo tsā ba dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gtsug lag khang chen po dpal thar pa gling du cung zad dag par bcos pa rnams bzhugs so// //shi pa la/ thams cad rnam rig tsam du ston pa sum cu pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa slob dpon chen po dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ phyi rol gyi don 'gog pa nyi shu pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i rang bzhin gsum nges par bstan pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po shānti bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ phung po lnga'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i rnam par bshad pa'i rigs pa'i mdo sde'i dum bu brgya/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shuddha singha dang*/ sarba dzñā de wa dang*/ lo tsā ba rtsangs de wend+ra rakṣi tas bsgyur cing*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba mañdzu shrī warmas kyang zhus pa/ rnam par bshad pa'i rigs pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ bam po bcu pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shuddha singha dang*/ shākya singha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rtsangs de wend+ra rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ las grub pa'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shuddha singha dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rtsangs de wand+ra rakṣi tas bsgyur cing*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/ theg pa chen po'i chos brgya gsal ba'i sgo'i bstan bcos rgya'i dpe las slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa snang*/ deng sang bod rnams dpal ldan chos skyong gis mdzad ces grags so// dpal ldan dbang phyug rgya'i lo tsā ba thang sang tsang zhes bya bas rgya gar gyi skad las rgya'i skad du bsgyur cing*/ phyis ston pa dge slong chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya bas bsgyur bar zhus pa'i don du gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde pa las rab tu byung ba rgya nag chen po'i lha btsun chos kyi rin chen gyis dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur zhing legs par gtan la phab pa/ sum cu pa'i bshad pa slob dpon blo brtan gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rab tu byed pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel bshad slob dpon dul ba'i lhas mdzad pa dang*/ phung po lnga'i rab tu byed pa bye brag tu bshad pa/ bam po bzhi pa slob dpon blo gros brtan pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa rnams bzhugs so// //si pa la/ phung po lnga'i rnam par 'grel pa slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa dang*/ phung po lnga'i bshad pa slob dpon sa'i rtsa lag gis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/

rnam par bshad pa rigs pa'i bshad pa bam po bco lnga pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shuddha singha dang*/ shākya singha dang*/ lo tsā ba de wend+ra rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ 'di la tshigs su bcad pa bzhi stong chig brgya bzhugs so// //hi pa la/ sum cu pa'i 'grel bshad bam po lnga pa slob dpon dul ba lhas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ las grub pa'i rab tu byed pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon dpal nā lend+ra'i gtsug lag khang chen po na gnas pa dge slong blo bzang ngang tshul gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shuddha singha dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rtsangs de wend+ra rakṣi tas bsgyur cing*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyis gtan la phab pa/ dbu ma rgyan gyi 'grel bshad dbu ma'i lam grub pa zhes bya ba slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa/ 'di la bod na sems tsam rgyan zhes grags pa lo tsā ba shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ de ltar rnal 'byor spyod pa sems tsam pa'i lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa'i bstan bcos rnams bstan nas/ bsgom pa gtan la 'bebs pa'i bstan bcos ni/ bsam gtan gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i man ngag rnal 'byor pa mig gi snying po slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor la 'jug pa zhes bya ba slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ de'i don 'grel rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i man ngag slob dpon chos kyi dbang pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dza ran dā na dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa'i man ngag slob dpon mkhas pa chen po rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po shānti bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i bsgom pa'i don mdor bsdus nas bstan pa slob dpon ye shes zla bas mdzad pa/ rtsa ba slob dpon klu'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradzñā warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa'i man ngag slob dpon chen po ratna ā ka ra shāntis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po dpal rab 'byor zhi ba dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong ting nge 'dzin bzang po'i 'gyur/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag paṇḍi ta chen po ratna ā ka ra shāntis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po zhi ba bzang po dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyi 'gyur/ dge ba'i sdong po zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa bi kra ma shī la'i paṇḍi ta ratna kīrtis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta bidyā ka ra singha dang*/ lo tsā ba mañdzu shrī warma'i 'gyur/ spyod pa dang bslab bya ston pa'i skor la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nyi shu pa slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon shānta rakṣi tas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi dyā ka ra singha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba mañdzu shrī warma'i 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nyi shu pa'i dka' 'grel slob dpon byang chub bzang po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta kṣe ma ga ga na dang*/ lo tsā ba mang 'or dge slong byang chub shes rab kyi 'gyur/ 'di dag rtsom pa po rnams sems tsam gyi lta ba 'dzin pa ma yin yang*/ bod na 'di dag sems tsam lugs su grags 'dug pa dang*/ brjod bya'ang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims le'u'i skabs dang mthun par 'dug pas 'dir bris so// chos rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa paṇḍi ta chen po ratna kīrtis mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta chen po ratna kīrti de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba la chings yon tan 'bar gyi 'gyur/ dbu ma rgyan gyi man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba zhes bya ba paṇḍi ta rnams las mchog tu gyur par kun gyis bsngags shing 'gran zla med pa/ khyad par du slob dpon 'di 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ rin chen 'byung zhes bya ming gang*// ston pa'i bstan pa gsal byed 'byung*// zhes lung bstan pa des mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shānti bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyis bsgyur ba/ slad nas kha chen a mo gha dang*/ 'o ru lo tsā'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// 'di sems tsam gyi lta ba ston pa'i bstan bcos yin kyang*/ dus phyis rnyed pas pusti'i gsham du bzhugs pa yin no// chos rnams gzung dang 'dzin pa las grol ba'i// rnam rig tsam du ston pa'i lta bsgom spyod// gsal byed byams pa thogs med rjes 'brang gzhung*// bcu phrag drug la drug gis brgyan pa bzhugs// de dag gis ni theg pa chen po sems tsam du ston pa'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar sems tsam du ston pa'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ gsum pa bka' 'khor lo dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bka'i dgongs pa 'grel pa'i bstan bcos la/ dang po lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa ston pa mngon pa'i bstan bcos ni/ i pa la/ 'phags pa maud gal gyi bu chen pos mdzad pa'i gdags pa'i bstan bcos la/ 'jig rten bzhag pa bam po dgu/ 'di la dkar chag chen mo nas bam po bdun zhes 'byung*/ rgyu gdags pa bam po drug rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ pradzñā warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur/ las gdags pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ pradzñā warma dang*/

zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// 'di dag bye brag tu smra ba rnams bka' ru 'dod la/ mdo sde pa rnams bstan bcos su bzhed do// //ku khu gnyis la/ chos mngon pa mdzod kyi tshigs le'ur byas pa dang*/ de'i rang 'grel chos mngon pa'i mdzod kyi bshad pa bam po sum cu pa slob dpon chen po dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ chos mngon pa mdzod kyi bstan bcos kyi tshig le'ur byas pa'i 'grel pa mdo dang mthun pa zhes bya ba slob dpon 'dus bzangs kyis mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// //gu ngu gnyis la/ chos mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel bshad don gsal ba zhes bya ba shlau ka khri brgyad stong*/ bam po drug cu pa slob dpon rgyal po'i sras grags pa bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi shuddha singha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur ba bzhugs so// //cu chu gnyis la/ chos mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel bshad mtshan nyid kyi rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya ba slob dpon gang ba spel zhes pa chos mngon pa'i gzhung lugs gangs can mtsho'i pha rol tu son pas mdzad pa/ 'di ni gangs ri chen po ti se dang yid bzhin gyi mtsho'i lho ngos/ ri bo chen po spos kyi ngad ldang ba'i 'dab yul pu rangs su/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka na ka warma dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur ba bzhugs so// //ju nyu gnyis la/ chos mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel bshad nye bar mkho ba zhes bya ba mdo dang sbyar ba bal po'i paṇḍi ta dge slong zhi gnas lhas yang dag par sbyar ba/ kha che'i grong khyer chen po dpe med kyi dbus dza ra me'i gtsug lag khang gi byang phyogs kyi bsil khang du rgya gar gyi mkhan po dza ya shrī dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba khams pa dge slong shes rab 'od zer gyi 'gyur/

chos mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa gnad kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa/ gzhung gi tshad shlau ka bzhi stong yod pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po rnal 'byor zla ba dang*/ lo tsā ba 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i 'gyur/ chos mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel bshad mtshan nyid kyi rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po gang ba spel chos mngon pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka na ka warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ 'di 'grel pa chen mo las mchims kyis bkol ba yin no zhes kyang grag go /chos mngon pa la 'jug pa rgya cher 'grel pa'i snying po kun las btus pa zhes bya ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shī la dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rab tu byed pa chos mngon pa la 'jug pa zhes bya ba rnams bzhugs so// //gnyis pa lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa mdo sde'i sde snod kyi dgongs 'grel la/ tu pa la/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms dgra bcom pa chos skyob kyis bsdus pa shlau ka stong lnga brgya bzhi bcu pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bidyā ka ra pra bha dang*/ lo tsā ba rin chen mchog gi 'gyur la/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyis zhus nas gtan la phab pa/ 'di bye brag tu smra ba rnams kyis bka' nyid du bzhed do// ched du brjod pa'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa slob dpon shes rab go chas mdzad pa'i stod bzhugs so// //thu pa la/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms kyi rnam par 'grel pa'i smad dum yul ka ba dhyar skyes pa thos pa mang ba'i slob dpon bo dhi warma'i slob ma yul bhaṅga lar skye ba bzhes pa thams cad yod par smra ba'i slob dpon pradzñā warmas mdzad pa/ 'di la shlau ka stong phrag bcu gnyis dang lnga brgya yod do zhes rgya gar gyi yi ge las smos/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po sgra'i gtsug lag la byams klas par mkhas pa paṇḍi ta dza nar dha na dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 'phags pa chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po'i rnam par 'grel pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta ye shes snying po dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ bstan bcos tshigs su bcad pa bsdus pa zhes bya ba dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa'i don bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma ka ra dang*/ lo tsā ba ye shes snying pos bsgyur te/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyis zhus pa rnams bzhugs so// //gsum pa lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi dgongs 'grel la/ bka' so so'i dgongs 'grel dang*/ spyi'i dgongs 'grel gnyis kyi bka' lung so so'i dgongs 'grel la/ rtsa ba'i lung gi dgongs 'grel dang*/ bshad pa'i lung gi dgongs 'grel gnyis las/ dang po la/ rtsa ba'i lung so sor thar pa'i dgongs 'grel ni/ du pa la/ so sor thar pa'i mdo'i gzhung 'grel gyi stod bzhugs so// //nu pa la/ so sor thar pa'i mdo'i gzhung 'grel gyi smad slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad par grags pa/ 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa kha che bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon sarba dzñā de wa dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ 'di la shlau ka dgu stong*/ bam po nyi shu rtsa bdun no// so sor thar pa'i 'grel pa 'dul ba bsdus pa zhes bya ba slob dpon khyad par bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa bam po bcu gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī lend+ra bo dhi dang*/ shākya pra bha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bai ro tsa na rakṣi tas bsgyur ba la/ slad kyis kha che'i mkhan po dzñā na shrī bha dra dang*/

lo tsā ba dge slong rgyal ba shes rab dang*/ shākya bshes gnyen gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// //pu phu bu gsum la/ so sor thar pa'i mdo'i rgya cher 'grel pa kun las btus pa slob dpon dri med bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa kha che bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang*/ sarba dzñā de wa dang*/ bod kyi zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur ba/ 'di la shlau ka khri lnga stong yod/ bam po ni bdun cur byas so// so sor thar pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa mdzad byang 'gyur byang med pa cig rnams bzhugs so// //mu pa la/ so sor thar pa'i 'grel pa mi brjed pa'i dran byed mdzad byang med pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzā rand+ra ra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur zer ba cig so sor thar pa'i tshig gi brjed byang dā na shī las mdzad par grags pa/ 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa kha che bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ so sor thar pa'i 'grel pa tshig gi dga' ba bskyed pa zhes bya ba mdo sde 'dzin pa ka lyā na mi tras nye bar sbyar ba'i dum bu cig 'dul ba bya ba'i phung po mjug ma tshang ba cig rnams bzhugs so// //tsu pa la/ 'phags pa thams cad yod par smra ba'i dge slong ma'i so sor thar pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa mdzad byang dang 'gyur byang med pa cig bzhugs/ gnyis pa bshad pa'i lung gi dgongs 'grel la/ 'dul ba gzhi'i rgya cher 'grel pa mdo sde 'dzin pa dge legs bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ gso sbyong gi gzhi dgag dbye'i 'phro bam po bcu gnyis pa yan chad mjug ma tshang ba rnams bzhugs so// //tshu pa la/ 'dul ba lung rnam par 'byed pa'i tshig rnam par bshad pa slob dpon dul ba lhas mdzad pa/ 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang*/

zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur ba 'di la shlau ka ni lnga stong chig brgya/ bam po ni bcu bdun du byas pa rnams bzhugs so// //dzu pa la/ 'dul ba lung phran tshegs kyi rnam par bshad pa slob dpon tshul khrims bskyangs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī buddha shānti dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/ 'dul ba lung bla ma'i bre brag lung zhu ba'i 'grel pa mdo sde 'dzin pa dge legs bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa 'go mjug gnyis ka nas ma tshang ba cig bzhugs so// //gnyis pa 'dul ba'i bka' lung spyi'i dgongs 'grel ni/ wu pa la/ rtsa ba'i lung dang bshad pa'i lung thams cad kyi dgongs 'grel mtshan nyid gtan la 'bebs par byed pa 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba shlau ka nyis stong bdun brgya/ bam po dgur byas pa dang*/ cho ga lag len gtan la 'bebs par byed pa las brgya rtsa gcig pa gnyis slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang*/ lo tsā ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// 'di la shlau ka ni sum stong bdun brgya/ bam po ni dgur byas so// //zhu zu gnyis la/ 'dul ba mdo'i 'grel pa mngon par brjod pa rang gi rnam par bshad pa zhes bya ba yul bcom brlag gi 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i rtsod pa chen po rnams kyi khyu mchog bstan bcos du ma mdzad pa gzhung 'bum phrag bco brgyad la kha ton mdzad pa'i slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta ā laṅka ra de wa dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong ga rod tshul khrims 'byung gnas sbas pa gnyis kyis dpal sgye'u ri'i rtsa chos skor dben tsha'i gtsug lag khang du 'gyur ba bzhugs so// 'di la shlau ka stong phrag bcu bzhi yod do// //'u yu gnyis la/ 'dul ba mdo'i rgya cher 'grel pa 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po tho gar gyi bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon dharmā mi tras mdzad pa/

kha che bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur ba bzhugs/ 'di la shlau ka ni nyi khri chig stong*/ bam po ni bdun cur byas so// //ru pa la/ 'dul ba mdo'i 'grel pa slob dpon pradzñā ka ras mdzad pa bzhugs so// //lu pa la/ 'dul ba mdo'i rtsa ba'i 'grel pa chung ba slob dpon mang du thos shing yon tan dang ldan pa yon tan gyi 'od thams cad yod par smra ba pas byas par grags pa bzhugs/ 'di bod mar the tshom za'o// //shu pa la/ 'dul ba tshig le'ur byas pa me tog phreng rgyud ces bya ba 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po 'phags pa dge 'dun 'bangs kyi slob ma dpal 'phags pa sa ga'i lhas mdzad pa bam po lnga pa/ bal po'i paṇḍi ta dza yā ka ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong pradzñā kīrtis bsgyur/ rgya gar shar phyogs satna ga ra'i paṇḍi ta ba na ratna ma hā sthi bī ra la gtugs te sgra'i don la mkhas pa rong ston shes bya kun rig gis kyang 'gyur bcos cung zad byas pa/ 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i dge tshul gyi tshig le'ur byas pa sum brgya pa dang*/ 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i dge tshul gyi tshig le'ur byas pa'i 'grel pa 'od ldan bam po brgyad pa mang du thos pa'i slob dpon shākya 'od kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzñā de wa dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rtsangs de wend+ra rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ tshig le'ur byas pa sum brgya pa'i rnam par bshad pa slob ma la phan pa zhes bya ba slob dpon dul ba'i lhas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po buddha shānti dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur rnams bzhugs so// 'di la shlau ka stong phrag phyed dang bzhi yod do// //su pa la/ 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba dge tshul gyi tshig le'ur byas pa lnga bcu pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad kyang zer/

kha che dge 'dun bzang pos mdzad kyang zer ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po mu ni warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba sna nam ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa don brgyad ma yang zer/ dge sbyong gi kā ri kā lnga bcu pa'i tshig gi brjed byang du byas pa slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa/ yang lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa thams cad yod par smra ba rnams kyi dge tshul gyi bya ba zhes bya ba 'di bod kyi mkhan po chen po dag gi brjed byang yin pa 'dra'o// dge tshul gyi bslab pa'i gzhi'i mdo mdo sde 'dzin pa'i slob dpon ka lyāṇa mi tras mdzad pa/ kha che'i mkhan po grong khyer dpe med kyi paṇḍi ta ma hā dza na dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu mchog gi 'gyur ba las/ slad kyis kha che'i paṇḍi ta pa ra hi ta dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu mchog gis bcos shing zhus pa/ gleng gzhi dang gang zag bsdus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa byang phyogs kyi kha che'i yul nas byung ba'i paṇḍi ta 'dul ba 'dzin pa dge slong ba la shrī bha dras mdzad pa/ tho ling gi gtsug lag khang du rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong gzhon nu mchog gi 'gyur/ dpe kha cig na bi ma la shrīs mdzad zer/ dge tshul gyi dang po'i lo dri ba kha che'i mkhan po na ras de wa dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rgyal ba'i shes rab kyi 'gyur/ dge slong gi dang po'i lo dri ba dpal ra sa'i gtsug lag khang gi 'od mchog dngos grub kyi gtsug lag khang du rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ 'dul ba dri ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa dang*/ 'dul ba dri ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon mdo sde 'dzin pa kā lyāṇa mi tras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharmā ka ra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ shlau ka stong drug brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi yod do// 'dul ba la bstod pa btsun pa chos kyi tshong dpon gyis mdzad pa dang*/

'dul ba la bstod pa'i tshig gi rnam par bshad pa btsun pa chos kyi tshong dpon gyis mdzad cing slob dpon dul ba'i lhas bshad pa/ 'phags pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa kha che bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ gzhung lugs kyi bye brag bkod pa'i 'khor lo btsun pa dbyig gi bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharmā ka ra dang*/ lo tsā ba bzang skyong gi 'gyur/ sde pa tha dad par byed pa dang rnam par bshad pa slob dpon bha byas mdzad pa/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang du rgya gar shar phyogs bhaṅga la'i mkhas pa chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na zhes bya ba'i paṇḍi ta'i zhal snga nas dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ gzhung tha dad pa rim par bklag pa'i 'khor lo las sde pa tha dad pa bstan pa bsdus pa zhes bya ba 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i slob dpon dul ba'i lhas mdzad pa bzhugs so// de gsum 'dul ba dngos ma yin kyang*/ de dang rjes su 'brel pa la bsams nas sngon gyi rnams kyis 'dul ba'i skabs su bris 'dug pa bzhin bris so// dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa brgyad pa dang*/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa brgyad pa'i bshad pa slob dpon chen po su na ya shrīs mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po dge slong dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ rnam par grol ba'i lam la sbyangs pa'i yon tan bstan pa zhes bya ba rgya gar gyi mkhan po bidyā ka ra pra bha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ 'di sngon gyi dkar chag chen mo las bkar bshad gzhung gi ngo bo bltas na bstan bcos su gsal bas bstan bcos kyi sder snga ma rnams kyis kyang bris 'dug pas bris so// 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi 'khor du gyur pa gser mdog gi rtogs pa brjod pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ ku na la'i rtogs pa brjod pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po padmā ka ra warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ gzhon nu ma bdun gyi rtogs pa brjod pa slob dpon gsang bas byin gyis mdzad pa/ bslab pa bcu'i cho ga klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas gsungs pa/ rtse thang lo tsā ba gzhon nu'i 'gyur/ ye dharma'i 'grel pa slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes gsungs pa/ rtse thang lo tsā ba gzhon nu'i zhabs kyi 'gyur ba rnams bzhugs so// rtogs pa brjod pa 'di dag 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi 'khor du gtogs par bshad pas 'dir bris so// chos rnams thams cad bdag dang sems can med// rgyu dang bcas las byung bar ston pa'i gzhung*// 'khor lo dang po'i rjes 'brang bslab pa gsum// ston byed gzhung ni drug cu rtsa gsum bzhugs// de dag gis ni bka' dang po'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar bka' dang po'i chos skor rnams bkod nas/ da ni bka' 'khor lo rim pa gsum gyi nang nas ci rigs par btus pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'dul ba'i sde snod skyes pa'i rabs sna tshogs kyi skor la/ hu pa la/ skyes pa'i rabs sum cu rtsa bzhi pa slob dpon dpa' bos sbyar ba/ shlau ka sum stong phyed dang bzhi/ bam po bcu gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bidyā ka ra singha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba mañdzu shrī warma'i 'gyur/ skyes pa'i rabs kyi rgya cher bshad pa slob dpon dharma kīrtis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta dza na ra dha na dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba i bu dge slong shākya blo gros kyi 'gyur gnyis bzhugs so//

//u pa la/ slob dpon rgyal po'i sras seng ge zhabs 'bring bas mdzad pa'i skyes pa'i rabs kyi phreng ba sum cu rtsa lnga pa rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta a laṅka de wa dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims 'byung gnas sbas pas dpal sgye'u ri'i rtse chos skor dben pa'i gtsug lag khang du 'gyur/ gzhon nu gtsug na nor bu'i skyes pa'i rabs zlos gar gyi bstan bcos 'jig rten kun du dga' ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa/ paṇḍi ta chen po kīrti tsand+ra dang*/ lo tsā ba yar lungs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bal yul yam bu'i grong khyer du legs par 'gyur/ rig pa 'dzin pa sprin gyi bzhon pa'i skyes rabs klu kun du dga' ba'i zlos gar dpal dga' ba'i lhas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po lakṣ+mī ka ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shong ston gyis dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du 'gyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //ke khe gnyis la/ byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri shing snyan dngags mkhan chen po dge ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po snyan dngags mkhan chen po lakṣ+mī ka ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shong ston gyis mang yul 'phags pa'i drung dge 'dun bzhi sde'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du rgya dpe dang legs par gtugs nas skad gnyis ka'i cha la zhu chen zhib pa cig grub pas gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa/ slar yang 'di'i skad gnyis zung du sbyar ba la/ 'jig rten gyi mig tu gyur pa'i zhwa lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang pos legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyi gzhung la sogs pa dang bstun te/ zhu chen mdzad pa bzhugs so// //ge pa la/ sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po yul sha se ta ka'i gser mig ma'i bu dge slong snyan dngags mkhan chen po smra ba dang ldan pa phyogs su rnam par grags pa btsun pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/

paṇḍi ta sa dbang bzang po dang*/ lo tsā ba blo gros rgyal po'i 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyes pa'i rabs kyi chos kyi gaṇḍī'i sgra bsgrags pa snyan dngags mkhan chen po slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa/ chos kyi rje sa steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i paṇḍi ta chen po kha che shākya shrī bzang po dang*/ lo tsā ba gnubs dge slong byams pa'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ skyes rabs 'di rnams byang chub sems dpa'i 'dul ba yin pas/ sngar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i phyogs su bris kyang rung mod kyi/ bka' 'khor lo dang po dang*/ tha ma'i gseb nas btus pa shas che bar snang zhing*/ bka' 'khor lo rim pa gsum ka dang 'brel par snang bas 'dir bris so// gang zhig rlabs chen byang chub sems kyi mthus// gcig tu gzhan don spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// dka' ba spyod pa'i rnam thar skyes pa'i rabs// ston pa'i gzhung lugs rnam pa brgyad bzhugs so// de dag gis ni skyes pa'i rabs kyi chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar skyes rabs kyi chos skor rnams bkod nas/ bka' 'khor lo rim pa gsum ka dang spyir 'brel pa gtam du bya ba dang phrin yig sna tshogs kyi skor la/ rgyal po la gtam bya ba rin po che'i phreng ba slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzñā na garbha dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur la/ slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka na ka warma dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis rgya dpe gsum dang gtugs te legs par bcos pa/ rin po che'i phreng ba'i rgya cher bshad pa slob dpon mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bidyā ka ra pra bha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ rmi lam yid bzhin nor bu'i gtam sbyin pa'i gtam/

srid pa las 'das pa'i gtam rnams slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta shrī ra tha dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ yon tan bdun yongs su brjod pa'i gtam slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta gaṅgā dha ra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ tshul khrims kyi gtam slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dza ran dha na dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ tshul khrims kyi gtam gyi 'grel pa slob dpon gsal grags kyis mdzad pa/ tshogs kyi gtam slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po gaṅgā dha ra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ mi khom pa brgyad kyi gtam slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī a dzi ta bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ legs par bshad pa rin po che za ma tog lta bu'i gtam snyan dngags mkhan chen po slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ru dra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ phyin ci log bzhi spang ba'i gtam slob dpon ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po buddha bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ rtsod pa'i dus kyi gtam slob dpon ma ti tsi ṭas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ dben pa'i gtam slob dpon chen po sa 'tsho byin gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur ba rnams bzhugs so// //nge pa la/ chos smra ba dang dam pa'i chos nyan pa la gus par bya ba'i gtam slob dpon sa 'tsho sbyin gyis mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po gnas brtan a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ ched du brjod pa'i gtam drang srong chen po zla bas mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ mi rtag pa'i don gyi gtam snyan dngags mkhan chen po dga' ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa dang*/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta bi nā ya dang*/ lo tsā ba grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur/ legs pa'i lam bstan pa'i gtam slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa bam po phyed dang gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ lo tsā ba chen po dge slong rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam bstan pa slob dpon bram ze btsun pa chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po buddha ka ra warma dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ mya ngan bsal ba slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam bstan pa slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i 'gro ba drug gi tshig le'ur byas pa slob dpon btsun pa chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharmā ka ra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rtsangs de wend+ra rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i nyes dmigs bshad pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis dge slong rab gsal gzhon nu la spring ba'i phrin yig bshes pa'i spring yig slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdza' bo rgyal po bde spyod la bskur ba/

slob ma la spring ba'i phrin yig slob dpon chen po tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa rnams rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzñā de wa dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ rgyal po chen po ka niṣka la spring ba'i phrin yig slob dpon ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi dyā ka ra pra bha dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande rin chen mchog gi 'gyur la/ ā tsārya dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa/ sems rin po che rnam par sbyang ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba'i spring yig slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' chen po dgra las rgyal ba gsang bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya du lo pa dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ bla ma la spring pa dge slong dgon pa bas mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsārya bi nā ya tsand+ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ bu la spring pa paṇḍi ta mkhas pa sadzdza na chen pos mdzad pa/ kha che'i mkhan po ma hā dza na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ dri ma med pa'i rin po che'i phrin yig ces bya ba gnas brtan mkhas pa chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas rgyal po nirya pha la la brdzangs pa dus de nyid du bla ma de nyid dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal ba'i 'gyur/ shlau ka bzhi bcu pa'o// rgyal po zla ba la spring ba'i spring yig rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shrī dza ga ta mi tra ā nandas mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug de nyid dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba gnubs tshul khrims shes rab kyi 'gyur bshes pa'i spring yig gi rgya cher bshad pa tshig gsal ba zhes bya ba slob dpon blo gros chen pos mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzñā de wa dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ slob ma la spring ba'i phrin yig gi dka' 'grel slob dpon bai ro tsa na rakṣi tas mdzad pa/

rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta chen po su ga ta shrī mi tra dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ slob ma la spring ba'i 'grel pa slob dpon shes rab 'byung gnas blo gros kyis rang gi slob ma rnams la phan pa'i don du mdzad pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi nā ya tsand+ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rgya gar nub phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen po dzñā na bha dras lo tsā ba chen po bu ston gyi phyag tu

ma byung phrin yig tu bskur ba lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal gyi 'gyur/ slob dpon ka ma la shī las lho za mo tshangs pa'i dbyangs la sdug bsngal brgyad kyi bye brag bstan pa dang*/ slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas gsang bas bod rje 'bangs dang bod btsun rnams la brdzangs pa'i phrin yig slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa'i dad bskyed sgron ma/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thos pa'i phan yon ston pa dpe'i phreng ba las sangs rgyas mchog gi dpe rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang*/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims yon tan gyi 'gyur la/ dge slong rin chen bzang pos bcos nas gtan la phab pa/ dkon mchog ma byung mchod pa'i phan yon bstan pa/ mya ngan med pa'i sgo nas klu btul ba'i le'u/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po gnas brtan a dzi ta shrī bha dra dang*/ dge slong shākya 'od kyi 'gyur/ dge 'dun spyan drang ba dpal 'byor rab brtan gyi phyag dpe rgya dpe las zhwa lu lo tsā ba'i 'gyur/ gnas brtan spyan drang ba slob dpon bha wa skandha sya zhes bya bas mdzad pa/ ā tsārya dzi na mi tra dang*/ lo tsā ba bande ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ bstan pa'i gtad rabs mgo mjug ma tshang na yang tshong 'dus kyi pho brang du 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ji ltar gnas tshul dang tha mar nub tshul ston pa dgra bcom pa dge 'dun 'phel gyis lung ston pa dang*/ li'i yul lung bstan pa zhes bya ba gnyis bzhugs so// 'di gnyis li yul nas 'gyur ba yin pa 'dra'o// ngan 'gro srid pa'i duḥkha kun spong zhing*// mngon mtho zhi ba'i bde ba sgrub pa'i thabs// gtam du bya dang spring yig la sogs skor// bcu phrag bzhi la bdun gyis brgyan pa bzhugs// de dag gis ni gtam du bya ba dang spring yig sna tshogs pa'i chos skor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs rnams bkod zin to// //de ltar rang nyid kun shes pa nang rig pa'i bstan bcos rnams bkod nas/
